izzyondroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.name: Running Services Monitor
izzyondroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.summary: Monitor running services on your Android device with Root or Shizuku
izzyondroid:me.biplobsd.rsm.description:
Running Services Monitor helps you monitor running services on your Android device. With a clean and intuitive interface, you can easily view system and user apps and check their status efficiently.
 Features 
 Monitor Running Services: View a comprehensive list of all running services on your device
 Categorized View: Easily switch between All, User, and System apps
 Search Functionality: Quickly find specific apps with the built-in search bar
 App Details: Get detailed information about each app, including package name, version, and more
 Root & Shizuku Integration: First checks for root permission, then falls back to Shizuku for advanced system interactions (where supported)
 Material Design 3: A modern and beautiful UI that adapts to your device's theme
 Dark/Light Mode: Toggle between dark and light themes for comfortable viewing
 Localization: Support for English, Bangla, Chinese languages
 Requirements 
 Essential:
 Android 7.0 (API 24) or higher
 Root access (preferred) OR Shizuku app installed and running
 Permissions:
 QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES - To list all installed apps
 Root permission OR Shizuku permission - The app first checks for root access, then falls back to Shizuku if root is unavailable
 How It Works 
 This app uses root access or Shizuku to execute privileged ADB commands. Starting from Android 8.0 (API 26), the ActivityManager.getRunningServices() API was deprecated and restricted. Third-party apps can no longer query all running services on the device for privacy and security reasons.
 Root access provides the most seamless experience with direct access to system commands and no additional setup required.
 Shizuku provides an alternative for non-rooted devices by running a privileged service that can access system APIs, allowing apps to execute ADB commands without root, working on non-rooted devices via Wireless Debugging (Android 11+) or USB ADB.
 The app checks for root permission first, and if not available, falls back to Shizuku. It executes dumpsys activity services to get running service information, parses the output to extract service details (package name, PID, process name, etc.), and categorizes services into System and User categories.
 Limitations 
 Due to Android security policies, some service information may be limited
 When using Shizuku, the service stops when device reboots
 Dumpsys output format may vary across Android versions
 This app only displays services; it cannot start/stop them
 This app is designed for users who want to monitor running services on their device, similar to the "Running Services" feature that was available in Android Developer Options in older Android versions.

fdroid:com.exner.tools.immichuploader.name: Immich Uploader
fdroid:com.exner.tools.immichuploader.summary: App that can upload media files to your Immich instance.
fdroid:com.exner.tools.immichuploader.description:
Immich Uploader is a small app that discovers media files on your Android device, then uploads them to your Immich instance.
 The app can be configured to remove media files from your device after successful updates. This can be configured individually by type of file (Photo, Screenshot, Download, or Others).
 It can also apply Tags to media files after successful upload. Again, this can be configured by type of file.
 Permissions
 Android
 The app needs INTERNET permissions for the upload as well as access to your media files, which it will explicitly ask for. 
 On devices running Android 17 or later, it also needs ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK permissions if you want to use a local server URL when your Android device is on the same network as your Immich server. This usually speeds up upload a great deal.
 Immich
 The app connects to your Immich instance. It needs an API Key to do so.
 You can use your standard Immich user, or you can (should) create a user specifically for Immich Uploader.
 The user must have the following permissions on your Immich instance:
 asset.upload - for uploading media assets
 apiKey.read - for testing the connection, used on the Settings screen (since v2.2.2)
 tag.read - for retrieving the list of Tags on your Immich instance (since v3.1.0)
 tag.asset - for applying Tags to assets (since v3.1.0)
 If you use the "Check connection" buttons on the Settings view, but your Immich user does not have apiKey.read permission, the check will fail.
 If your Immich user does not have tag.read permission, the app can not download Tags from the Immich instance, and if they do not have tag.asset permission, uploads will still work, but media files will not be tagged.
fdroid:com.exner.tools.immichuploader.category: Cloud Storage & File Sync, Connectivity, Multimedia

fdroid:com.finanplus.name: Finan+
fdroid:com.finanplus.summary: Offline, encrypted personal finance manager (Brazilian Portuguese)
fdroid:com.finanplus.description:
Finan+ is a simple, lightweight and private personal finance app. It works fully offline: your data stays on your device , with no account and no external server.
 Note: the app interface is in Brazilian Portuguese and amounts are in Brazilian reais (R$).
 Features 
 Quick entry for income and expenses: a large amount, category and date chips, and Undo after saving
 Accounts and credit cards: each card shows its open bill, limit usage and due date, with alerts when the limit is almost used
 Installments, recurring transactions, bills to pay and to receive
 Current balance and end-of-month forecast, calculated the same way on every screen, plus a calendar with each day's balance
 Each month's balance on its own or carried over from previous months, as you prefer
 Shared expenses: split a bill with friends or family (equally or by each person's amount), see who owes what, record partial payments, attach the receipt and send a PDF statement or a Finan+ image via WhatsApp
 Monthly limits per category and savings goals: saving into a goal takes the money out of the account without counting it as an expense, with an alert when a goal will miss its deadline
 Debts: loans and financing in installments, with the next installment and how much is left
 "What if…?" simulator to save, plan a purchase or pay off a debt early, without touching your data
 Read a bill or boleto: amount and due date from a PDF (password-protected too), the boleto line or a Pix code
 Reports with charts and PDF report export
 On-device assistant: suggests categories from descriptions, summarizes the month, gives saving tips and answers quick questions, always explaining why
 Balance widget and daily due-date reminders
 7 themes, including Gruvbox, OLED, Tokyo Night and Nord, with an optional glass effect
 Network access (optional): use Finan+ in your computer's browser on the same Wi-Fi, with the data staying on the phone. HTTPS with the phone's own certificate, a code and confirmation on the phone
 JSON backup and restore (compatible with Finan+ web and Finan+ for Linux) and CSV export
 Automatic backup: one copy a day, encrypted with a password, to a folder you choose (phone, SD card, Google Drive, Nextcloud…)
 Privacy and security 
 Data encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key kept in the Android Keystore
 PIN and/or strong biometric lock, with auto-lock
 Screenshots blocked by default and an option to hide amounts
 Discreet notifications and widget when the app is protected
 No ads, no trackers, no account, no sign-up
 The network permission is only for local network access: off until you turn it on, works only on your home Wi-Fi and turns itself off after 10 minutes of inactivity. The app never connects to the internet
 Finan+ is free software, licensed under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

fdroid:com.redtrigger.name: RedTrigger
fdroid:com.redtrigger.summary: System-wide shoulder triggers for Nubia Red Magic phones
fdroid:com.redtrigger.description:
RedTrigger enables shoulder triggers (SAR capacitive sensors) on Nubia Red Magic phones system-wide, without needing Game Space.
Nubia's game framework controls the shoulder trigger hardware and only activates them inside Game Space. The system also resets trigger settings every time you switch apps. RedTrigger fixes both issues.
How it works:
- Activates SAR sensors without launching full Game Space
- Runs a watchdog service that detects when Nubia's SystemMgr resets trigger settings on app switch
- Re-applies settings instantly, keeping triggers active across all apps
Key remapping (via Shizuku):
- Reads raw input events from /dev/input using a Shizuku UserService
- Optionally injects remapped key events (L1/R1) so apps like KeyMapper can capture them
- Uses a virtual uinput device so remapped events appear as real hardware input
Requirements:
- Nubia Red Magic phone (tested on Red Magic 11 Pro)
- Shizuku installed and running (wireless ADB or root)
The app automatically grants itself WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS via Shizuku, so no manual ADB commands are needed. Enable "Auto-enable on boot" to survive reboots.

fdroid:de.cyb3rko.pincredible.name: PINcredible - Secure PIN vault
fdroid:de.cyb3rko.pincredible.summary: Modern and secure Android app to help you remember any PIN
fdroid:de.cyb3rko.pincredible.description:
About 
Over time I've used several apps to store my PINs, unfortunately none of them really convinced me.
So here we are now, this is my own implementation of a secure PIN manager.
 Features 
 🔢 PIN obfuscation
 🔐 Local Encryption
 🎨 Modern Design
 🌐 No Internet Connection required
 🎞️ No Ads
 🗿 No Suspicious Permissions
The app obfuscates the PIN in a table layout surrounded by secure random numbers. 
This brings two security benefits:
1. ❔ The app can not know where in the pattern the user given PIN is located at. Attackers can not extract the plaintext PIN.
2. 🕵️ This offers protection against Shoulder Surfing , for example while accessing your PIN in a super market or a bank.
 Security Aspects 
For technical details about the implemented security take a look at the GitHub repo readme .
 Used Icons 
 Color-blindness-test icons created by Freepik - Flaticon 
 Grid icons created by prettycons - Flaticon 
 Random icons created by Uniconlabs - Flaticon

fdroid:dev.midnightbeam.name: MidnightBeam
fdroid:dev.midnightbeam.summary: Screen dimmer and warm filter for Android TV, with phone remote and schedule
fdroid:dev.midnightbeam.description:
Less blue light, more comfortable movie nights. MidnightBeam is a warm (red) filter and screen dimmer for Android TV boxes, projectors, TVs and phones.
It draws a click-through overlay above everything, video included. Filter strength, brightness and colour temperature change live, with no flash to full brightness. Made for the many LED projectors and TV boxes that cannot lower their own light.
 On the TV 
* a settings screen that needs only the D-pad and OK, with a clearly visible focus highlight
* a QR code to control it from a phone (the phone remote is on by default on TVs, on the local network only, protected by a pairing code; the TV announces itself there over mDNS so the phone app can find it)
* an "Android app" button with a QR code to download the app on a phone
* the schedule shown as a timeline at the bottom of the screen
 On a phone or tablet 
* use the filter on the phone itself, or control your TVs and projectors
* scenes (Movie, Relax, Night…) and your own, a power button and the state of every device
* add a TV by scanning its QR code or by hand (address and code); the device type is detected
* a guided setup for the permissions Android needs
* no app at all is needed for a quick try: the QR code opens the same controls in the phone browser
 Audio (optional) 
Volume, equalizer, presets, bass boost, surround and loudness of the device from the phone, with an on-screen display on the TV, on devices whose audio supports the standard Android effects.
 Schedule 
Daily or weekly time slots, dragged on a timeline, with gradual transitions between them; the TV applies them by itself, even with the phone off. A manual change lasts until the next slot.
 Automation 
* adb shell: am start-foreground-service -n dev.midnightbeam/.DimService --ei red 60 --ei bright 40 --ei temp 1100 
* Home Assistant, through the Android Debug Bridge integration (example package and dashboard in the source repository)
* a small HTTP API on the local network
The last setting is restored early at boot. The service can only be controlled by the app itself and from adb shell, not by other apps.
Plain Java, about 420 KB (mostly artwork), no trackers, no ads, no data collected, no internet connections: the network is used only on your local network, for the phone remote (port 8765) and to reach the TVs you paired.
The optional accessibility service is used only to draw the dimming overlay above everything on Android 12+; it reads no content.
On a TV box without a touch screen, the overlay permission can be granted with adb shell appops set dev.midnightbeam SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow , or in Settings, Special app access, Display over other apps.

fdroid:tech.ula.name: UserLAnd
fdroid:tech.ula.summary: Easiest way to run GNU/Linux Distros on Android - no root required
fdroid:tech.ula.description:
UserLAnd is an open-source app which allows you to run several Linux distributions like Ubuntu,
Debian, and Kali.
- No need to root your device.
- Use a built-in terminal to access your favorite shells.
- Easily connect to VNC sessions for a graphical experience.
- Easy setup for several common Linux distributions, like Ubuntu and Debian.
- Easy setup for several common Linux applications, like Octave and Firefox.
- A way to experiment and learn Linux and other common software tools from the palm of your hand.
UserLAnd was created and is being actively maintained by the folks behind the popular Android
application, GNURoot Debian. It is meant as a replacement for the original GNURoot Debian app.
When UserLAnd first launches, it presents a list of common distributions and Linux applications.
Clicking one of these then leads to a series of set-up prompts. Once these have been completed,
UserLAnd will download and set up files required to start the task that has been selected. Based on
the set-up, you will then be connected to your Linux distribution or application in a terminal or
VNC viewing Android application.
Want to know more about getting started? View our wiki on Github:
https://github.com/CypherpunkArmory/UserLAnd/wiki/Getting-Started-in-UserLAnd
Want to ask questions, give feedback, or report any bugs you've encountered? Reach us on Github:

debian-packages:checksecurity.name: checksecurity
debian-packages:checksecurity.description:
Checksecurity can periodically do some very basic system security checks:
 * check-setuid - scans for insecurely mounted remote file systems,
 and tracks changes in setuid programs;
 * check-sockets - tracks changes in open ports to detect rogue programs;
 * check-passwd - scans for empty or duplicate system accounts;
 * check-disfree - scans for mounted filesystems nearing capacity;
 * check-iptables-logs - scans logs generated by iptables and look
 for intrusion attempts.
Be aware that these minimal set of checks are no substitute for a full
security auditing and integrity checking system.
In addition to these checks you are encourage to install additional packages
(listed in "Recommends") to provide more information concerning the security
or vulnerability of your system.
Installing the suggested package lockfile-progs can help to prevent
the cron jobs running multiple times if something gets jammed.

debian-packages:backup-manager.description:
This is a backup program, designed to help you make daily archives of
your file system.
Written in bash and perl, it can make tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, and zip
archives and can be run in a parallel mode with different
configuration files. Other archives are possible: MySQL or SVN dumps,
incremental backups...

remote hosts.

possible.
The configuration file is very simple and basic and gettext is used for
internationalization.

This package provides symbolic links that alias the following Go import paths to github.com/inconshreveable/log15: – gopkg.in/inconshreveable/log15.v2 Aliasing Go import paths via symbolic links or http redirects is fragile. fedora-packages:golang-gopkg-yaml-3/gola.description: The yaml package enables Go programs to comfortably encode and decode YAML values. It was developed within Canonical as part of the juju project, and is based on a pure Go port of the well-known libyaml C library to parse and generate YAML data quickly and reliably. The yaml package supports most of YAML 1.2, but preserves some behavior from 1.1 for backwards compatibility. Specifically, as of v3 of the yaml package: – YAML 1.1 bools (yes/no, on/off) are supported as long as they are being decoded into a typed bool value. Otherwise they behave as a string. Booleans in YAML 1.2 are true/false only. – Octals encode and decode as 0777 per YAML 1.1, rather than 0o777 as specified in YAML 1.2, because most parsers still use the old format. Octals in the 0o777 format are supported though, so new files work. – Does not support base-60 floats. These are gone from YAML 1.2, and were actually never supported by this package as it's clearly a poor choice. and offers backwards compatibility with YAML 1.1 in some cases. 1.2, including support for anchors, tags, map merging, etc. Multi-document unmarshalling is not yet implemented, and base-60 floats from YAML 1.1 are purposefully not supported since they're a poor design and are gone in YAML 1.2. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – gopkg.in/yaml.v3

firefox-addons:2998553.name: Privacy Thing (Preview)
firefox-addons:2998553.summary: See what a site checks and decide which browser data it receives — with separate rules for every website and Firefox container.
firefox-addons:2998553.description:
See more. Share less. 
Websites can learn far more about your browser than what you type into a form. They may read your geolocation, language, time zone, screen size, hardware characteristics, and other details about your environment. Even graphics information exposed through WebGL can become part of a recognizable browser fingerprint.
 Privacy Thing gives you practical control over this layer of privacy. It shows which browser information and features the page open in your browser accesses, then lets you decide which selected information it can see — separately for every website.
In Firefox, rules can also be assigned to containers. The same domain can therefore use a different profile depending on the context in which you open it.
 TL;DR 
 Privacy Thing lets you control the information your browser shares with websites and web apps.
 See which information a site used and how many times. 
 Create multiple sets of rules separately for every website and Firefox container.
 Create multiple location setups based on geographic position, available languages, and regional preferences. Privacy Thing includes a full-featured GPS-location spoofer with a realistic location-simulation model.
 Privacy Thing is built to provide as much functionality as possible without connecting to external services. Your settings remain yours.
 What Privacy Thing gives you 
 Reduce selected parts of your “digital fingerprint” — depending on the browser and configuration, Privacy Thing can control or modify selected information related to the browser, screen, and hardware, as well as canvas, WebGL, audio, WebRTC, frames, and workers. This includes some data that may reveal characteristics of the graphics hardware. Privacy Thing gives you a concrete set of tools for limiting and organizing information that falls within the extension’s reach.
 See what a site checks — X-Ray shows whether a site has accessed geolocation, language, screen data, canvas, WebGL, audio, WebRTC, or selected worker mechanisms. You can also see which profile was applied and whether any supported category encountered a problem. It is not a complete record of everything a website does. It is a practical view of the browser areas Privacy Thing can recognize and control.
 Set your own rules for every website — create profiles and assign them to domains or domain patterns. Use a default rule, add exceptions for particular websites, and temporarily switch Privacy Thing off without deleting your configuration. You can also use the extension only on selected websites — Privacy Thing does not restrict you to one operating model.
 Keep settings separate across Firefox Containers — assign different profiles to the same website depending on its container. This is a convenient way to keep work contexts, accounts, and use cases separate.
 Build coherent regional profiles — combine coordinates, geolocation accuracy and coordinate-variation radius, a primary language, a language list, and a time zone. The first-run wizard lets you quickly choose ready-made regional presets, while your own profiles remain freely editable. The Refract engine can align the Geolocation API, navigator.language , navigator.languages , Date , Intl , and Accept-Language . A site does not have to see a random mixture of a location from one country, a language from another, and a time zone from somewhere else.
 Use realistic data without unnecessary network requests — every Privacy Thing release includes compact local data catalogs built from processed public datasets. Using these catalogs, the extension can independently choose statistically plausible hardware profiles with suitable screen resolutions, CPU-core counts, and available-memory values without making additional requests. Privacy Thing can also rotate the browser version visible to a website. The extension additionally includes catalogs of browser-supported language codes and official languages. These datasets ship with the extension and are refreshed periodically through updates. Privacy Thing does not need to query their sources during normal profile use. A time zone can also be determined locally from coordinates.
 Clear data for a selected website — Privacy Thing can clear data for the current domain, including cookies, localStorage , sessionStorage , IndexedDB , Cache Storage , and service workers. This is useful both for privacy and for testing a website from a clean state. Once the operation finishes, the profile receives an entirely different set of parameters, which should make it significantly harder for the site to track activity.
 Your data. Your call. 
Profiles, rules, and settings stay locally in your browser. Core features require no Privacy Thing account or backend. The extension does not collect its own telemetry and does not sell data.
Ready-made presets, bundled catalogs, and manually entered coordinates work without map-service requests. Place search and map previews use OpenStreetMap Nominatim and OpenFreeMap only after you choose to enable them.
 Privacy works in layers 
Privacy Thing works at the browser layer. It does not change your public IP address, route or encrypt traffic, or replace a VPN, proxy, or Smart DNS service.
Those tools can complement one another: network tools affect the connection or name-resolution layer, while Privacy Thing controls selected information exposed through browser APIs.
Privacy Thing does not guarantee anonymity or undetectability. Websites may also use IP addresses, account data, sessions, and other information beyond the extension’s control. X-Ray reports activity only in supported areas — it is not a complete audit of everything a website does.

firefox-addons:2835988.name: Secure access to Discord with privacy
firefox-addons:2835988.summary: Secure anonymous access for Discord free communications app that lets you chat with friends and game communities.
firefox-addons:2835988.description:
Cordfy is an extension that provides a secure and anonymous access to Discord. Our application aims to offer users a safe and private way to connect with others on the popular communication platform. Below, you will find a comprehensive overview of our features and the benefits they bring to our users. Users can connect to the platform without revealing any personal information from their PC, ensuring their privacy and security online. Cordfy offers a seamless user experience while protecting their data and identity.
Key Features:
1. Secure and Anonymous Access: Cordfy allows users to create an account without providing any personal information. Their identity remains protected while using the application.
2. End-to-End Encryption: All messages and calls on Cordfy are encrypted to prevent unauthorized access to user conversations.
3. Anti-Tracking: Cordfy blocks tracking technologies to maintain user privacy and prevent third-party data collection.
4. IP Masking: Users’ IP addresses are masked to ensure anonymity while using the application.
5. Access to Discord Features: Users can enjoy all the features that Discord provides, including voice and video calls, text messaging, and community forums.
Overall, our application aims to provide users with a secure and anonymous way to access Discord, enabling them to connect with others without compromising their privacy. We are committed to delivering a safe and reliable platform for communication and community building.
Remember that Discord is a free communications app that lets you share voice, video, and text chat with friends, game communities, and developers. It has hundreds of millions of users, making it one of the most popular ways to connect with people online. Anyone can create a Discord server for free for any number of reasons. You can use it to gather friends together in a group text just generally. Use it to post gifs, share memes and screenshots, or talk about your day. You can stream your game to your friends and publishers often use Discord as a place to share gaming goodies with their communities. You can see concept art, new screenshots, and even be given access to a game on Discord.
A new Discord server will start with a General channel, but admins can create multiple channels for specific reasons. These could include server Announcements and Rules, or specific game-related chats, such as a Fortnite channel. It’s up to the admin and the server users to define. Game Streaming in Discord
You can stream your screen to your Discord pals and community. This isn’t like Twitch, YouTube, or Facebook, where it’s meant to be a public show. It’s more of an advanced version of video chat. You can do it in direct message via the home screen or within a public voice chat on the server. It’s entirely confined to the server and to the channel to which you started to stream. You can use it to share your progress in a game with friends, or to show off some loot, or to ask for assistance. You’re even capable of streaming other screens, such as a paint program. Though you can stream a screen alongside your video stream, you can’t combine the screens to overlay you playing picture-in-picture. firefox-addons:3011420.name: InfraLens - Security & Inspector
firefox-addons:3011420.summary: InfraLens is a lightweight Firefox security and infrastructure analysis extension that helps inspect HTTP headers, HTTPS security, CSP weaknesses, cookies, redirects, CDN, CMS, TLS, mixed content, and website security posture in real time.
firefox-addons:3011420.description:
InfraLens is a powerful read-only Firefox extension designed for cybersecurity professionals, infrastructure engineers, system administrators, developers, SOC analysts, bug bounty hunters, and privacy-focused users who want to inspect the security posture and infrastructure details of websites directly from the browser.
The extension performs fast real-time analysis of the current webpage without modifying page content, injecting ads, or tracking users.
Key Features:
✔ HTTPS and HTTP Security Status
Instantly identify whether a website uses secure HTTPS connections and review protocol security posture.
✔ Security Header Analysis
Inspect important HTTP security headers including:
• Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
• Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
• X-Frame-Options
• X-Content-Type-Options
• Referrer-Policy
• Permissions-Policy
• COOP / COEP / CORP
✔ CSP Weakness Detection
Detect common Content Security Policy weaknesses such as:
• unsafe-inline
• unsafe-eval
• wildcard sources
• missing default-src directives
✔ Mixed Content Detection
Identify both active and passive mixed content issues that can weaken browser security.
✔ Redirect Chain Analysis
View main-frame redirect chains to analyze request flows and security behavior.
✔ Cookie Security Inspection
Review cookie security attributes when exposed by the browser:
• Secure
• HttpOnly
• SameSite
✔ DNS and Infrastructure Insights
Retrieve DNS-based IP information using Firefox DNS APIs and identify:
• CDN providers
• CMS technologies
• Runtime/language indicators
• TLS certificate issuer
• Application version hints
• Themes
• Analytics and tracking platforms
✔ Performance and Response Metrics
Measure page response timing using browser request timestamps.
✔ Security Scoring System
Generate an overall security score and grade for the current webpage.
✔ Export and Reporting
Export analysis results as:
• TXT reports
• JSON reports
✔ Quick Security Tools
Open the current website directly in:
• SecurityHeaders
• SSL Labs
• VirusTotal
• Sucuri SiteCheck
✔ Quick Browser Actions
• Copy cURL command
• Reload current tab
• Hard reload with cache bypass
✔ Privacy Focused Design
InfraLens is designed with a security-first and privacy-focused approach:
• Read-only extension
• No telemetry
• No ads
• No tracking
• No backend server dependency
• No page modification
✔ Lightweight and Fast
Designed for minimal overhead while providing valuable infrastructure and security insights directly inside Firefox.
Ideal For:
• Cybersecurity Researchers
• SOC Analysts
• Penetration Testers
• Infrastructure Administrators
• DevOps Engineers
• Web Developers
• Privacy Enthusiasts
• Security Auditors
• Bug Bounty Hunters
Permissions Usage:
InfraLens uses browser webRequest and related permissions only to inspect response headers and request metadata of the currently visited page for security analysis purposes.
No user browsing data is sold, tracked, or transmitted externally.
Developed by NB InfoTech.

firefox-addons:2972834.name: LockMyTab – Secure PIN Lock for Tabs
firefox-addons:2972834.summary: Protect your privacy by locking individual browser tabs with a secure 4-digit PIN. Secure, fast, and easy to use.
firefox-addons:2972834.description:
Protect your privacy and secure sensitive information with LockMyTab, the ultimate PIN-protected browser extension for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. 
Designed for professionals, students, and privacy-conscious users, LockMyTab allows you to lock individual browser tabs behind a secure 4-digit PIN, ensuring your data remains hidden from prying eyes, even when you share your device.
Key Features:
- Secure 4-Digit PIN: Instantly lock any tab with a simple numeric code.
- Automatic Auto-Lock: Set an idle timer to automatically re-lock protected tabs when you step away.
- Full Content Masking: Prevents viewing, copying, or interacting with tab content using a high-fidelity blur screen.
- Selective Security: Lock only the tabs you need. Protect specific websites without affecting the rest of your browsing speed.
- Quick Shortcut: Use Alt+L to lock your current tab in an instant.
- Recovery Keys: Never get locked out! We provide 3 secure recovery pins during setup.
- Minimalist & High-End Interface: A distraction-free, glassmorphism-inspired lock screen that integrates seamlessly with your workflow.
Why Choose LockMyTab?
Whether you are handling confidential client data, managing personal bank accounts, or simply want to keep your social media private, LockMyTab provides that essential extra layer of security. It’s perfect for open-plan offices, shared home computers, or anyone who values digital privacy.
How to use:
1. Click the LockMyTab icon or press Alt+L on any tab you want to secure.
2. Enter your custom PIN to unlock and access the content.
3. Manage your PIN and Auto-Lock settings easily from the Options page.

firefox-addons:3106853.name: WebTool Inspector
firefox-addons:3106853.summary: Inspect any site: detected technologies & versions, IP/ASN/geo, WHOIS/RDAP, DNS, TLS certificate and HTTP security headers — in one Firefox popup.
firefox-addons:3106853.description:
WebTool Inspector is a Firefox toolkit for everyday web investigation and development.
Open the toolbar button on any http(s) page to get:

bluejetty:00087647:ios.summary:

mypensionID is designed to put you back in control of your data, you decide which pension schem
bluejetty:00087647:ios.description:
mypensionID also allows you to update your address in one place for all of your pensions shown in your dashboard, whether at home or on the go.
mypensionID is designed to put you back in control of your data, you decide which pension scheme to update and with what data.
Using innovative and proven mobile technology and biometrics, mypensionID offers a secure and convenient way for you to keep your pension scheme data up to date, ensuring you never lose touch with your pension pots and control the information you receive.
Your Data, Your Rules.
HOW TO REGISTER
If you have received an invitation letter from mypensionID, all you need to do is follow the onscreen instructions to onboard with mypensionID.
You’ll need the 12-digit Unique Security code from the letter/email and you’ll need to verify your identity with a selfie and a valid government issued photo identity document (passport, driving licence or national ID card).
THE BENEFITS
• Log in quickly and securely
• Instant verification - no interruption to your pension payments
• Saving you time and hassle - No need to send documents through the post
• Update your details as they change
• Call us straight from the app to speak to an adviser or use live chat function
• Update all pension schemes that you belong to (providing they are registered with mypensionID).
The average person has 9 jobs in their working life. Updating pension providers with new address details can be a cumbersome process, or one that is treated as low priority, and often leads to individuals losing track of their benefits.
When it’s hard to find a moment for those small but important jobs, mypensionID is here to help. It’s fast, convenient, secure, with built-in security technology to keep your details safe and private.
KEEPING YOU SAFE ONLINE
We use the latest online security measures to protect your personal information and your privacy. This includes preventing connections from the app on devices that we think have been tampered with.
Your unique biometric details are converted into a non-identifiable biometric key that can only be matched to you.
Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
Terms & conditions
We don't charge you for using mypensionID, but your mobile operator may charge for internet services, please check with them. Services may be affected by phone signal and
functionality. Terms and conditions apply.
Please note: Our Mobile app is supported by devices running iOS.
Please note: Our Mobile app is supported by devices running iOS. If your phone has been subjected to unauthorised modifications (e.g. jailbroken or rooted) the app will not be compatible with your device.
When you use this app we collect anonymous location data to help combat fraud, fix bugs and improve future services.

bluejetty:00156522:ios.summary: Introducing Neighbors Trailer! Our peer-to-peer trailer rental platform is a hyper-convenient solution to turn your underutilized trailer into a profitable asset. Renting out your trailer while you’re not using it is a great way to earn som
bluejetty:00156522:ios.description:
Introducing Neighbors Trailer! Our peer-to-peer trailer rental platform is a hyper-convenient solution to turn your underutilized trailer into a profitable asset. Renting out your trailer while you’re not using it is a great way to earn some extra cash and take advantage of demand without having to spend large amounts of valuable time and money. Through the Neighbors Trailer owner app, you have complete access to a multitude of resources and features to fully complete any process while offering trailer rentals to your local community. 
Neighbors Trailer is the best place to help those around you, earn money doing it, and make meaningful connections backed by a support team of real people to help you grow your business.
Why list your trailer through Neighbors Trailer? 
FULLY EQUIPPED
Access tools to control every aspect of your account, trailers, and bookings from the tip of your fingers. Enjoy the flexibility and convenience of accessing the platform anywhere at any time!
-Create and manage trailer listings 
-Manage bookings and extensions 
-Connect with renters 
-Coordinate pick-ups and deliveries 
-Track your rentals and profits 
-Secure online payments 
-Access to GPS tracking software
SET YOUR REQUIREMENTS
-List an unlimited number of trailers for free 
-Create your own competitive prices 
-Define rental requirements 
-Choose to participate in delivery 
-Create add-ons to rent out accessories 
-Enhance your listing with a detailed description to showcase capabilities and features
RENTAL PROTECTION
Rent with confidence with the NT Protect™ Protection Package. As a Neighbors Trailer exclusive, NT Protect™ provides broad coverage designed to give both renters and trailer owners peace of mind on every booking.
For just a few dollars per day, you can protect your rental with coverage of up to $25,000 per covered incident — all under one simple plan.
-Coverage for accidental damage during your rental
-Available in all 50 U.S. states and Canada
-All trailer types eligible
-Renters 21+ eligible (no commercial license needed)
STAY CONNECTED
Sign up to gain exclusive access to an abundance of useful features and resources. Join our newsletter to receive updates and stay in the loop. Follow us on Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X (Formerly Twitter) @Neighborstrailer. 
SUPPORT
Need Help? Get in touch with us at service@neighborstrailer.com or call us at 650-597-7200 to speak with an agent.

bluejetty:00073288:ios.description:
Welcome to Manta – Your Ultimate Manga, Webcomics and Webnovels Destination!
Manga is now available on Manta—explore a growing library of official manga, comics, and novels all in one place.
Immerse yourself in the captivating universes of Manta, where a diverse collection of stories unfolds across manhwa, webtoons, webcomics, manga, manhua, and webnovels. Whether you’re captivated by romance, thrilled by action, enchanted by fantasy, chilled by horror, intrigued by BL (yaoi), or swept away by romantasy, our extensive library offers stories that cater to every taste. With Manta, experience immersive storytelling, stunning artwork, and boundless creativity—right at your fingertips.
With Free Pass, you can read one free episode every 24 hours — available on select titles only.
No need to pay — just wait and enjoy your favorite stories, day by day.
Free Pass titles include both Gem‑Only and Subscription series.
Discover Your Next Favorite Story
- Try our hit series Under the Oak Tree, a fan-favorite loved by millions worldwide.
- Romance fan? We’re your go-to for epic love tales, featuring exclusives like Tempest Night, Predatory Marriage, Betrayal of Dignity, High Society, The Beast Within, A Wicked Husband, Savor the Taste, Prison Love, and more.
- Searching for BL? We’re the perfect choice with popular BL titles like Semantic Error, Love Jinx, No Love Zone, The New Recruit, The Dangerous Convenience Store, Punch Drunk Love, Circuit Breaker, and many more!
- Craving more after the webtoons? Discover original novels that delve deeper into each world, revealing new layers of the characters and their stories.
Explore Manta subscription to access the Unlimited Library with exclusive stories, or unlock individual episodes from our full library to match your reading mood.
For more, please visit:
Website: [http://www.manta.net](http://www.manta.net/)
Instagram: http://instagram.com/mantacomics
Twitter: http://twitter.com/mantacomics
Privacy Policy: https://mantasupport.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056564334-Privacy-Policy

bluejetty:00114451:ios.summary: In this chilling horror experience, players find themselves trapped inside a twisted, dimly lit Shrek environment where every room hides a new threat. What first appears to be a simple exploration quickly becomes a nightmarish struggle for
bluejetty:00114451:ios.description:
In this chilling horror experience, players find themselves trapped inside a twisted, dimly lit Shrek environment where every room hides a new threat. What first appears to be a simple exploration quickly becomes a nightmarish struggle for survival, as a horrifying, distorted version of Shrek roams the shadows, hunting anyone who dares to move. His presence is felt long before he appears the distant thud of footsteps, the flicker of failing lights, the unsettling silence that fills each hallway. 
Players must search, hide, and navigate through dark corridors and unsettling spaces, using quick thinking and sharp instincts to stay one step ahead of the creature. Every turn holds uncertainty, and every sound could signal imminent danger. The tension never fades as the world shifts around you, pushing you deeper into fear. With its claustrophobic atmosphere, eerie ambient noises, and relentless stalker lurking in the fog, this game delivers a pulse-pounding experience where survival depends on how long you can keep your fear under control.

bluejetty:00170566:ios.name: ASolver>I'll solve your puzzle
bluejetty:00170566:ios.summary:
Take a photo of your Magic Cube with the camera and see how to solve the puzzle.
The 100 patterns on the Magic Cube will not leave you indifferent.
Incredible Feature! Some puzzles have been broken - disassembled and reassembled incorrect
bluejetty:00170566:ios.description:
Take a photo of your Magic Cube with the camera and see how to solve the puzzle.
The 100 patterns on the Magic Cube will not leave you indifferent.
Incredible Feature! Some puzzles have been broken - disassembled and reassembled incorrectly. Such puzzles are impossible to solve. ASolver knows how to solve and fix such a puzzle.
The app uses the camera to recognize and solve puzzles:
 - 3x3x3 Magic Cube (Speed Cube, Puzzle Cube)
 - 2x2x2 Pocket Cube (Mini Cube)
 - 4x4x4 Rubik's Revenge (Master Cube)
 - 5x5x5 Professor's Cube
 - 6x6x6 V-Cube 6
 - Pyraminx (Meffet's Pyramid)
 - Megaminx
 - Void Cube
 - Skewb
 - 1x2x3 Puzzle 123
 - 2x3x3 Domino
 - Ivy Cube
 - Kilominx without centers
 - Kilominx with centers 
 - Dino Cube
 - 2x2x3 Tower
new puzzles will be ready soon.
Scan the puzzle with your camera and ASolver will walk you through the steps to solve it in minutes!
You can solve the puzzle by looking at the interactive model. Or see a list of moves that solve the puzzle.
The camera is not always able to recognize the puzzle, for example in poor lighting or due to glare. This is not a problem - the puzzle can easily be entered in manual mode.
For simple puzzles (2x2x2, 2x2x3, 2x3x3, 1x2x3, Skewb, Ivy, Pyraminx, Dino) ASolver finds the optimal solution with the minimum possible number of moves.
The solution of the 3x3x3 Magic Cube and the 3x3x3 Void Cube is very close to optimal. For a well tangled puzzle, that's about 19 moves.
For 4x4x4, 5x5x5, Kilominx with and without centers, and Megaminx the optimal solution is unknown, so nobody knows :)
A well-tangled:
 - 4x4x4 on average is solved in 48 moves
 - 5x5x5 in 83 moves
 - Kilominx with centers in 35 moves
 - Kilominx without centers in 33 moves.
ASolver is the solution to any puzzle.
Terms of use https://bnice.xyz/asolver/terms.html

bluejetty:00179306:ios.description:
Make your everyday phone life cuter with Fontsy.
Discover cute fonts, aesthetic wallpapers, clock widgets, app icons, and keyboard themes—all in one app. Create stylish text for your social media profiles and messages, then give your Home Screen a look you love.
CUTE FONTS & STYLISH TEXT
Turn ordinary words into expressive text. Explore cursive, bold, outlined, and decorative styles for your bios, captions, comments, and messages.
• Type your text and preview different styles.
• Copy your favorite look with a tap.
• Paste it into Instagram, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, and other apps.
• Save favorites and revisit your copy history.
• Edit saved text and copy it again whenever you need it.
AESTHETIC WALLPAPERS
Find a background that matches your mood. Choose soft pink, dreamy blue, warm vanilla, lavender, or mint, with designs ranging from gentle gradients and little hearts to large hearts, fluffy clouds, and photo wallpapers.
Preview your favorites and save them to Photos to personalize your Lock Screen or Home Screen.
CUTE CLOCK WIDGETS
Bring your favorite colors to your Home Screen with matching clock and date widgets.
• Choose small or medium widgets.
• Mix colors with hearts, clouds, and soft backgrounds.
• Coordinate your widget with your wallpaper and app icons.
MATCHING APP ICONS
Create a coordinated Home Screen with themed icon designs. Pick a color and pattern, save individual icons or an icon pack, and follow the included guide to add them through Apple’s Shortcuts app.
KEYBOARD THEMES
Make everyday typing more colorful with a keyboard that matches your style. Explore soft color themes and decorative text styles, with an in-app preview and setup guide to help you get started.
SYMBOLS & TEXT ART
Add personality to your messages with decorative symbols and ASCII art. Find a finishing touch for your profile, caption, or conversation.
YOUR COLORS, YOUR STYLE
Go all pink, keep it soft and simple, or mix your favorite designs. Explore matching looks across wallpapers, widgets, icons, and keyboards, and customize each one at your own pace.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Decorative text may display differently depending on the app, device, or character.
• Custom app icons are added individually using Apple’s Shortcuts app.

bluejetty:00184602:ios.description:
Nice to meet you, we’re Tubi. We’re more than a completely fee-free streamer with the largest library in the entire streaming universe. We’re entertainment fiends and collectors, and never judgers. So, get comfy and settle into whatever you’re feeling. It’s about to get good.
WATCH WITH ZERO FEES EVER (YES, REALLY!):
Live TV: news, weather, sports, & entertainment
It’s live, always on, forever fee-free and has way fewer ads than cable. We call that a win-win-win-win. 
+ Check your local news channels for weather and news.
+ Get game day ready with pre-game excitement.
+ Unwind with your favorite TV competitions and guilty pleasures.
Movies
From the biggest names in the industry to the indie darlings we can’t get enough of.
+ Top titles added every month.
+ Bask in loads of drama that isn’t your own.
+ Comedy, action, and horror…oh, my! Whatever genre you’re looking for, we have it.
Series
Marathon all the best series, all in one place, with zero subscriptions ever.
+ Refine your taste buds with cooking shows and competitions.
+ Get lost in the drama of an evening soap.
+ Decompress with laugh-out-loud sitcoms.
Tubi Originals
Made by us, just for you. And only available on Tubi.
+ Critically acclaimed series like Boarders and Big Mood.
+ Live out your fantasies with all-new reality shows, series, and movies.
Tubi Comic Con(tent)
It's a bird, it's a plane, it's...all your favorite comic book heroes and caped crusaders!
+ Binge full series, old school and new.
+ Stay current with the latest Hollywood releases.
Tubi Español
Tú perteneces aquí. Watch in Spanish with no subtitles necessary.
+ Keep up with all your telenovelas.
+ Stream Spanish-first favorites and discover dubbed blockbusters.
International Entertainment
+ Ikuze! We have all the anime!
+ Korea’s in the house!! Get your fill of K-pop, horror, action, comedy, and drama.
+ Live the Bollywood dream and dance along with tons of favorites.
MORE PERKS
+ Swipe your way to discovering new content.
+ Never run out of stuff to watch. We add new arrivals every week.
+ Not sure what to watch? Tap the dice icon in the corner to do the Tubi Shuffle and get a randomized pick!
+ Here, there, everywhere. Tubi works on 30+ devices, so it goes wherever you go.
+ We’ll never ask for your credit card, ever. You’ll pay zero fees forever. For really.
+ Create an account to build your own watchlist, save your watch progress, and get better recommendations.
See You In There™

bluejetty:00093640:ios.summary: Especializada na administração e gestão patrimonial de empreendimentos logísticos, comerciais e residenciais, a SEVEN oferece as melhores e mais inovadoras soluções, sempre comprometidos com nossos valores e proporcionando um serviço de exc
bluejetty:00093640:ios.description:
Especializada na administração e gestão patrimonial de empreendimentos logísticos, comerciais e residenciais, a SEVEN oferece as melhores e mais inovadoras soluções, sempre comprometidos com nossos valores e proporcionando um serviço de excelência, ética e transparência.
Tanto pelo site da SEVEN quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo a qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real. Com a SEVEN, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente!
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade.
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas
- acesso ao regimento interno e demais documentos do condomínio
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes
- autorização da entrada de visitantes
- acesso às câmeras de segurança
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para seven@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00015860:ios.summary: Music theory can be empowering, exciting, and one of the biggest tools in your creative arsenal. Whether you already play an instrument or are just learning, Waay teaches you how to bring together notes into melodies, chords, progressions,
bluejetty:00015860:ios.description:
Music theory can be empowering, exciting, and one of the biggest tools in your creative arsenal. Whether you already play an instrument or are just learning, Waay teaches you how to bring together notes into melodies, chords, progressions, and even songs. This is applied music theory—stuff you can take straight to your instrument and use. 
--
“Best music theory learning app out there. I just want to say this app is completely amazing and an incredible amount of work must have gone into this. I have been looking for an app just like this to complete my learning between music classes and this has everything I need and more. I highly recommend!” —BigMat74, Oct. 20, 2023
"Absolutely phenomenal. This is better than any YouTube video, podcast, or music theory book I have read. Within 48 hours using this app I have actually comprehended what is being taught far beyond any previous comprehension for past products. Honestly they could charge more than double the amount and it would be totally worth it." —Artice, May 3, 2022
"It's obvious a lot of time, love and energy has gone into this app. It's very well thought out, easy to follow and keeps you coming back for more. The developer is super friendly and answers any questions you have. It's clear he has a real passion for what he does and genuinely wants to help out. Awesome work all round" —thatboyswiss, Jan. 8, 2019
"I have probably spent thousands of dollars perfecting tone on pedals, instruments, amps and apps, posters, printed media, online courses. The BEST PURCHASE has been your Waay app." —A.P., Apr. 1, 2020
--
You're writing a song, but keep getting stuck. What chords sound good together? What melody fits those chords? Waay helps you master these skills with its interactive exercises, bite-sized video lessons, musical examples, and progress-tracking tools. The Practice Space recommends a great time to practice each of your new skills too. Plus there's no Internet connection required! Perfect for your subway commutes and plane adventures. 
Here’s what you’ll learn in each course:
Course 1: Melodies
• 8 video lessons, 11 interactive exercises
• The 12 notes in music and how we talk about them
• Intervals: Steps, half-steps, and moving between notes
• Keys: Learn what notes sound good together and hear audio examples 
• Scale building: Build major and minor scales from scratch
• Songwriting: How do we apply theory to write music?
• Circle of fifths: The super-fast way to build scales… and more
Course 2: Chords
• 8 video lessons, 12 interactive exercises
• Thirds and fifths: The building blocks of chords
• Build major, minor, and diminished chords
• Songwriting: We write a song melody-first and then add just the right chords
• Magic formula: Which chords actually sound good together?
Also included:
• Relative majors & Fast minor scales
Courses 3 & 4: Progressions
• 10 video lessons, 30 interactive exercises
• The fundamental relationship between keys and chords
• Identify the key of a chord progression with six speedy tricks
• Shortlisting: Find chords to fit your chord progressions
• Musical judgement: Decide which chords *you* like best in your progressions
• ii V: Why is the ii V progression so important anyways?
• Choosing accidentals: Is it a sharp or flat? Learn that here
Courses 5 & 6: Intervals
• 10 video lessons, 20 interactive exercises
• Learn the complete set of intervals, from unison to 14th
• Inversions: How to flip intervals upside-down—and why you'd want to
• Enharmonics: Different names for the same note
• Compound intervals: Intervals bigger than an octave!
• Transposition: How to move songs to different keys
• Augmented chords and intervals
The Practice Space, first seven videos/exercises, and device syncing all come free. Access all content through a one-time purchase or subscription. Get in touch at tenkettles.com/contact if you have any questions—happy to help! -Alex

bluejetty:00096169:ios.description:
WHAT IS MOMO
Momo is your magical self-care pet — a tiny, ancient spirit that helps you sleep better, practice gratitude, build habits, and stay motivated through gentle guidance and playful rewards.
SO, IS IT JUST A HABIT TRACKER?
Not exactly. Momo isn’t a boring checklist or another wellness app. It’s a gamified self-care companion that turns your daily habits — from sleep and gratitude to small wins like brushing your teeth — into joyful quests with real rewards.
WHY TURN SELF-CARE INTO A GAME?
Because real life is overwhelming. Research shows that tracking habits, practicing gratitude, and getting consistent sleep improves well-being — but most apps make it feel like homework. Momo makes it feel fun, like getting encouraged by a little ancient creature who’s rooting for you.
HOW DOES MOMO WORK?
Each day, Momo nudges you to:
Track your sleep by placing your phone on your bed
Complete one simple gratitude prompt
Pick a few small habits to complete (or create your own)
Earn Momo Coins to dress up your creature and decorate their world
WHO IS MOMO FOR?
Students buried in stress
People with ADHD or low motivation
Anyone who needs a little nudge (and a lot of cuteness)
Try Momo AI for free and see what changes when you stop going it alone.
Terms of Service: https://momoselfcare.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://momoselfcare.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00198391:android.description:
Welcome to the heart of winter's charm with our Christmas Fireplace Live Wallpaper. This app transforms your smartphone into a haven of cozy warmth, offering a real fireplace experience complete with the soothing sounds of burning logs and festive melodies. Ideal for the Christmas and New Year festivities, it's your personal retreat into a world of tranquil flames and holiday spirit.
Key Features:
Animated Fireplace Wallpapers: Choose from three beautifully crafted live wallpapers featuring animated fires and twinkling Christmas tree lights. Customize your festive view by enabling or disabling the tree lights.
Seasonal Soundscapes: Accompany the visual warmth with your choice of sound. Select from a variety of sweet, classic Christmas melodies or the authentic sound of crackling wood, creating the perfect backdrop for your holiday relaxation.
Personal Touch: Elevate your live wallpaper by adding your own photo. Watch as it comes to life with a gentle, animated snowfall effect, set against your choice of Christmas music.
Customizable Settings: Tailor your festive experience by adjusting the sounds, selecting your favorite melody, and controlling the tree light animations. 
Immerse yourself in the sheer bliss of a real fire in your living room. Enjoy the full ambiance of a crackling wood fire and the gentle glow of Christmas lights. This Christmas Live Wallpaper offers a romantic, heartwarming atmosphere, perfect for enjoying the closeness with your family and friends.
Embrace the love and warmth of the holiday season. Let the Christmas Fireplace Live Wallpaper bring a touch of magic to your daily life, filling your home with joy, warmth, and the spirit of Christmas. Make this holiday season your most memorable yet. Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year to all!

bluejetty:00159783:ios.description:
The simplest way to enjoy radio on your device. Our app consolidates numerous radio stations into one easy-to-use application. Discover local stations nearby.
* A VAST ARRAY OF RADIO STATIONS - Enjoy live streams from local radio, including news, music, talk shows, sports, and more. We continually add new stations.
* AS SIMPLE AS CAR RADIO - Easily set up your favorite stations and access them instantly each time you open the app.
* FAST STATION SWITCHING - Swipe and press play to switch stations effortlessly.
* EASY FAVORITE SELECTION - Allow the app to access your location or input your postcode to see local stations first. Add to your favorites by tapping the heart icon. You can then swipe through your favorites or explore all available stations.
* TRACK RECENTLY PLAYED MUSIC - View the tracks recently played on your top music stations.
* GREATER CONTROL - Manage the app and switch stations from your iPhone’s lock screen, using Casting, or through a Bluetooth speaker.
* INTEGRATE WITH STATION APPS – For more content from your preferred stations, access their specific apps directly through our app.
* EFFICIENT DATA USAGE - Our app consumes less data than using social media or video streaming platforms.
Why is sign-in required? Signing in allows you to save your favorite stations and helps us understand app usage. This information aids in improving the app and enhancing station programming. We do not sell your data. Thanks!
Enjoy your radio, wherever you may be.

bluejetty:00119363:ios.description:
Bring your desk phone with you wherever you go with the Mitel Connect mobile app. Easily access your enterprise contacts, join conferences with one click, and manage your calls and voicemails - all powered by our new user-friendly design.
Key benefits: 
- New dashboard to manage your work day
- Contact your colleagues without using carrier minutes
- View upcoming events and join meetings in one click
- No more giving out your personal number - your business caller ID is used when placing calls 
- Reach coworkers quickly via favorites or extensions
- Visually manage your voicemails 
- Manage your missed calls and view recent activities from your dashboard
- Handover between WiFi and cellular and never lose a call 
- And more!
For more information go to:
https://oneview.mitel.com/s/article/Mitel-Connect-for-iOS
Note: This app is for Mitel Connect, Mitel 14.2 and Mitel Sky customers only. 
Warning: VoIP over 3G/4G/LTE networks
Miltel is not liable for any charges, fees or liability imposed by your mobile carrier for the use of this service. Voice quality is subject to Wi-Fi or 3G/4G/LTE signal quality and available bandwidth.
IMPORTANT
• This application requires connectivity to a Mitel Connect Mobility Router and will not operate without this component. Please contact your business ‘IT department if you are unsure if your company has deployed the Mitel Connect Mobility solution. 
• This application is intended only for enterprise calling. As such, emergency calls (e.g. 911) will be routed over the cellular radio when available and not over WiFi.
•By downloading and using this application you hereby agree to the terms in the accompanying End User License Agreement (EULA).

bluejetty:00144522:ios.summary:
Já pensou em receber os seus ganhos de viagens e entregas na hora?
Com a Uber Conta você tem uma conta digital parceira em que você pode fazer transações em diversos estabelecimentos físicos e virtuais utilizando o Cartão Uber, sacar em cai
bluejetty:00144522:ios.description:
Já pensou em receber os seus ganhos de viagens e entregas na hora?
Com a Uber Conta você tem uma conta digital parceira em que você pode fazer transações em diversos estabelecimentos físicos e virtuais utilizando o Cartão Uber, sacar em caixas eletrônicos da rede Banco24Horas com QR Code, pagar boletos com tranquilidade pelo celular e fazer transferências instantâneas sem restrições de dia e hora para qualquer banco.
São diversos motivos para você abrir a sua: 
CASHBACK
Faça compras com seu Cartão Uber nas lojas parceiras dentro do app, você aproveita cupons de desconto ou pode receber parte do dinheiro de volta com resgate direto no seu saldo. Quanto melhor for seu nível no Uber Pro, maior será sua porcentagem em dinheiro de volta.
PAGAMENTOS
Pague suas contas de consumo, como água, luz, telefones e boletos* com seu saldo. Organize sua vida financeira e faça seus pagamentos pelo próprio aplicativo, sem precisar sair de casa.
Realize pagamentos de compras na função compras à vista com a leitura de QR Code em maquininhas da Cielo. É rápido, fácil e você só precisa do celular.
 TRANSFERÊNCIAS TED E PIX
Você pode realizar transferências* entre Uber Contas ou para outros bancos. Pelo Ted você pode efetuar a operação na hora ou, se preferir, por meio de agendamento.
Entre Uber Contas as transferências são creditadas no mesmo instante, 24 horas por dia, sete dias por semana.
*Fique atento aos limites permitidos no seu app.
Com o Pix você pode fazer e receber pagamentos e transferências quando quiser, inclusive aos sábados, domingos e feriados gratuitamente. É só cadastrar uma chave Pix para começar a receber.
SAQUES
 Saque* valores sem cartão usando apenas com seu app!
No aplicativo, toque em “Sacar”, para selecionar o valor que deseja retirar. Depois, vá a um caixa eletrônico da rede Banco24Horas e selecione a opção “Saque digital”.
O caixa eletrônico irá gerar um QR Code que você deve escanear por meio da câmera do aplicativo. Para realizar a operação é importante que o aplicativo esteja autorizado a acessar a câmera do seu celular e sua localização.
*Consulte limites permitidos no seu aplicativo.

bluejetty:00131619:ios.description:
Why did the athlete sit on the sideline and sketch pictures? Because they love to draw a long jump! Athletics Championship is a 3D sports game where you can become a track and field star. Compete with athletes worldwide and manage your sports career to victory.
As you tie your virtual spikes, prepare to join an elite group of athletes on a world stage that demands speed, strength, and strategy. 
Global Competition Awaits!
As the heart and soul of your own athletic persona, you'll challenge players globally and battle for trophies in the ultimate sports game. From sprinting to throwing, your virtual athletic prowess will crown champions.
Tailor Your Athlete 
Craft the perfect competitor! Customize your avatar's look, outfit them with the finest gear, and select trainers who will propel them to triumph. It's all about personal flare and functionality.
Create Your Community 
Form teams to construct a robust community and partake in thrilling tournaments. Your decisions shape your team's legacy as you climb the ranks to become a sports legend.
Daily Rewards Progression
Embrace daily challenges and reap bountiful rewards. Every arena offers new trials; every victory sharpens your skills. 
Training for Excellence
Develop a top-notch training center, level up your athlete and equip them with all they require to conquer twenty different track and field events.
Is your competitive spirit ready for an adrenaline rush? Will you seize the top spot on the global leaderboard? Do you have what it takes to command the track and become an athletics champion? Lace up, get set, and compete play now in Athletics Championship – the sports game where fun multiplayer meets the thrill of victory.
Sharpen your athletic skills and dominate the track. Sports glory awaits!

bluejetty:00014412:ios.summary:

MarketSurge is different—
bluejetty:00014412:ios.description:
The best stock research and charting app just got better. MarketSurge (formerly MarketSmith) gives you all the tools you need to make more money in the market. It’s simplified and streamlined for modern investors.
MarketSurge is different—intuitive instead of complicated. It’s easy-to-use and, unlike other apps, you can talk to a MarketSurge product coach about features, strategies and smarter ways to find winning stocks. Try MarketSurge for $29.99 for the first month and leave your old investing routine behind.
The MarketSurge app makes it easier and faster to:
GET TRADE IDEAS
• Our Growth 250 stock list uses 30 different screens to identify stocks with the highest growth potential.
• Industry Group metrics track the best- and worst-performing stock groups.
• Generate trade ideas faster with our exclusive stock lists like Breaking Out Today, Near Pivot and RS Line Blue Dot.
• Screen for stocks using the criteria of legendary investors like William O'Neil and Warren Buffet.
• Jumpstart your stock research with free product coaching so you can maximize all of our app features.
EVALUATE STOCKS
• Detailed high-definition stock charts provide constantly updated information on stocks, indexes, mutual funds and industry groups.
• Instant access to over 70 key technical and fundamental stock data points, such as earnings and sales histories, proprietary IBD ratings and institutional ownership.
• Daily and weekly charts feature Earnings Per Share data at a glance, plus previous year EPS comparison with a single tap.
• Tap and hold for price tracker featuring historical earnings data, complete with snapshot percentage change over previous quarters.
• Set custom alerts to notify you if a stock you’re watching crosses into your buy zone or starts flashing sell signals.
SEE WHEN TO BUY AND SELL.
• MarketSurge’s AI-powered Pattern Recognition feature automatically finds and highlights base patterns as they form, which makes buying breakout stocks easier than ever before.
• Right on the chart, you’ll see color-coded zones showing optimal price ranges to take action: buy in the blue, take profits in the green and cut losses in the pink.
• Set alerts to be sent to your email, phone and tablet based on chart pattern buy points.
The MarketSurge iOS app is free to download, offers introductory pricing of $29.99 for the first month and gives you unlimited access to our stock research and analysis across multiple devices—phone, tablet, Mac and PC.
If you want to keep making more money with MarketSurge, after your first month you can subscribe for $149.99/month.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings in iTunes after purchase.
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during an active subscription period.
Terms of Use may be viewed at: https://www.investors.com/home/investors-business-daily-inc-terms-of-use/
If you have any questions about app functions or how to access your subscription on other devices, please contact us at (800) 831-2525.

bluejetty:00014723:ios.name: Simple Booth HALO
bluejetty:00014723:ios.summary:
Make the most of every moment with Simple Booth HALO®, the top photo booth app for events, businesses, and more. Now, more powerful than ever with AI effects, the Layout Designer, and DSLR camera support!
For over a decade, Simple Booth ha
bluejetty:00014723:ios.description:
Make the most of every moment with Simple Booth HALO®, the top photo booth app for events, businesses, and more. Now, more powerful than ever with AI effects, the Layout Designer, and DSLR camera support!
For over a decade, Simple Booth has powered photo booth experiences at premier music festivals, social clubs, bars & restaurants, Fortune 500 companies, VIP meet and greets, celebrity green rooms, and so much more. Bring that same world-class photo experience to your next event.
With weekly plan options, HALO is the best and most flexible way to set up a hassle-free photo booth. It's perfect for live events, brand activations, parties, or as a permanent fixture at your venue or business.
The HALO app is incredibly easy-to-use with premium features built for advanced photo experiences and business needs. Here's how it works:
As the event host or business owner, you can design custom layouts or "photo booth templates" with ease. Add images, text, a logo or overlay, and frames for your captured photos. Our Layout Designer and free library of themes makes this fun and simple\! Plus, you can choose which types of motion to offer, from still images to GIFs and videos.
Then, personalize the experience from start to finish in the app preset editor or from the online dashboard, customizing everything to your preferences. This includes the start screen, branding & messaging throughout the experience, and even a thank you message at the end. You can go in-depth or keep it simple using our sensible defaults—the choice is yours.
When you're on-site and ready, you can launch your booth\! The Preflight Check screen will help you make sure you didn't miss anything important. At this point, you can connect a DSLR camera for professional portraits, or keep it simple using the iPad camera.
Once you're live, guests can walk up to the photo booth and choose from your layouts and capture their images. The countdown begins, guests pose, and instantly see the results. Then, they can edit their photos with any tools you've enabled—glam, background replacement (AI or green screen), filters, props, stickers, and AI effects. Choose from a growing library of pre-built styles, build your own with AI-generated prompts, or use guest inputs to create personalized AI portraits.
After that, they can choose whether to keep their photos private or include them in the gallery. No other photo booth software on the market puts privacy in the hands of guests like Simple Booth HALO.
Finally, photos are sent directly to guests' phones by their favorite method: QR code, text message, email, AirDrop, WhatsApp. You can also choose to offer prints for guests to take home\!
We've dialed in the formula to make it all work seamlessly, including a robust offline mode (works for all features except AI effects, which require a stable internet connection). Guests simply adore it—coming back again and again to take more photos. At the end, you'll have an amazing online gallery full of stunning images, thanks to proprietary features that improve photo quality like glam, background blur, and filters. Your galleries can be displayed on your Simple Booth profile or streamed to a TV or projector using the Live Feed—a real-time, online slideshow.
Most importantly, don't let your next event pass by without capturing incredible memories. Simple Booth offers interactive photo experiences that are fun, easy to use, and delightful to share—for every occasion.
"All we hear is, 'Look how good we look!' The most common reaction? 'I need one of these at home.'" - Kurt Nielsen, Photographer
For inquiries, please reach out to sales at halo@simplebooth.com or support at support@simplebooth.com
Policies & terms https://www.simplebooth.com/policies

bluejetty:00141038:ios.name: Blade of God X: Orisols
bluejetty:00141038:ios.summary:
"Blade of God X: Orisols" is a dark-themed A-RPG, serving as the second installment in the Blade of God series. 
Rooted in Norse mythology, players assume the role of an "Inheritor," reborn through the cycles, and embark on a journey from
bluejetty:00141038:ios.description:
"Blade of God X: Orisols" is a dark-themed A-RPG, serving as the second installment in the Blade of God series. 
Rooted in Norse mythology, players assume the role of an "Inheritor," reborn through the cycles, and embark on a journey from Muspelheim to explore the vast realms supported by the World Tree. By traversing the timelines of Voidom, Primglory, and Trurem, players have the choice of "Sacrifice" or "Redemption," allowing them to acquire artifacts or seek the assistance of hundreds of deities, including Odin the Allfather and Loki the Evil, to shape the progression of the world.
Inheritor, the gods annihilated in the dusk —
You, are the ultimate guardian.
[Dynamic Combos & Skill Chain]
Building upon the exhilarating combos from Blade of God I, we have introduced enhanced strategic depth to combat. 
The integration of counterattacks with skill chains empowers players to analyze the behavioral patterns and attack sequences of diverse bosses. Seizing the opportune moments when they are stunned or staggered, players can unleash focused attacks, making great damage.
[Unique Concept, Soul Core System]
Hela, who had nothing left to lose; Esther, who left her past behind; Chaos, who abandoned the physical form.
Embedding the soul cores of monsters into the skill chain allows the protagonist to harness the power of souls in combat. Paired with the protagonist's professional features to find out limitless possibilities for the style of combat.
[Multiplayer Cooperation & Collaborative Confrontation]
Hand of corruption, assist horn, and invading. Engage in collaborative battles, compete for rewards, and execute cunning strategies.
Form or join a Caravan, participate in genuine and fair PvP, and collaborate to conquer formidable bosses.
[Ultimate Visuals & Musical Experience]
As a product that enables cross-platform data sharing across iOS and Mac , we will officially launch on platforms simultaneously.
Enjoy the best visual performance with support for up to 4K resolution. 
Immerse yourself in a symphonic experience crafted in collaboration with the Philharmonic Orchestra, providing an unparalleled musical journey.
[From the producer]
Each of us has sacrificed something invaluable for what we needed in that moment. Love? Freedom? Health? Time?
In retrospect, is what we gained truly more precious than what we lost?
This game aims to take you on a journey of sacrifice and redemption, where you can uncover your own answers.

► Roomie Remote X is our current app — get the latest features and ongoing updates. Search the App Store for "Roomie Remote X" to upgrade.
This is the original Roomie Remote, still supported, but device compatibility is now out of date.
Audio/Video Control and Home Automation seamlessly merged into a Universal Remote for your entire home. Control TVs, A/V receivers, set top boxes, lights, thermostats, and more from an integrated remote with a beautiful and simple design.
Multiple Winner of the CTA Home Technology App of the Year Award!
PURCHASE REQUIRED: This app requires a subscription for all functionality. A free trial is offered.
FEATURES
• The Leader in Audio/Video and Home Automation Control: Directly control popular devices including any television, Apple TV, Fire TV, DISH, Sonos, TiVo, Kodi, Plex, DirecTV, Roku and thousands more – automatically discovered on your network.
• Direct integration with televisions from LG, Samsung, Sony, Vizio, TCL, Roku, and more including app launch and channel guides.
• TV Guides: Personalized TV listings for most of the Americas and Europe. Detailed episode, season, and cast information.
• HomeKit: The only app that provides control of your entire home including HomeKit accessories, seamlessly blending home control with audio/video control.
• Unmatched Compatibility: Over 400,000 commands for IP, Infrared, and even Serial control automatically organized into easy to use Activities.
• Media Guides: Content guides for Kaleidescape, Zidoo, Kodi, Plex, Sonos, HEOS, and many more
• Full intercom-style video conferencing, instantly connect with video to any active Roomie in your home, or even remotely!
• Broadcast to HomePod: Live broadcast to HomePods
• Sonos Announcements: Send announcements to Sonos speakers
• Roomie Voice Control directly in the app
• Siri Voice Control and Shortcuts support
• Amazon Alexa Voice Control
• Sonos: Run your entire Sonos system, group/regroup speakers, setup automatic regroupings
• Receivers: Integrates with popular receivers from Denon, Yamaha, Trinnov, JBL, Anthem, Onkyo, Marantz, and more including receiver streaming systems such as HEOS and MusicCast.
• Lighting and Thermostats: Lutron, Honeywell, Ecobee, SmartThings, Philips Hue, Vera, ISY, Insteon, WeMo.
• DVR Guides: DVR control for DISH, TiVo, and DirecTV
• Cameras: Monitor Arlo, Ring, HomeKit, RTSP, and other ONVIF cameras
• Harmony hardbutton remote synchronization
• Instant synchronization of your home configuration across multiple iOS devices
