bluejetty:00088624:ios.description:
Descubre la Biblia como nunca antes con "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual", la aplicación diseñada para llevarte de la mano a través de las Escrituras en un lenguaje claro y contemporáneo. Perfecta para creyentes de todas las edades, "Biblia Traducción en Lenguaje Actual" transforma tu experiencia de estudio bíblico, haciéndola accesible, profunda y enriquecedora. Con esta aplicación, la palabra de Dios está al alcance de tu mano, lista para iluminar tu camino en cualquier momento y lugar.
Funcionalidades Únicas de Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual:
Texto Bíblico Completo en Lenguaje Actual: Sumérgete en las Escrituras con una traducción contemporánea que habla tu idioma. "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" ofrece una lectura fresca y accesible, ideal para la comprensión y el estudio profundo de la Palabra.
Recursos Bíblicos Complementarios: En "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual", no solo tendrás acceso al texto sagrado, sino también a una amplia gama de recursos adicionales. Desde temas bíblicos para predicar, devocionales diarios, estudios bíblicos y predicaciones, hasta mensajes cristianos que nutrirán tu fe diariamente. 
Imágenes con Versículos Bíblicos: Visualiza la Palabra de Dios de una manera única con hermosas imágenes acompañadas de versículos bíblicos inspiradores. Perfectas para compartir en redes sociales o para meditar en la intimidad de tu devocional personal.
Podcast y Predicaciones en Audio: ¿Prefieres escuchar? "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" incluye contenido en audio para que puedas nutrir tu espíritu mientras te desplazas, haces ejercicio o simplemente descansas. Escucha estudios bíblicos, devocionales y predicaciones en cualquier momento.
Herramientas de Estudio Personalizadas: "Biblia Traducción en Lenguaje Actual" te ofrece herramientas de estudio personalizadas para que tu tiempo con la Palabra sea aún más fructífero.
Devocionales Diarios: Los devocionales diarios en "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" te ayudarán a profundizar en tu fe, ofreciéndote reflexiones y oraciones para cada día.
Interfaz Amigable y Personalizable: Con un diseño intuitivo y fácil de usar, "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" te permite personalizar tu experiencia de lectura. Ajusta el tamaño del texto, elige tu modo de visualización preferido y disfruta de una lectura cómoda a cualquier hora del día.
Acceso sin Conexión: ¿Vas a estar sin internet? No hay problema. "Biblia Traducción en Lenguaje Actual" te permite descargar tus versículos y recursos favoritos para que puedas acceder a ellos offline, asegurando que la Palabra de Dios te acompañe siempre, sin importar donde estés.
Comunidad y Compartir: "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" no solo te conecta con la Palabra, sino también con una comunidad de creyentes. Comparte tus descubrimientos, versículos favoritos e inspiraciones con amigos y familiares a través de las redes sociales o directamente desde la aplicación.
Soporte Constante y Actualizaciones: Nos comprometemos a mejorar continuamente Biblia Traducción en Lenguaje Actual para ofrecerte la mejor experiencia de estudio bíblico. Disfruta de actualizaciones regulares con nuevas características, recursos y contenido que enriquecerán tu jornada de fe.
"Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual" es más que una aplicación, es tu compañero diario en el camino de la fe, ofreciéndote las herramientas y recursos necesarios para un crecimiento espiritual profundo y significativo. Con una interfaz amigable y una riqueza de contenido que abarca desde el estudio bíblico hasta la inspiración diaria, "Biblia Traducción en Lenguaje Actual" es la aplicación definitiva para quien busca conectar con la Palabra de Dios de manera moderna y relevante.
Con "Biblia TLA Lenguaje Actual", lleva la palabra de Dios contigo a todas partes y deja que su luz guíe cada paso de tu camino. No esperes más para profundizar en tu estudio de la Biblia con la mejor herramienta a tu disposición. Comienza tu viaje hacia una fe más profunda y un conocimiento más rico de las Escrituras.

Kangaride – Your Trusted Ride-Sharing Companion
Discover the easiest way to find and share rides with Kangaride, the go-to ride-sharing app for comfortable and affordable travel. Whether you're commuting, planning a road trip, or just need a ride, Kangaride connects you with trusted drivers and passengers across Canada.
Why Choose Kangaride?
• Pay As You Go: With Kangaride's flexible token system, you only pay when you book a ride. Purchase tokens that never expire and use them whenever you need a ride—giving you full control over your travel expenses.
• Simple Booking: Browse available rides, choose your preferred route, and book your seat in just a few taps.
• Safe and Reliable: Drivers are verified to ensure a safe and comfortable journey. See driver reviews before you book.
• Flexible Options: Find rides that suit your schedule, or post your own ride offer to share your car with others.
• Affordable Travel: Save on travel costs by sharing rides with others heading the same way.
• Real-Time Updates: Stay informed with notifications on ride status, and communicate directly with our customer service, available every day of the year.
• Environmentally Friendly: Reduce your carbon footprint by carpooling and making efficient use of available seats.
Join the Kangaride community today and start sharing rides with confidence.

bluejetty:00022226:ios.description:
Beep Me: Simplify Your Life, Stay On Time!
Tired of forgetting important tasks or appointments? Beep Me is the reminder app designed to help you manage your schedule effortlessly. Whether it’s setting a quick reminder or one that keeps nagging you until you act, Beep Me has you covered with just a couple of taps.
Imagine this:
You’re in a meeting and remember you promised to call Jack later. Quickly note “Call Jack” and set a reminder for 2:30 PM. Or, you’ve got a pizza in the oven and need a timer for 20 minutes? Beep Me makes it easy to set reminders in seconds without the hassle of complicated apps or calendar clutter.
Key Features:
◆ Nagging Mode: Never miss a reminder again! Set how often and how many times Beep Me should nag you until you act.
◆ Quick Setup: Create reminders in seconds using either timer-style (e.g., “Remind me in 20 minutes”) or clock-style (e.g., “Remind me at 2:30 PM”).
◆ Repeat Reminders: Customize daily, weekly, monthly, or custom intervals to fit your schedule.
◆ Apple Watch Integration: View, snooze, or mark reminders as done straight from your wrist when a reminder pops up.
◆ Customizable Sounds & Widgets: Choose your preferred notification sounds and add widgets to your home screen for quick access to reminders.
◆ Beep Priority: Set High priority to break through Focus modes, or Urgent to sound alarms even in Silent mode.
What Users Are Saying:
◆ "This app is a game-changer. The nagging reminders mean I never forget anything!"
◆ "Quick, intuitive, and exactly what I needed to stay on top of my tasks."
Ready to stay on top of your schedule? Download Beep Me today and experience a life with fewer forgotten tasks and more peace of mind!

bluejetty:00132318:ios.description:
XinematiX establishes a new high-level standard for sound libraries for iOS®.
XinematiX delivers over 25 GB of premium sounds that are the result of over 3 years of recording and programming work by legendary sample sound producer KARO Sound Development, brought to you by music app guru Harry Gohs. Unlimited creative possibilities and ease of use - that's what XinematiX is all about.
Non-compromise sound quality – Harry Gohs’ top-notch sound engine offers excellent dynamics via extensive velocity switching and clever programming. Advanced features like Round Robin sample triggering will make your performances and productions sound richer and more natural than ever before.
The App already includes 2 beautiful multi sampled sounds: A phrase choir using round robin to give you different articulations on each key repetition and the standard XinematiX Choir preset.
990 programs - carefully curated sound programs selecting from 62 preset packs across all thinkable sound categories now available with a single in-app purchase.
Multi power - Up to 3 different programs can be stacked simultaneously in a multi and either be crossfaded or layered for dramatic sound sculpting with the intuitive color-coded on-screen fader.
Flexible and customizable – pro features like envelopes, filters, and reverb effects make it easy to adapt any program/multi to your needs and save it as your own user preset. A special “white mode” allows effective manipulation of all programs loaded in a multi at once.
Live Mode - organize your multis and programs for quick access in a dedicated Live Mode with 128 scenes and 16 tiles per screen.
Unlimited seamless transitions – No matter if you are performing or just browsing through sounds: To ensure you stay in the flow, special care is given that your sound never cuts off or glitches.
MIDI Learn - A comprehensive MIDI Learn feature makes it easy to map any MIDI controller to all relevant functions.
List of sound categories:
 • Bell & Mallet
 • Brass
 • Motion & Pad
 • Orchestra
 • Piano & Key
 • Plucked & Guitar
 • Sound FX
 • Strings
 • Synth & Airy
 • Vocal & Choir
 • Woodwind & Reed
Further features include:
 • Standalone & AUv3 for integration in Logic Pro, Cubasis and other compatible hosts
 • Bridge to AudioLayer App for enhanced sound design
 • Dynamic control fader compresses the response of your keybed on the fly
 • ‘Dice’ button suggests random multi for instant inspiration
 • Hermode Tuning function for purest harmonies
 • Compatible with MIDI Polyphonic Expression (MPE)
 • optional SSD disk streaming

bluejetty:00167999:ios.description:
Save More & Earn Rewards at Save Mart! Download our app today to track and redeem Cash Back on groceries and Fuel Savings at Shell®, unlock digital coupons, browse weekly deals, and scan products to get the best prices—all in one place!
Earn Save Mart Rewards every time you shop 
• Earn 1 Save Mart Rewards point for every $1 spent in-store or online on qualifying purchases, and redeem points for Cash Back on groceries and Fuel Savings at Shell. The more you shop, the more you save on your cart and at the pump.
Link Accounts to Earn Even More Fuel Savings 
• Every 100 points = 10¢ per gallon in fuel savings at participating Shell stations (up to 20 gallons per fill-up). Points expire on the last day of the third month after you earn them. Just enter your registered phone number at the pump to redeem instantly. Then link Fuel Rewards® from Shell to stack even more savings from Fuel Rewards offers like tier status, dining, online shopping, rental cars, and more.
Clip Coupons & Save Big 
• Easily clip digital coupons in the app and redeem them at checkout by entering your registered phone number. Find offers tailored to your shopping needs and maximize your savings effortlessly.
Weekly Deals & Featured Ads 
• Stay updated with the latest deals and special promotions, including weekly ads and limited-time discounts.
Scan Products In-Store 
• Use your phone to scan any product for available coupons or check the price before you buy.
Get Notifications on Savings & Deals 
• Enable push notifications to receive updates on new coupons, fuel savings offers, exclusive discounts, and special promotions.
Order for Delivery or Pick Up (via Instacart) 
• Conveniently shop online and choose between pickup or delivery, making grocery shopping easier than ever.
Find Your Nearest Save Mart 
• Quickly locate your nearest Save Mart store and get directions with just a few taps.
Create & Organize Your Shopping List 
• Build a personalized shopping list by adding items manually, browsing the app, or scanning products. See which items have coupons or Rewards available to maximize savings.

bluejetty:00095830:ios.description:
ReBrain helps you reclaim your time and mental clarity by turning healthy habits into screen time rewards.
What’s ReBrain?
 It’s a smart productivity companion designed to fight digital overload and build better habits. You complete real-life tasks—like workouts, reading, or meditation—to earn back the right to scroll. No guilt, no shame—just science-based motivation that makes self-discipline feel good.
HOW IT WORKS 
Get a Brain Check-In
 Take a short interactive quiz to find out your current "brain state" and get personalized suggestions.
Choose Distracting Apps
 Choose apps that you want to limit and cut your scrolling time.
Pick Your Habit Goals
 Choose areas you want to improve—focus, fitness, sleep, learning, mindfulness, and more.
Earn Screen Time by Completing Tasks
 Every healthy activity earns you time coins you can use to unlock scrolling. No more endless doomscrolling.
Gamify Your Growth
 Our brain mascot keeps you on track with fun rewards, streaks, and gentle reminders.
Track Progress with Beautiful Visuals
 See how your habits evolve and how much screen time you’ve redeemed from real-life wins.
FEATURES
Task-based habit tracker that unlocks scrolling
Focus sessions to help you stay on track without distractions
Physical activity tracker to reward movement and wellness
Smart to-do list that converts real-life tasks into screen time
Motivational quotes-reminders to help you quit scrolling
Detailed statistics on your habits, focus time, and redeemed screen time
Fun, gamified interface with an animated brain mascot
WHO’S IT FOR?
Students and creatives battling procrastination
Entrepreneurs and remote workers seeking balance
Anyone tired of feeling like their brain is “rotting” from mindless scrolling
ReBrain is where productivity meets dopamine.
 Give your future self something to scroll for.
Start your ReBrain journey today and turn your attention into your biggest asset.

bluejetty:00138369:ios.description:
Embark on an epic journey as a powerful wizard through the age of war and magic survival in Soul Quest: Epic War RPG.
From ancient to modern times, you will command an army of mini warriors, masters in the art of war across historical epochs. Your quest in Soul Quest: Epic War RPG begins with collecting souls from defeated enemies, empowering you to summon your own mini warriors. These summoned champions are your key to conquering relentless zombie waves and monstrous hordes that threaten to engulf each era of history!
Key Features:
- Collect souls & resurrect warriors: Gather souls from fallen foes to strengthen your soul knight army and unlock powerful summoning abilities.
- Master the Art of War: Strategize and deploy your mini warriors strategically to defeat zombie waves and monstrous hordes. It's heroes vs hordes - using your army strategically will ensure your survival through the eras.
- Engage in epic battles: Engage in age of war from ancient civilizations to futuristic realms, all in the quest to conquer and survive io.
- Heroes vs Hordes: Lead your summoned warriors against hordes of zombies and monstrous creatures in intense, tactical battles. You can resurrect fallen warriors and distribute souls evenly among the units you've unlocked, ensuring a balanced and formidable army at all times.
- Wizardry and Magic survival: You're a wizard with powerful abilities - harness the mystical forces of wizardry to augment your army’s abilities and turn the tide of battle. Win magical artifacts to increase your chances of survival and show your full wizard powers!
- Strategic Conquest: Plan your moves carefully as you navigate through the challenges of each age of war, mastering the art of war and survival io against overwhelming odds.
Join the Soul Quest in this Epic War RPG, harness the power of souls and summon your army of mini warriors in this survival game.
As a wizard and soul knight collecting the dark souls of your defeated enemies, it's your mission to conquer this heroes vs hordes battle of the ages. Master the art of war, defeat the zombie waves, and ensure your survival.
If you enjoy strategy, historical battles and zombie games, then Soul Quest: Epic War RPG is the war game for you.
We are warriors fighting for survival through the eras, and you're the wizard in charge of leading us to victory. Are you up to the challenge?

bluejetty:00063327:ios.name: EuroMillions
bluejetty:00063327:ios.summary: Get the latest EuroMillions results within seconds of the draw taking place. This easy to use app shows the EuroMillions numbers (including associated draws like the Millionaire Maker, Irish Raffle and EuroMillions Plus) and full prize brea
bluejetty:00063327:ios.description:
Get the latest EuroMillions results within seconds of the draw taking place. This easy to use app shows the EuroMillions numbers (including associated draws like the Millionaire Maker, Irish Raffle and EuroMillions Plus) and full prize breakdowns including number of winners and prizes paid. 
The following features are also included:
QR Ticket Scanner (UK only)
--------------------------------------
For lottery tickets purchased in UK shops, simply scan the QR code printed on your ticket using your phone’s camera to see if you have won a prize.
Ticket Checker
--------------------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket. Only play EuroMillions on certain days every Friday or Tuesday? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customisable Notifications
--------------------------------------
Get notified instantly when the latest EuroMillions results and prize breakdowns become available. Want to know when the jackpot has rolled over or has reached a certain amount? Just head to the Notification section of the app to set up your alerts. There is also the option to set notifications at times that suit you - great for reminding you to purchase tickets before the draw.
Random Number Generator
--------------------------------------
Stuck for numbers? Use this handy tool and let the app choose your numbers rather than having to rely on Lucky Dip numbers!
EuroMillions Results Archive
--------------------------------------
Access to the full archive of results dating back to the first draw which took place in 2004. 
Multilingual Support
--------------------------------------
This app is available in the following languages: English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, Chinese, German, Italian, Polish, Swedish and Russian.
Support
--------------------------------------
If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve this app, please get in touch at support@euro-millions.com.

bluejetty:00126242:ios.summary: Easy-PhotoPrint Editor is an easy-to-use photo print app. It features many useful templates and a free-layout editor for making all kinds of prints (photo layouts, cards, collages, calendars, disc labels, photo IDs, business cards, stickers
bluejetty:00126242:ios.description:
Easy-PhotoPrint Editor is an easy-to-use photo print app. It features many useful templates and a free-layout editor for making all kinds of prints (photo layouts, cards, collages, calendars, disc labels, photo IDs, business cards, stickers, posters).
[Key features]
• Intuitive operation for easy printing of all kinds of prints
Just select the type of print you want to make, edit and decorate your photos, and print.
• Comes with plenty of ready-to-use templates
Choose from collages, calendars, and many other templates that use multiple photos in addition to photo prints.
• Make original posters for use in stores and other situations
Just add photos and text to the simple poster template to create original posters you can use in stores or other situations.
• Easy to create other everyday items
The app makes it easy to create business cards, photo IDs, stickers, and other items you use every day.
• Pattern paper for making original art works
The app lets you print pre-designed pattern paper for use in making paper items or scrapbooking.
• Print disk labels so you can see at a glance what’s on your disks
If your printer supports printing disk labels, you can make original disk labels with just your smartphone.
• Slate of editing functions to create just the print you want
Not only can you crop or expand your photos, you can also edit and decorate them with colored edges, text, and stamps.
[Supported printers]
- Canon Inkjet Printers
See the following website for supported printers.
https://ij.start.canon/eppe-model
*Some functions are not supported on imagePROGRAF series.
 [When the app cannot find your printer.] Check that your printer is in the supported printers list.
 The printer must be connected to your network.
 Use the "Canon PRINT" app to connect your printer to the network.
[Supported OS]
iOS 17.0 and later

bluejetty:00126643:ios.description:
Vexere is the pioneer one-stop-shop booking app in Vietnam that allow people to search and book bus, flight, train tickets in the shortest time with a single click on only one screen. It revolutionizes the travel planning experience, providing customers with more choices, transparent pricing, travel times and easier booking.
We help travelers explore and connect with every destination, district, and province on the map. With a single “search” click, Vexere will show you all the best possible transport options to save your time and money so you can love the journey you’re on, thanks to our 5000+ routes, 2000+ bus operators, 5000+ agents, and partnership with all airlines in the country. 
WHY SHOULD WE BOOK BUS, FLIGHT, TRAIN ON VEXERE?
Attractive exclusive discounts. With marketplace system, our partners can easily build promotional programs to make sure you always have the cheapest bus, flight and train tickets.
Excellent customer support: Vexere always supports you anytime, anywhere for a complete journey.
Diverse payment methods: Quick and secure payments with e-wallets (Momo, Zalopay...), ATM, Visa / Master cards.
Guaranteed transport: Direct integration with all best airlines and bus operators.
VEXERE BUS BOOKING - GUARANTEE 150% REFUND IF TRANSPORT SERVICE IS NOT PROVIDED
Key features:
- Convenient, secure & fast booking without booking fee.
- One touch cancellation - Cancel tickets using the app with a single tap and complete refund
- Live bus tracking – Track your bus live and send tracking link to your bus operators.
- Attractive exclusive discounts and last minute deals every time you book (T&Cs apply)
Popular Bus Operators: Hà Lan, Hoa Mai, Sao Viet, Phat Loc An, Kumho Samco, Kumho Viet Thanh, Good Morning Cat Ba, Cat Ba Express, Sao Nghe Limousine, Tra Lan Vien, Khanh Phong, Lien Hung.
Popular Bus Stations: Mien Dong Bus station, Trung tam Da Nang Bus station, Gia Lam Bus station, My Dinh Bus station, An Suong Bus station, Nuoc Ngam Bus station, Mien Tay Bus station
Popular Routes: Ha Noi - Sapa, Ha Noi - Quang Ninh, Ha Noi - Cat Ba, Ha Noi - Ninh Binh, Ha Noi - Vinh, Saigon - Da Lat, Saigon - Mui Ne, Saigon - Nha Trang, Saigon - Rach Gia, Saigon - Vung Tau. 
VEXERE FLIGHT - DISCOUNT 20K/SEAT FOR THE CHEAPEST TICKET OF VIETJET AIR
Key features:
- The price you see is the price you pay. Price including all fees and taxes. 
- Auto-suggestion search engine allows you to find the nearest airport and how far from where you want to go.
- Quick flight refund only 20 minutes after completing your payment
Popular airlines: Vietnam Airlines, Vietjet Air, Bamboo Airways, Vietravel Airlines, Pacific Airlines. 
VEXERE TRAIN
Key features: 
- Smart Journey Planner: Search, compare & book cheaper train tickets. Vexere simplifies your booking experience, saving you time and money 
- Automatically apply all promotions offered by Vietnam Railways (VNR) for train tickets
- Diverse payment methods: Buy your train tickets with e-wallets, all major credit cards and debit cards
- Vexere offers e-tickets on all routes, saving the time and hassle of having to queue to collect train tickets.
VEXERE BUS/CAR RENTALS
- Transparent Information
- Get detailed quotations in a few minutes
- High quality and verified buses, cars and motorbikes
- Dedicated 24/7 customer service whether you rent a vehicles from us or not
Popular bus & car types for rent: Normal 4-45 seater, Limousine Luxury 9-11 Bus, Sleeper Bus, Cabin Luxury 20-20 Sleeper Bus. Most common destinations: Da Lat, Vung Tau, Nha Trang, Da Nang, Hue, Ha Giang, Sapa, Ha Noi, Ho Chi Minh City
Customer support hotline: 1900 88 86 86
Any suggestions please send to lienhe@vexere.com.
Follow Vexere.com on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Vexere

bluejetty:00088084:ios.description:
Meet the new Doctor Sugar — redesigned, smarter, and more helpful than ever.
With a clean, modern look and a brand-new app icon, the app makes tracking your diabetes and overall health easier and faster.
See more, scroll less.
Unlike many glucose trackers, Doctor Sugar is built for simplicity. Most people with type 2 diabetes check their glucose only a few times a day — which means the app can now display multiple days of measurements at once, often 6 days or even more depending on your screen size. No endless scrolling, no clutter.
Tap to dive deeper into each day.
Days overview shows your blood glucose trends across multiple days. Tap any day row to expand and see complete details: medications taken, meals logged with individual food items and their full nutrition values (carbs, protein, fat, calories), plus activity recorded that day.
Stay on top of your day.
Busy schedule? Forget to check your glucose after a meal? The built-in alerts have you covered — just turn one on and the app will remind you when it’s time.
Understand your progress at a glance.
A clear, visual chart helps you spot trends instantly, while statistics like Average Blood Glucose and Estimated HbA1c keep you informed and motivated.
Now with even more health tools:
 • Medication and activity logging
 • Enhanced food logging with full nutritional insights
 • Massive food database for quick meal entry
 • Weight, body measurements, blood pressure, and heart-rate tracking
 • iCloud sync to keep your data safe and accessible across all your Apple devices
 • Apple Health integration to save your glucose, weight, and other data directly to Apple Health
All your key health data — together in one clean, intuitive app.
Download Doctor Sugar and take control of your health today!

bluejetty:00128408:ios.description:
Choose a layout for 2 images or 3 images, and apply rounded corners. There is an infinite number of combinations.
Create your special photo with PhotoFrame.
PhotoFrame is a photo frame app that allows you to bring your photos in the iOS photo albums together.
- Frames
Select any of the frame shapes from a wide collection, then apply color and rounded corners to create your own unique photo frame. 
- Sizes
Select different sizes from the printout size to the wallpaper size according to your needs. 
The following sizes are available:
DSC, L, postcard (Japanese size), HV, KG, square, 16:9, 4:3 and 3:2.
- Video
You can create collages using not only photos, but also videos.
Place videos in your layout just like photos, and export expressive collages with motion. Capture your favorite moments in a richer, more vivid way than still images alone can offer.
About the video feature:
- You can place up to 6 videos in a single layout.
- Exported videos are limited to a maximum length of 15 seconds.
- Videos longer than 15 seconds will be exported using only the first 15 seconds.
- Videos shorter than 15 seconds will loop as needed during export.
- Adjust the printable area
It's quite common to hear that even though you set the photo dimensions to fit the frame size, when you print the picture at shop, the edges of the frame may get cut off since they will be printed a few millimeters inside.
PhotoFrame enables you to adjust the outline of the frame without cutting anything off for the final print.
- Add text captions
You can easily add any text or date stamps to your photo.
(Please note that text won't be saved to your Favorites. The text will be removed when you quit the app.)
- Favorites
Save the frames you created to your Favorites. 
【Supported OS】
iOS 12 or later
【Supported devices】
iPhone 6sPlus, iPhone 6s, iPhone 5s
Please note that this app has not been tested for compatibility with other devices except those listed above.
【Disclaimer】

As featured in "New Games We Love", "Game of the Day", and "Essential Card Games!"
Match Solitaire™ weaves the best of classic Solitaire and Match 3 into an original new card-stacking puzzler.
Stack cards up, down, or both ways to strategically uncover and collect 3-of-a-kind matches.

Play for the jackpot in the weekly team event!

Have you met your match?
FEATURES
• 25,000 levels
• 10+ million unique puzzles
• 40+ animated characters
• 7 difficulty levels
• Hint system
• Daily Challenge
• Weekly Team Event
• Every deal guaranteed winnable!

My goal in designing a new kind of Solitaire was to create something that feels fresh and exciting for fans of classic Solitaire while staying true to the spirit of the game beloved by so many.
Match Solitaire is my attempt to achieve that goal, and I hope you'll be as delighted to play it as I am to share it with you.
-David

bluejetty:00178537:ios.name: Timer Tabata for Workout, HIIT
bluejetty:00178537:ios.summary:
Workout Timer: Tabata, Rounds, Intervals, Stopwatch and WOD
One timer for every workout: HIIT and Tabata at home, rounds in the boxing gym, your own intervals for circuit training, a stopwatch for running and a Workout of the Day for Cross
bluejetty:00178537:ios.description:
Workout Timer: Tabata, Rounds, Intervals, Stopwatch and WOD
One timer for every workout: HIIT and Tabata at home, rounds in the boxing gym, your own intervals for circuit training, a stopwatch for running and a Workout of the Day for CrossFit.
TIMERS
• Tabata — set work, rest, rounds and cycles, start with one tap
• Rounds — a round timer with rest breaks and a countdown before the first round, for boxing, MMA and sparring
• Intervals — build your own sequence of exercises by time or by reps, name every interval and save the workout
• Stopwatch — with a beep at the interval you choose
• WOD — a workout of the day with exercise descriptions and pictures, a new WOD every day, save your favourites or build your own
• AI Coach — a workout plan for your goals, level and equipment: bodyweight, dumbbells, kettlebell, barbell, jump rope
WHILE YOU TRAIN
• Big numbers you can read from across the gym
• Sound schemes, vibration, voice alerts and a flash on the last seconds
• Keeps running in the background, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Widgets for a quick start
APPLE WATCH
• Timers on your wrist with heart rate, controlled from the watch or from iPhone
PROGRESS
• Workout history and achievements
• Apple Health: workouts and calories burned are saved automatically
• iCloud sync between iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch
• Layouts for iPad and iPhone Duo
• Articles about training
PREMIUM
Premium removes ads, unlocks all timers and the background mode. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or buy once and keep it forever. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel it in your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of use: http://appbysnap.tilda.ws/terms
Privacy policy: http://appbysnap.tilda.ws/privacypolice
Good luck in your workouts!

bluejetty:00179453:ios.description:
Gladys is a drag-and-drop shelf that holds things you want to set aside, such as links, text snippets, map locations, contacts, images, photos, emails, messages and much more (even if the application that the information came from is removed)
It works with any app that supports drag-and-drop, and helps keep you focused by letting you quickly set something aside, without having to consider where it needs to be dropped, or having to constantly switch between apps.
• Works with any app that supports drag-and-drop, but also provides an extension for apps that don't yet support it, as well as the ability to paste items to & from the clipboard.
• Quickly search for items inside the app or via Spotlight. Access your top items from the home screen / Today widget, your Apple Watch, and even iMessage.
• Annotate items with notes, custom titles, and tag items with labels that allow you to easily categorise, browse, and sort your collection.
• Take your collection with you on your iPhone, and keep it updated by turning on automatic iCloud syncing.
• Invite friends to keep items from your own collection in their own collections, and, if you give permission, even collaboratively annotate and edit them.
• Import/export/merge collection archives simply by dragging.
• Ideal for bookmarking between apps: For example you can quickly return to dropped email items by selecting 'Open' in their info view, quickly share links between different browsers, or use Siri shortcuts to copy often-used items to and from your clipboard.
• Experienced users can get details on dropped items and extract or modify specific data components (e.g. extract the URL of an image link, instead of the whole item, add a new image, or edit the title).
• Technical users can inspect binary data using the in-built hex viewer, download items pointed to by web links, and even archive web pages.
• Contains no analytics, ratings prompts, or noise.

bluejetty:00188218:ios.name: Kol Yaakob
bluejetty:00188218:ios.summary:
Kol Yaakob is a weekday Siddur app built around the Kol Yaakob Siddur and the Aram Soba (Aleppo) tradition, redesigned with a clean book-style interface for faster daily use.
Browse the Siddur by organized sections, switch between Hebrew-s
bluejetty:00188218:ios.description:
Kol Yaakob is a weekday Siddur app built around the Kol Yaakob Siddur and the Aram Soba (Aleppo) tradition, redesigned with a clean book-style interface for faster daily use.
Browse the Siddur by organized sections, switch between Hebrew-style and English-style book lists, and open the original scanned pages in a focused reader. The reader supports PDF, horizontal or vertical reading, full-height page display, page scrubbing, a section picker, fullscreen double tap, and page bookmarks.
Find what you need quickly with search across section names, Siddur text, and page numbers. Keep important pages saved in the dedicated Bookmarks tab, and use customizable home-screen shortcuts for Zemanim, Search, Bookmarks, and common Siddur sections such as Shacharit, Mincha, Arbit, Birkat Hamazon, Bedtime Shema, Counting the Omer, and Hallel.
Kol Yaakob also includes a full Zemanim tab based on your current location or a fixed location. View the Hebrew date, Perasha, Shabbat and holiday times, candle lighting, Shabbat end, and morning, afternoon, and evening zemanim. Today's Prayers guidance shows practical reminders for Tachanun, Hallel, Al HaNissim, Ya'aleh VeYavo, seasonal Amidah changes, Sefirat HaOmer and a new jump to Torah feature that takes you right to the Perasha of the week when appropriate.
Tap many zmanim and prayer rules for short explanations, and export the current Zemanim page as a PDF. Fixed-location settings include ZIP lookup, current-location autofill, latitude, longitude, altitude, Israel/Diaspora mode, and candle-lighting offset. Settings also show upcoming candle-lighting times.
Additional tools include a direction-to-Jerusalem compass, light/dark/system appearance options, and reader controls for the way you prefer to use the Siddur.
This app is intended for weekday use and should not be used on Shabbat or Yom Tov.

bluejetty:00136700:ios.name: SailTies: Logbook GPS Tracking
bluejetty:00136700:ios.summary:
SailTies: Track and Connect on Your Sailing Adventures
Join thousands of sailing enthusiasts who choose SailTies as their trusted sailing companion. With a digital logbook that makes logging every mile and route effortless, SailTies ensure
bluejetty:00136700:ios.description:
SailTies: Track and Connect on Your Sailing Adventures
Join thousands of sailing enthusiasts who choose SailTies as their trusted sailing companion. With a digital logbook that makes logging every mile and route effortless, SailTies ensures every voyage is meticulously recorded with precision and ease.
Your Digital Logbook:
Automatically transform your sailing experiences into a meticulously kept logbook. Record detailed logs of each voyage, including the vessel's information, weather conditions, photos, videos and crew details. This digital logbook is not just a record but a treasure trove of memories and valuable data that can elevate your sailing experience.
Comprehensive GPS Tracking and Live Updates:
Track and share your sailing route live as you travel. The SailTies app provides detailed tracking of your position and movement, helping you focus on the fun of sailing, knowing your friends and family can monitor progress and conditions in real time. From speed to trajectory, every aspect of your voyage is recorded in your digital logbook.
Key Features: 
SIMPLE VOYAGE TRACKING:
- One-tap logbook tracking
- Simple start & stop tracking, using phone GPS
- Route map, key stats and location information generated automatically
- Low battery usage
- Voyage recovery in case your phone turns off
- Works offline, perfect for at sea
- Add photos and logs for rich memories
COLLABORATE WITH CREW:
- Only one person needs to record a voyage
- Everyone gets the voyage on their profile
- Add photos and logs together
AUTOMATIC SAILOR RESUME:
- Profile stays up to date automatically
- Easily prove your sailing experience, with a public link to your profile
- Interesting statistics calculated for you!
- Export PDF of your sailing resume to send to charter companies etc.
- A digital record of your sailing qualifications
COMPARE SAILING WITH FRIENDS
- View friend's achievements and see who's been logging the most miles!
- Easy to invite other sailors you know and crew with
- Get notified when friends go sailing
GROUPS & CLUBS:
- Setup a free group page for your existing sailing community
- Compete on the leaderboard
- Get notified when friends go sailing
SAILTIES PLUS:
- Automatic historic weather data on your voyages
- Weather records added to your sailing resume
- Group voyages together into collections, perfect for sailing trips and courses
- Upload videos to voyages
Why Choose SailTies?
Reliable Tracking: SailTies' advanced GPS system ensures you can always pinpoint your exact location with high precision. Whether you're exploring uncharted territories or staying close to familiar shores, our GPS keeps you informed every step of the way.
Live Tracking: Share the highlights of your trips. Showcase your routes, locations, and all the fun moments to friends and family on social media platforms. This feature turns your sailing experiences into shareable stories, connecting you more deeply with your social circles.
Rich Logbook Entries: Our digital logbook allows you to capture every detail of your journeys at sea with just a tap. Simply click to start and stop GPS tracking for your voyage. This information is invaluable for improving your sailing strategies and maintaining a historical record of your experiences.
Boating Certification Wallet: Store digital copies of your boating certificates in one secure & accessible place.
Vibrant Sailing Community: Engage with SailTies' global community of sailing enthusiasts. Connect with other sailors to broaden your horizons and deepen your love for sailing.
Cherished Sailing Memories: Capture and preserve your sailing experiences with photos and videos, creating a visual diary that brings your sea tales to life.
Download SailTies now to elevate your sailing experience with our GPS tracking and comprehensive digital logbook.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00172170:ios.summary: Easy scorekeeping for your basketball team on your iPhone or iPad. Stat trackers can share box scores via Email, Facebook, Twitter or a simple link. Great for parents, coaches and fans. All for free! Best basketball stats app out there for
bluejetty:00172170:ios.description:
Easy scorekeeping for your basketball team on your iPhone or iPad. Stat trackers can share box scores via Email, Facebook, Twitter or a simple link. Great for parents, coaches and fans. All for free! Best basketball stats app out there for youth, high school, AAU, college or pro. 
Easy Stats makes stat keeping simple by focusing on your team's players. The opponent's stats are tracked as a team so you don't need to manually add or track their players.
Features:
Unlimited teams, games, and players for free.
All the major stat groups (same as box scores on espn.com).
2 fast touches to record any stat.
Share box scores via Facebook/Twitter/Email or simply paste a link into any other app.
Analyze trends like net point difference, points per game, minutes and more for teams, players and groups of players.
AI powered game recaps.
Shot charts.
Game flow chart.
Rank and sort lineup groups by different stats.
Export data in CSV format.
Compare stats with head-to-head matchup view.
Easy to use and much more!
Reviews:
"I have been using this app for 3 years for my daughter’s AAU and High School teams. Very easy to use and the parents and coaches love getting the emailed stats after every game. The Season Stats feature is awesome! I had tried many others before using Easy Stats but this one worked best and was the easiest to use. I recommend using this app over other stat apps it is really easy to use."
-Nadster
"For our team it is the easiest way to keep game stats for our players. It's easy and quick and you won't miss viewing the game trying to log stats"
-E&ADahl
"Simple and easy, hassle free score keeping and stat recording. I love how it shows how much time is played per player"
-WakeBorden
For more information, see our terms of service and privacy policy: https://www.easystatsapp.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00086771:ios.description:
Conheça o HUB3, onde investimentos, apoio educacional, informações e análises de mercado financeiro se encontram em um único lugar!
Com esse aplicativo, você tem um mundo de possibilidades para apoiar seus investimentos.
Oferecemos uma experiência única, combinando ferramentas de controle de investimentos, redes sociais, notícias e análises do mercado financeiro em um único aplicativo completo e fácil de usar.
Nossa missão é estar ao seu lado conectando você a uma comunidade de empreendedores em investimentos, como você.
Principais recursos do HUB3:
1. Gestão de investimentos: Monitore todos os seus investimentos em um só lugar. Tenha uma visão clara e organizada, de fácil acesso, para alcançar seus objetivos financeiros.
2. Rede social: Participe de debates em uma comunidade diversa, formada por empresas, investidores e especialistas. Obtenha insights valiosos e fique atualizado sobre as tendências do mercado financeiro.
3. Análise de Mercado: Acesse dados em tempo real, indicadores fundamentalistas, gráficos e publicações. Fique por dentro das últimas notícias e tendências do mercado para tomar decisões impactantes sobre seus investimentos.
4. Apoio Educacional: Desenvolva-se com uma variedade de recursos, incluindo cursos, artigos e tutoriais ministrados por especialistas experientes no mercado financeiro.
5. Notificações Personalizadas: Receba alertas e atualizações personalizadas sobre suas ações, criptomoedas e outros ativos financeiros, para que você esteja sempre com a carteira de ativos competitivos e pronto para aproveitar oportunidades.
O HUB3 é seu guia completo para explorar o mundo das finanças de forma inteligente, conectado socialmente e com o apoio necessário para alcançar o sucesso. Baixe agora e comece a transformar suas finanças pessoais em um futuro financeiro promissor!

bluejetty:00021624:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform to find and sell new and used RVs, including motorhomes, travel trailers, fifth wheels, camper vans, toy haulers, truck and pop-up campers, and other RVs. Whether you’re a buyer, private seller, or an RV dealer, RVUniverse makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the RV industry fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF RV LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse thousands of listings for motorhomes, travel trailers, fifth wheels, toy haulers, camper vans, pop-up campers, and other recreational vehicles. Plus, find parts, accessories, and components to customize your RV experience. 
Once you’ve narrowed your search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired RV and its specifications. Contact sellers directly to secure the best deal and explore financing and delivery options offered by RVUniverse’s trusted partners. 
The RVUniverse app features advanced search tools that allow you to filter listings by type, make, model, location, condition, length, sleeping capacity, floor plan features, and other specifications. Save time with personalized search filters and find exactly what you need. 
EASILY TRACK RVs YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite RVs, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to let sellers know what you’re searching for. Stay updated with new listings and personalized alerts via email, and browse category pages updated daily with fresh inventory. 
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
Whether you’re an RV dealer or an independent seller, RVUniverse connects you with thousands of qualified buyers actively searching for recreational vehicles, camping trailers, and truck campers. 
Consign your inventory with RVUniverse to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your RVUniverse app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device. 
CHOOSE THE RVUNIVERSE APP FOR YOUR NEXT RV ADVENTURE
Whether you’re upgrading your RV or selling your camper, RVUniverse connects you with a vast inventory of recreational vehicles and camping equipment and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, RVUniverse links you to a network that includes TractorHouse, Truck Paper, AuctionTime, and other trusted platforms. Access listings from Winnebago, Forest River, Thor Motor Coach, Coachmen, Tiffin, Jayco, Airstream, Keystone, and other top manufacturers. 
GET THE RVUNIVERSE APP NOW 
Thousands of RV dealers, adventurers, and sellers trust RVUniverse to manage their operations. Download the app today to find your next RV or sell with ease!

bluejetty:00023893:ios.description:
ClockZ is a clock app that displays accurate current time. The largest digital clock is always displayed on the screen and can be extensively customized. In addition to the basic clock features, you can use the timer, alarm, stopwatch, widget, and many other features for free.
Free Features
• Digital/Analog Clock
• Option to display or hide seconds, date, and day of the week
• Music alarm (wake-up alarm)
• Timer
• Stopwatch
• Widget (current time display)
• Photo backgrounds
• Automatic unlock (no sleep when the app is launched)
• Tap for full screen
• Clock font settings
• Clock size adjustment (pinch gesture)
• Four-directional rotation (portrait and landscape)
Design：
• Large and easy-to-read clock
• Versatility
• Optimized for nighttime use
Frequently Asked Questions
Q. About the 24-hour time format
A. You can change it by going to Settings → General → Date & Time → 24-Hour Time.
Q. Why isn’t the alarm sounding?
A. Please check that notifications are enabled by launching the app, tapping the + button, and going to Settings. Also, ensure that your ringtone volume, silent mode, and the set time are correct.
Q. What about time discrepancies?
A. ClockZ synchronizes with your device’s time. Please check the time settings on your device.
About ClockZ Premium：
• ClockZ Premium is $2.99/month (US dollar standard)

bluejetty:00118727:ios.summary:
*** For the latest features and enhancements, please check out our NEW Accounts 3 Checkbook app, now available for download from the App Store! ***
Featured by Apple in "What's Hot" List
Accounts 2 is an easy to use application to replace
bluejetty:00118727:ios.description:
*** For the latest features and enhancements, please check out our NEW Accounts 3 Checkbook app, now available for download from the App Store! ***
Featured by Apple in "What's Hot" List
Accounts 2 is an easy to use application to replace your paper checkbook. With the Accounts 2 application, you will have a quicker and more convenient way to track your daily finances. You can schedule transactions, transfer funds, capture photo receipts, reconcile, view reports, export data, print, and much more. All features of the Accounts 2 app are designed to be quick, clean, intuitive, and easy to use. 
FEATURES
* Touch and Face ID Support
Use Touch or Face ID to authenticate and launch the app quicker and more conveniently.
* Sync Data via iCloud
Sync your data across iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch devices
* Universal Binary
Designed for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch devices. No need to buy separate apps for each device. 
* Graphs and Reports
Review your monthly income vs. expense, spending by category, or income by category summaries with beautiful graphs and reports. 
* Photo Receipts
Capture and store photo receipt as part of a transaction. 
* AirPrint Support
Print reports directly from your iPhone or iPad to any AirPrint-enabled printer.
* Recurring Transactions
Schedule transactions to repeat weekly, biweekly, monthly, semimonthly, quarterly, biannually, or yearly on a start date that you choose. 
* Split Transactions
Split a transaction among several categories for more precise tracking. 
* Search
Quickly search for transactions and edit them from the same screen. 
* Reconcile Transactions
Reconcile by checking off cleared transactions and comparing the actual and outstanding balances against a bank statement.
* Smart Autocomplete
As you type, a list will show you your previously entered descriptions and corresponding category. Selecting an entry from the list will fill both fields of the transaction. 
* Auto-increment Check # Field
Accounts 2 will suggest the next check number for you based on the previously entered number. If you replace your checkbook, just enter the new starting number and Accounts 2 will auto-increment from there. 
* Transfers
Make a one-time transfer between accounts or set up recurring transfers to automatically repeat.
* Export in CSV, QIF & HTML Formats
Export transactions via email attachments for used with desktop applications such Numbers, Excel, or MS Money. 
* Customization Settings & Themes
Configurable settings and themes to customize the Accounts 2 application based on your preferences. 
* Transaction Sorting/Hiding
Sort transactions by date in either ascending or descending order. You can also hide reconciled transactions to keep your current list from being cluttered. 
* Accounts Reordering
Reorder your accounts from the account list in any order you choose. 
* Accounts Delete Lock 
Prevents accidental deletion of all the transactions under an account. 
* Backup / Restore 
Backup your data for safekeeping via email, Dropbox, or iTunes file sharing interface. Then restore it to your device whenever you need to.
* Passcode Security
Keep your accounts information private. 
* FREE Accounts 2 Lite version
Please download the Accounts 2 Lite version to try before you buy.

Loigiaihay.com (còn được gọi Lời Giải Hay, loi giai hay) giúp các bạn học sinh và phụ huynh tìm kiếm lời giải bài tập sách giáo khoa (SGK), sách bài tập, sách tham khảo cũng như lý thuyết tóm tắt theo từng bài học cho tất cả các môn: Toán học, Vật Lý, Hóa học, Sinh học, Văn học, tiếng việt, Tiếng anh, Lịch sử, Địa lý,.. cho tất cả các lớp 12, lớp 11, lớp 10, lớp 9, lớp 8, lớp 7, lớp 6, lớp 5, lớp 4, lớp 3, lớp 2, lớp 1 đầy đủ.
App được thiết kế đặc biệt để các bạn học sinh phụ huynh có thể:
1. Dễ dàng tìm kiếm: Chỉ cần chọn ô “Tìm kiếm” trên cùng bên phải và gõ tên bài muốn tìm sẽ thấy các bài viết bạn cần.
2. Lưu bài đã xem: Bạn có thể lưu lại các bài để xem lại đơn giản bằng cách bấm nút “Lưu” ở cuối mỗi bài để xem lại ngay cả khi không có mạng
3. Dễ dàng đổi môn: chỉ cần chọn môn phía trên cùng, bạn có thể chọn các môn quan tâm sau đó lựa chọn các chuyên đề hoặc bài tập hay lý thuyết để học
4. Đổi lớp khi cần: Việc chọn lớp sẽ chỉ cần làm duy nhất một lần, học sinh có thể chuyển lớp khác bằng cách chọn đổi lớp ở danh mục trong app.
5. Dễ dàng chuẩn bị trước bài học cho hôm sau bằng cách xem các bài viết tiếp theo trong phần bài viết liên quan.
Với nội dung phong phú đầy đủ, lời giải chi tiết, hấp dẫn cùng những tiện ích vô cùng hữu ích. Lời giải hay sẽ đồng hành, giúp các em học tốt trong suốt thời gian cắp sách đến trường.
Điều khoản sử dụng: https://loigiaihay.com/policy/vi.html

bluejetty:00019061:ios.description:
Draw N Guess Multiplayer is one of the best real-time online multiplayer games. This game is all about drawing and guessing the word online with your friends and family. The fun begins when you get connected with thousands of people around the world and start playing with them. 
An exclusive mobile game that can be played by anyone, anytime and anywhere in the world while talking with them through group voice chat. The objective of Draw N Guess multiplayer game is, one player has to draw the word and the other players should guess the word and vice-versa. A turn based drawing and guessing game mode is also available which helps to express your artistic skills. So, here you get to experience the craziness of the players with their funny guesses and sketches.
Highlights:
* An online real-time Drawing and Guessing game providing a platform to exhibit your artwork. 
* Best Pictionary type game
* 2 to 6 players can play together online
* Talk while you play through group voice chat
* Play at your own pace in the turn based drawing and guessing game mode.
* Unlock the distinct color sets, paints, crayons, stickers, smileys and variety of brushes for best painting and drawing experience.
* Guess the word of the drawing based on the artistic skill of the painter.
* Draw awesome doodles in the turn based game mode.
* Start with a quick game and match up with the new players around the world.
* Play with your friends and family in a party mode alongside chatting and talking with them.
* Find new friends showcasing your drawing and appreciate each other through chat.
* Get connected socially through FACEBOOK and share your drawings if they are cool.
* Winning the games by completing the achievements fetches you precious trophies and coins.
* Playing well automatically progresses your way to top the global leaderboard.
How to play ?
Register an account by logging in using Facebook or Google. Or play as a guest.
Click PLAY NOW --> QUICK GAME
The fun begins here! If it’s your turn to Draw, start drawing pretty pictures for the given word. If it’s your turn to Guess, start making funny guesses. Beware!!! To win a round, you need to be the first one to guess the word. So hold on tight and start making guesses!
You get bonus points too, if you play good. 
The fun doesn't stop here. You can also play with your DRAW N GUESS friends online by clicking PLAY NOW --> PLAY WITH FRIENDS
You can play live games with your family, friends or other players from all around the world.
Turn Based Game Mode:
Enjoy the fun and addictive turn-based drawing and guessing game with infinite time on the clock in this mode. Sketch, paint and show your creativity with colors. You could also guess what other artists have drawn and challenge your friends and family to find your drawing in this mode.
Sounds simple, but it's unbelievable how amazingly fun and addictive Draw N Guess can become! 
So what are you waiting for? Download Draw N Guess and start having FUN!!!!!
If you like Draw N Guess, please support us by rating the app.

bluejetty:00137777:ios.name: Premier Soccer Leagues Canada
bluejetty:00137777:ios.summary: The PSLC MatchDay app will keep you up to date with fixtures, results, team lineups, match events, statistics, and other interesting information, for every official soccer competition in Premier Soccer Leagues Canada (Ontario Premier League
bluejetty:00137777:ios.description:
The PSLC MatchDay app will keep you up to date with fixtures, results, team lineups, match events, statistics, and other interesting information, for every official soccer competition in Premier Soccer Leagues Canada (Ontario Premier League, British Columbia Premier League, Alberta Premier League, Prairies Premier League). You can use the app to track your favourite teams, players or matches, check their individual profiles, and receive a notification whenever a match event related to your favourites, such as a goal, booking, or the final whistle, is recorded onto the COMET Canada Soccer system.
**Matches**
- Team starting lineups, substitutes, coaches, and team officials
- Chronological timeline of match events including goals, yellow and red cards, substitutions, start and end times of each half, extra time, and penalties
- Additional match information such as the match officials, the playing venue, attendance, and team kits
- Ability to follow matches in real-time mode
**Competitions**
- Results of matches that have already been played and schedule of upcoming matches
- Comprehensive Table/Standings for League (Round-Robin) Competitions, including Form
- Competition statistics including top goal scorers, assists, yellow cards, and red cards, including filter by team
**Players**
- Previous appearances with full match data
- Easy to understand colour coding of the match outcome for the player’s team (Green = Win, Yellow = Draw, Red = Loss)
- Aggregate player statistics grouped by competition including appearances, minutes played, goals scored, yellow cards and red cards
- Animated confetti view of player’s goals and other match events, which can then be shared with friends
**Clubs and Teams**
- Results of previous matches, with full match data
- Upcoming fixtures
- Easy to understand colour coding of the match outcome (Green = Win, Yellow = Draw, Red = Loss)
- Contact Details of the Club/Team with deep-links to relevant apps installed on the device (Phone Call, Email Client, Browser, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Maps)
**Geo-location**
- Map View of all matches played on a certain date using stadium Geo-location and centred using device location
- Colouring of Pins based on match status (green – live, yellow – postponed, red – cancelled, dark blue – played, light blue – to be played)
- Choice of map overlays from six different options. Smart pin clustering depending on map zoom.
- Deep-link to Map Apps installed on the device (such as Google Maps) from Map View, Match Info Tab, Club Contacts Tab
**Favourites and Notifications**
- Search players, clubs or competitions with autocomplete feature
- Add Match, Team, Player or Competition to favourites for convenient quick access in the future
- Receive real-time push notifications for all events on your favourite matches, on all matches of your favourite teams, on all matches in your favourite competitions
- Receive real-time push notifications on all matches where any of your favourite players is in the lineup
- All match event details are contained within the notification: minute, event type (goal, substitution, yellow card, red card, final whistle), player, club and logo
- Contextual football-specific sounds/alerts upon receiving a match event notification
**Other Features**
- Share any application screen with a deep link to the app
- Access Premier Soccer Leagues Canada's news updates from the app
- Customize the display of your news sources and notification settings

- Contextual football-specific sounds/alerts upon receiving a match event notification

- Share any application screen with a deep link to the app
    
- Access Premier Soccer Leagues Canada's news updates from the app

bluejetty:00175705:ios.summary: Do you remember the good old days when you would spend hours playing in Spider Solitaire on your computer? You can relive those cherished moments by indulging in this timeless card game on your smartphone! Our Vita Spider Solitaire offers y
bluejetty:00175705:ios.description:
Do you remember the good old days when you would spend hours playing in Spider Solitaire on your computer? You can relive those cherished moments by indulging in this timeless card game on your smartphone! Our Vita Spider Solitaire offers you the classic gameplay you love and many new features and enhancements, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience than ever!
At Vita Studio, we have always been dedicated to crafting mobile games designed for seniors that bring back relaxation, fun, and joy. Our repertoire includes popular titles like Vita Solitaire, Vita Color, Vita Jigsaw, Vita Word Search, Vita Block, and more.
What makes Vita Spider Solitaire the perfect choice for seniors?
• Classic Gameplay but Built with Seniors in Mind: Enjoy the authentic Spider Solitaire gameplay with rules and a scoring system optimized for seniors.
• User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive touch controls, Large buttons, and customizable settings make playing on any smartphone or tablet effortless.
• Senior-Centric Design: Enhanced card sizes and bigger fonts make it easier for those who might have trouble seeing to identify and read the cards, reducing eye strain and ensuring a comfortable gaming experience.
• Two-row layout option: Splitting cards into two separate rows enhances accessibility and ease of operation, especially for older adults who might have problems with their fine motor skills.
• Night Mode: Enjoy a night mode feature that provides an eye-friendly play environment during low-light conditions.
• Eye Protection Mode: The eye protection mode reduces blue light emissions and adjusts overall brightness, providing additional comfort for seniors during extended gameplay sessions.
• Daily Heartwarming Quotes: Receive uplifting daily quotes via push notifications within the app or on your home screen, adding a touch of inspiration and positivity to your gaming experience.
What are the benefits of playing Vita Spider Solitaire for seniors?
• Relax Your Mind: Spider Solitaire demands focus and strategic thinking, diverting your attention from everyday stressors and helping you feel calm. Playing Vita Spider Solitaire can help you alleviate stress while giving you a sense of accomplishment. 
• Enhance Your Memory: Playing involves tracking card positions, identifying patterns, and recalling previous moves, which aids in memory improvement and enhanced focus.
• Train Your Brain: Vita Spider Solitaire keeps your mind sharp by challenging you to strategize, problem-solve, and think critically.
How to Play?
Playing Spider Solitaire is both easy and enjoyable! The goal is to arrange all the cards in descending order, from King to Ace, within each suit. While Spider Solitaire is traditionally played with two decks of standard playing cards, with our version, you can adjust the difficulty by choosing between 1 to 4 suits. Start your journey as a novice with 1 and 2 suit games and gradually escalate the challenge by attempting 3 and 4 suit games, aiming to become a true Spider Solitaire expert!
Additional Features:
• Daily Challenges: Earn crowns and trophies by conquering each new problem.
• Spiderette Mode: Play with one deck instead of two.
• Custom Card Suits: Adjust game difficulty with 1-4 decks.
• True Random Shuffling for Authentic Play.
• Unlimited Undos and Hints.
• Custom Card Decks and Backgrounds.
• Right and Left-Handed Mode.
• No Wi-Fi Required.
Download now and experience how easy and user-friendly our Vita Spider Solitaire game is!

With the SATA Loyalty Program coins & more, SATA rewards loyal customers with SATA coins that can be exchanged for high-quality rewards.
The SATA Loyalty Program coins & more is open to every purchaser of a premium-eligible SATA product or
bluejetty:00119549:ios.description:
With the SATA Loyalty Program coins & more, SATA rewards loyal customers with SATA coins that can be exchanged for high-quality rewards.
The SATA Loyalty Program coins & more is open to every purchaser of a premium-eligible SATA product or employee of a company purchasing premium-eligible products. The participant or the company must be domiciled in a country (see below) where the programme is offered. As an employee, a participant also needs the consent of his or her employer in accordance with the conditions set out in the terms and conditions of participation. In addition, only natural persons who are at least 18 years old are eligible to participate.
See Conditions of Participation under www.sata.com/coins-and-more
Collecting SATA coins is done by scanning a Loyalty QR code, which is located in a shrink-wrapped booklet on the packaging of SATA RPS multi-purpose cups. During selected periods, customers benefit from promotions exclusively for participants of the SATA Loyalty Programme coins & more, e.g. additional coins with every scan, reduced SATA coin prices in the SATA Loyalty Shop or competitions with exclusive prizes. 
1. Download app & register
2. Scan QR code & collect SATA coins
3. Redeem SATA coins for valuable rewards.
Here you will find Loyalty QR codes that you can scan to collect SATA coins
There is one SATA coin per SATA RPS multi-purpose cup.
A pack of 40 cups gives 40 SATA coins, a pack of 60 cups gives 60 SATA coins, a pack of 100 gives 100 SATA coins. Please note that there are also loyalty QR codes on the boxes of the replacement lids for SATA RPS multi-purpose cups, which you can use to collect SATA coins.
Collect more SATA coins
- Receive first SATA coins for your registration during certain promotional periods.
- Receive SATA coins for your birthday.
- Take part in surveys and contribute to SATA's ability to offer you even better products and an optimum service. In certain promotion periods, we reward you with SATA coins for your participation or you take part in a competition as a participant.
- Receive additional SATA coins within special promotion periods for subscribing to the SATA Newsletter, the SATA Loyalty News or the Push Notifications.
Exclude company from participation.
If you do not wish yourself or any of your employees to participate, your company can choose not to register and make a general deregistration via SATA, which will exclude all employees of the company from participation.
This can be done at www.sata.com/coins-and-more-exclusion.
All information on the SATA Loyalty Program coins & more is available at www.sata.com/coins-and-more.

Celebrate Every Step of Your Weight Journey 
Vekt is the smart weight tracker designed to help you understand your patterns like no other app. Whether you're focused on weight loss or gain, enjoy zero clutter, achievable targets that keep you on track, smart insights that help you understand your trends, and endless motivational support to reach your healthy weight. And it works! 74% of Vekt users notice a healthy change after just 3 weigh-ins. Vekt supports weight gain, weight loss, and maintain mode. With the tailored insights Vekt provides, rest assured, you will have the information you need to uniquely understand your body and reach your weight goals faster.
Effortless Weight Logging 
Log your weight instantly with your iPhone or Apple Watch. A simple tap and swipe make daily tracking hassle-free. All data syncs with Apple Health and is accessible in apps that use Apple Health weight, height, and BMI data. 
Track Your Habits 
Gain a deeper understanding of factors like meal timing, food quality, and activity levels. Small changes lead to big results, and Vekt helps you identify what uniquely works for your body and what doesn’t. Vekt makes it easy to see patterns between your habit and your weight changes with effortless habit journals.
Visualize Your Progress 
See your weekly and monthly weight changes on intuitive, eye-catching charts. Understand your patterns, see your trends, uncover insights, and watch your progress unfold. Vekt's intuitive interface presents your weight insights in an easily digestible format.
Designed for People Serious About Their Weight
Whether you're losing, gaining, or maintaining weight for yourself, your partner or an upcoming event, Vekt provides the tools and insights you need to succeed. It's the perfect companion for your health and fitness journey. 
Simplify Your Routine 
Say goodbye to manual logging and juggling multiple apps. Vekt combines simplicity and effectiveness for seamless weight management. 
Stay Motivated 
Celebrate milestones, monitor habits, and uncover trends. With Vekt, you’re not just tracking weight—you’re seeing your efforts pay off every step of the way. Add your goals, see your efforts pay off, and enjoy a motivational boost every step of the way. 
Privacy First 
Your data remains private. Vekt ensures your weight and health information is securely stored in Apple Health and never shared (even with us!)

bluejetty:00186710:ios.description:
◆◆15 million (*1) total downloads reached!!◆◆
A fun and easy-to-use app that allows you to have fun lining up dominoes and making them topple over.
There are two play modes available: "Easy Mode, and "Edit and Test Mode."
*Easy Mode
A dynamic mode that gives you a diagonal view from the top.
When you drag the stage, the dominoes are lined up and then they will start toppling over at the same time.
Tap on the stage to make a ball appear.
Depending on how you touch the screen, you can line up an infinite number of dominoes from far away to up close, giving you enough options to keep you entertained.
*Edit and Test Mode
This mode gives you a view straight from the top. Though it features a fairly simple design, it allows you to build whatever you like.
Drag on the stage to line up the dominoes.
The bottom right of the screen shows an item palette. Drag on an item from this palette to place it on the stage.

bluejetty:00016357:ios.description:
Eugene’s AR Wiki – Augmented Reality, Learning & Adventure!
Step into a world where learning, playing, and exploring come alive right before your eyes. Eugene’s AR Wiki invites you to discover lifelike AR animals, dinosaurs, and educational models, dive into a fascinating knowledge-packed wiki, and challenge yourself with engaging word games. Whether you're at home, outside, or on the go, every setting becomes an interactive playground of discovery.
3 Main Categories to Explore:
1. 3D Models (AR Animals & More)
Bring virtual creatures and objects to life - from farm animals and wild animals, to dinosaurs, birds, sea creatures, insects, and science models. Walk around them, engage with animations, and capture stunning photos and videos to share.
2. Wiki (Educational Content)
Unlock fascinating facts about each animal or object. From domestic pets and exotic wildlife to prehistoric giants - each model includes informative details to play and learn.
3. Games (Word Games)
Enjoy brain-boosting fun with mini-games like Word Guess, 1 Pic – 4 Words, and 4 Words – 1 Pic. Great for kids, families, or solo puzzle fans.
Why You’ll Love Eugene’s AR Wiki:
1. Explore a massive collection of AR animals and 3D models with realistic movement and scale.
2. Learn fascinating facts from the built-in interactive Wiki.
3. Play addictive word games to sharpen your brain.
4. Use camera filters to snap memorable photos and videos with virtual creatures.
5. Suitable for all ages - infants, kids and adults alike.
Whether you're walking with a dinosaur, discovering your spirit animal, or solving word puzzles, Eugene’s AR Wiki delivers an enriching blend of education and entertainment.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014943:ios.description:
Learn to play the tuba and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the tuba and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your tuba easily.
tonestro for Tuba offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your tuba skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your tuba fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with tuba players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the tuba or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover tuba lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your tuba with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the tuba or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the tuba. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your tuba.
For experienced tuba players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better tuba player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your tuba but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play tuba songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your tuba.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs.
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with tuba players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best tuba player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.
tonestro requires a subscription to access the entire learning content and song library. Each subscription plan may include a 3-day free trial period.
Terms: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00062256:ios.description:
For 16 years the most advanced geographic encyclopedia and quiz on the App Store.
Did you know…
…Bhutan is a country in Southeastern Asia?
…Romania has the same flag as Chad?
…the highest peak of Africa is Kilimanjaro in Tanzania?
…India is 7th largest country of the world?
…Buenos Aires is the capital of Argentina?
…Singapore is an island country?
This app is an ideal companion for people who want to learn more about geography. It includes more than 50 thousand facts about more than 300 countries and territories of the world, including all 50 U.S. states. In addition to browsing the data, you can play 9 types of quiz games about flags, capitals or location of countries.
FREE FEATURES:
• More than 300 countries and territories, grouped into 6 continents.
• Each country or territory has:
– Official name, flag, capital, ISO codes, and political status.
– Location on continent with a mini map.
– Area, highest peak, population, GDP, trade balance, and unemployment rate.
– Official languages and currency, major religions, and urbanization.
– Neighbouring countries, nearby countries, and administered territories.
– Time zones, telephone subscriptions, and internet users.
• Search by names, capitals, highest peaks, and ISO codes.
• Sort and compare all countries by area, population or GDP, with colored map diagrams.
• Play flag quiz for any continent and try demo of all other quizzes.
• Fully accessible using VoiceOver, including many of the quizzes.
IN-APP PURCHASES:
Download the app to see details about content, pricing, and discounts.
(1) Purchase detailed data to learn about population growth, lowest points, largest cities, GDP per capita and growth, and many other attributes.
(2) Purchase all statistics to be able to sort and compare all countries by length of borders or coastline, elevation of highest or lowest point, population density or growth, and many other attributes. You can then export these data to CSV tables and work with them.
(3) Purchase all quizzes to learn flags, capitals, locations, or sizes of all countries. Try blind map quiz or play with all question mixed together. You can win 100% discount for this in-app purchase and have it for FREE. 
If you need an app compatible with Volume Purchase Program, check out “Geography EDU” app with the SAME content.
Main sources of the data are the United Nations, International Monetary Fund, World Bank, and Social Progress Index.

Through this client, you can view your home, shops, offices and other places at any time in real-time video and video history, also receive immediate alert to the place of abnormal information alarm, and take safety precautions at the first time.

Support mobile real-time video surveillance;
Real Time HD video viewing;
Remote PTZ control, operate on the camera direction rotation through the touch screen;

Continuous monthly service, a monthly deduction

For accounts that purchase automatic subscriptions, the cost of the next subscription period will be deducted from your iTunes account 24 hours before the expiration. After the deduction is successful, the service time will be extended by one subscription period.
