Forest Fables is a cozy
bluejetty:00041921:ios.description:
Befriend Animals, Discover Quests. Immerse in Wildleaf Forest, meet 23 animal villagers with heartfelt quests for you!
You help animals, build friendships, and restore joy in the forest — one Bloomsprout at a time.
Forest Fables is a cozy life-sim and emotional mobile RPG handcrafted with soft pixel art, where connection and gentle choices guide your journey. This is an indie narrative game where your choices make a difference. 
________________________________________
A Game About Healing Others—and Finding Yourself
Each animal you meet in this animal friends game has a story. Some are shy. Some are healing. Others just want a shoulder to lean on. Come, make friends with cute and calm animals in this cozy life simulation game. 
+Help Peggy the Pig reconnect with a long-lost friend.
+Unveil your mysterious past with Pudding the Cat.
+Guide Nelly the Near-sighted Giraffe to find confidence.
+Recover the lost belongings of Gideon the Beaver.
A forest life where kindness is remembered—and your friendships shape the story in this mobile friendship game.
________________________________________
Storytelling Through Gentle Choices
+Earn Friendship Stamps to unlock deeper quests
+Collect Bloomsprouts to bring joy back to the forest
+Unlock new areas and uncover hidden stories with Explorer Keys
Progress is guided by relationship—not pressure—in this slow-paced relaxing game that blends story game depth with life sim for adults charm.
________________________________________
Pocket Life with Forest Friends
Minigames become your quiet rituals in this gentle simulation game:
+Become the Best Barista in the town 
+Bake tasty goodies in the cute cooking game
+Farming RPG to grow juicy carrots for forest bunnies 
+Serve ice-cream in relaxing restaurant sim
+Makeover your forest home with adorable furniture
Every task supports emotional connection, not just mechanics in cozy simulation gameplay.
________________________________________
Make It Yours
Express yourself with themed outfits like Forest Cottagecore or Blush Beauty.
Decorate your woodland home with handcrafted furniture inspired by your journey in this decor and dress-up game and cottagecore sim.
________________________________________
Gentle Lessons, Everyday Magic
As you play, discover soft lessons about managing time, saving for future goals, or choosing where to give your energy. Lessons are felt, not forced, making this a kindness game that nurtures reflection.
________________________________________
Indie Game Made with Heart
Forest Fables is an emotional adventure game made for players who seek meaning in the quiet moments. With no merge, no puzzles, and lots of story, it's a lovingly crafted space to relax, reflect, and feel.
If you love:
+Narrative-driven games
+Cozy emotional storytelling
+Pixel art games with heart
+Animal friendship games
+Games where your choices matter
…this is your kind of game.
Note: This game is free to download and play, with advertising available. May include in-app purchases.

bluejetty:00082627:ios.description:
Join the reverse singing challenge that is taking over TikTok and Instagram. Record your voice, reverse the audio with one tap, sing backwards, and share the result with your friends.
The Reverse Audio is a reverse audio recorder and a talk-backwards game in one app. Tap Record, say or sing anything, then tap Reverse to hear it played backwards.
■ Reverse Challenge mode
1. Read the backwards hint out loud and record it
2. Play your recording in reverse
3. Did it turn back into the original word? Then you nailed it!
Three difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Hard), five words per round, and a score you can share. Word lists are available in English, Japanese, Indonesian and Spanish, with hints written the way each word really sounds backwards.
■ What you can do
• Record your voice and reverse audio instantly
• Save and share reversed audio to social media and messaging apps
• Change playback speed (slow motion or fast)
• Pitch shift (high chipmunk voice or deep low voice)
• Echo effect
• Loop playback
• Manage your recordings in a list (rename, delete)
• Import audio files from your device
• Live waveform while recording and playing
■ Ways to play
• Practice the reverse singing challenge and film your attempt
• Talk backwards and see if your friends can guess the word
• Hear your own name played in reverse
• A quick party game for school, family gatherings and sleepovers
• Make funny clips, voice messages and backwards audio for your videos
■ Premium
Recording, playback, reverse audio and the challenge are free. Premium removes ads, unlocks unlimited playback and reverse playback of your saved recordings, and lets you export and share reversed audio.
■ Good to know
• Works offline: no internet connection is needed to record or reverse
• Requires microphone permission for recording
Looking for a reverse audio app, a reverse singing app, a reverse voice recorder or a sing backwards challenge game? Try The Reverse Audio.

Rediscover the magic of this classic game, where every move counts, each victory is satisfying, and every game lets you unwind and sharpen your mind!

bluejetty:00004317:ios.summary:

Download once,
bluejetty:00004317:ios.description:
Every Greek god, hero and monster, in your pocket. Read offline, quiz yourself daily, and follow the family trees of Olympus.
Loved by mythology readers for years. 700+ articles, 2,300+ quiz questions, no account, no sign-up.
Download once, then read, search and listen anywhere, even on a plane.
WHAT YOU GET
- 700+ ARTICLES: Zeus, Athena, Hades and the Olympians; Titans and primordial gods; heroes like Heracles, Perseus and Achilles; creatures like Medusa and the Minotaur; the great myths of the Trojan War and the Odyssey; places from Mount Olympus to the Underworld; and the classical plays.
- WORKS OFFLINE: sync the full library once and read, search and quiz with no connection.
- INSTANT SEARCH: type a name and jump straight to the god, hero, myth or place.
- DAILY QUIZ WITH STREAKS: 2,300+ questions. Take a daily challenge or quiz one section, from Olympians to monsters. Keep your streak alive.
- INTERACTIVE FAMILY TREES: see who fathered whom, who married whom and who fought whom. Pan, zoom and tap any name to open their story.
- AUDIO NARRATIONS: listen to myths while you commute, walk or cook. Background playback and lock-screen controls.
- MYTH OF THE DAY: one new story every morning, with an optional gentle reminder.
- VIDEOS: tap to watch short explainers for deeper dives.
- BOOKMARKS AND HISTORY: save favorites and pick up exactly where you left off.
- DARK MODE AND TEXT SIZE: comfortable reading day or night.
BUILT FOR CURIOUS READERS
Students revising for class, teachers building a lesson, fans of mythology-inspired books and shows, and anyone who has ever wondered who exactly was Zeus's father. Clear, well-organized articles with rich illustrations, cross-linked so one tap leads to the next story.
LIGHT ADS, NO ACCOUNT
The app is free with light, family-safe ads that never appear in the middle of an article. No account is needed, and your bookmarks, history and quiz progress stay on your device.
Questions or ideas? Write to info@greekmythology.com. We read every message.
Download Greek Mythology and start your journey from Chaos to Olympus today.

bluejetty:00043778:ios.description:
DECAF WALLET: A GLOBAL BANK, ON-CHAIN
Send, receive, invest, and cash out money globally—without borders.
Decaf Wallet is the easiest way to hold digital dollars, send money worldwide, and invest—all in one app. A crypto wallet that feels like a neobank, Decaf gives you full control of your money with no intermediaries, hidden fees, or delays. Powered by Solana & Stellar, it’s built for real-world financial freedom, offering instant transactions, gas-free transfers, and seamless fiat off-ramps in 180+ countries. The easiest way to use crypto in real life.
ADD FUNDS EASILY
Top up your wallet via bank transfer, cash, or crypto.
Get a US account – Receive payments from the USA with your own USD account, even if you’re not from the USA.
Social media logins—skip long sign-up processes.
SEND & WITHDRAW ANYWHERE
Send money globally and withdraw in 184 currencies via cash or bank transfer.
Transfer USDC, USDT, SOL, and XLM across Solana and Stellar blockchains in seconds.
Bank withdrawals at the lowest fees – Send money directly to SEPA, MXN, COP, BRL, ARS, USD, and more at the cheapest market rates.
Cash out with MoneyGram – Withdraw digital dollars in 184 currencies at 400,000+ MoneyGram locations—no bank account required.
Gasless transactions—no need to worry about network fees.
Search by username—no complicated wallet addresses needed.
GROW YOUR MONEY
Earn yield by investing in government bonds, DeFi, and crypto.
Swap at the best rates – Convert USDC, USDT, SOL, and XLM directly on-chain using Decaf’s decentralized exchange (DEX)—no centralized exchanges needed.
Debit card coming soon – Spend your crypto anywhere with Decaf’s upcoming crypto-backed credit card.
YOU’RE IN CONTROL
100% non-custodial – You own your private keys, meaning you control your money—no one else.
Decentralized & transparent – Decaf uses Solana & Stellar for ultra-fast, low-cost transactions without intermediaries.
No gas fees – Decaf covers blockchain transaction fees, making transfers smooth and cost-free.
Hold & spend digital dollars – Save in stablecoins (USDC, USDT) to protect against inflation, send money globally, and access funds without banking restrictions.
Built for the global economy – Serving users in Latin America, Africa, and beyond, Decaf provides an affordable, borderless financial solution.
WHO IS DECAF WALLET FOR?
Freelancers & remote workers – Get paid in USDC, USDT, and cash out easily, avoiding high fees and slow bank transfers.
Global travelers & expats – Hold digital dollars and withdraw cash worldwide—no need for a local bank account.
Crypto users & investors – Swap, hold, and manage crypto & stablecoins without relying on centralized exchanges.
Everyday users – Avoid high remittance fees and send money to family instantly with stablecoins.
Small business owners & merchants – Accept crypto payments with no chargebacks, low fees, and fast settlement.
Residents in high-inflation regions – Protect your money from devaluation by storing it in stable digital dollars.
HOW DECAF WALLET WORKS
Download & set up in seconds – No ID or bank required—just create a wallet and get started.
Send & receive crypto – Use USDC, USDT, SOL, XLM, and more for fast, borderless transactions.
Swap at the best rates – Convert your crypto on-chain using Solana and Stellar DEXs, without relying on centralized exchanges.
Invest & grow your money – Earn yield by investing in government bonds, DeFi protocols, and crypto assets.
Withdraw to a bank account – Send funds to SEPA, MXN, COP, BRL, ARS, USD, and more at the lowest market fees.
Cash out with MoneyGram – Withdraw digital dollars in 184 local currencies at thousands of MoneyGram locations worldwide.
Stay in control–Decaf Wallet is non-custodial, meaning only you control your private keys.
DOWNLOAD DECAF WALLET & TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR MONEY
Join thousands of users worldwide using Decaf Wallet for instant, secure, and low-cost crypto transactions.
Get started today and experience the future of financial freedom.

bluejetty:00016949:ios.description:
Like NONOGRAM games? Come play "Pixel Cross™-Puzzle Page Game"!
Like BEAUTIFUL and LOVELY pixel graphics? Come play "Pixel Cross™-Puzzle Page Game"!
In "Pixel Cross™-Puzzle Page Game", the exquisite game graphics and excellent background music will never disappoint you! There are also a large number of game levels waiting for you to challenge!
After each level is passed, players will be rewarded with a beautiful pixel picture, and collect pictures to get extra gem rewards!
Solve logic puzzles to show the hidden picture, complete all levels to get a beautiful background picture!
The multi-theme style chapters will dazzle you, and the large number of pictures will make you linger! Family theme, neighbor theme, town theme, farm theme, beach theme, zoo theme, park theme, the more themes, the more fun!
Insufficient gems? Piggy bank——your good partner to get gems! Buy a piggy bank and win more gem rewards while solving puzzles!
Spin the turntable and win amazing gifts!

●The game screen is designed in pixel style, and the screen is vivid and detailed
●The background music is wonderful and lively, making the game experience more comfortable
●From "very easy" to "expert" difficulty level
●Detailed novice guidance can help beginners get started quickly
●There are many themes of pictures, covering a wide range of content, such as animals, festivals, food, etc
●Unique game functions make your gaming experience more exciting: tips, turntables, piggy bank
●Contains high-difficulty levels with rich rewards
●AUTO-SAVE autosave every puzzle, if you stuck you can try another puzzle and come back later
●NO WI-FI NEEDED Play the game offline at any time! Anywhere ！
●Undo / Redo function provided
●Auto-fill line with 'X' when you mark last number
Download now and start boosting the power of your brain!

bluejetty:00120018:ios.description:
CuriosityStream is the world’s leading documentary and non-fiction streaming service covering science, nature, history, biographies of real characters of consequence and pretty much anything else you can think of. 
Learn about our natural world alongside luminaries like Sir David Attenborough. Look at our universe with wonder as Michio Kaku and Brian Greene broaden your perspective on space, time and the future. Step back in time and explore dinosaurs, ancient history, and the rise of homo sapiens.
Curiositystream also offers CuriosityKIDS, a dedicated collection of safe, entertaining and inspiring programs for families to enjoy together or for kids to watch on their own. Let CuriosityKids spark a love of learning and a passion for exploration. Plus, all CuriosityStream shows are downloadable so you can keep kids entertained while on the go. Whether your kids are budding astronomers, paleontologists, or historians, CuriosityStream has got you covered with award-winning, ad-free content.
Join more than 20 million CuriosityStream subscribers and explore thousands of brain-boosting documentaries. 
CuriosityStream membership benefits:
- Unlimited streaming of the best in documentary programming
- Download shows so you can watch anytime, anywhere without an internet connection
- 4K and HD documentaries available on multiple devices
- New content added weekly so you’ll never run out of things to watch
- Browse titles with multiple search tools to help you quickly find your favorite subject areas
- Rate your favorite shows and get recommendations for related content 
- Bookmark shows to watch later or resume watching previously viewed shows on other devices
You may cancel your membership and stop the billing anytime by logging into your account.
Please Note:
- Payment will be charged to the user's iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
By downloading this application, you agree to the CuriosityStream Terms of Use (https://curiositystream.com/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://curiositystream.com/privacy).

bluejetty:00147879:ios.description:
Introducing the Ultimate JAMB Past Questions and Answers App: Your Path to Exam Success!
Are you preparing for the highly competitive JAMB exams and searching for a comprehensive and reliable resource to help you ace the tests? Look no further! Our state-of-the-art JAMB Past Questions and Answers App is here to revolutionize your exam preparation experience. With thousands of past questions and answers at your fingertips, this app is designed to provide you with the ultimate learning tool for JAMB success.
Key Features:
Extensive Collection of Past Questions and Answers:
Access an extensive database of real JAMB past questions and answers. Our app provides a vast array of subjects and topics, allowing you to practice and familiarize yourself with the actual exam format. Prepare with confidence as you work through thousands of questions, ensuring you're well-prepared for any challenge that may arise.
Offline Access to Past Questions and Answers:
No internet connection? No problem! Our app offers seamless offline access to all past questions and answers. Once you download the app and the question bank, you can study anytime, anywhere, without worrying about internet connectivity. This feature is particularly useful for students in areas with limited internet access or those who prefer studying on the go.
Comprehensive Coverage of JAMB Exams:
Our app caters to all your JAMB needs, covering a wide range of subjects and exam years. Whether you're preparing for Science, Arts, or Commercial subjects, we've got you covered. Additionally, our question bank spans several years, ensuring that you have access to both recent and older exams. This comprehensive coverage enables you to track exam trends and effectively prepare for any question that may come your way.
User-Friendly Interface:
We understand the importance of an intuitive and easy-to-navigate interface when it comes to learning. Our app boasts a user-friendly interface designed to enhance your study experience. Seamlessly navigate through subjects, topics, and questions with ease, saving you valuable time and allowing you to focus on what truly matters—mastering the content.
Practice Mode with Instant Feedback:
Engage in interactive learning with our practice mode feature. Test your knowledge by attempting past questions in a simulated exam environment. Receive immediate feedback on your performance, allowing you to identify areas that require improvement. This invaluable feature helps you track your progress, build confidence, and refine your exam-taking skills.
Performance Analytics and Progress Tracking:
Track your performance and monitor your progress with our advanced analytics tools. Gain valuable insights into your strengths and weaknesses, enabling you to focus your efforts on areas that need improvement. Our performance charts and detailed breakdowns provide a visual representation of your progress, ensuring you stay motivated and on track towards success.
Regular Updates and Support:
Stay up to date with the latest information and announcements related to JAMB exams. Our app provides timely updates on exam schedules, registration deadlines, and any other relevant news. In addition, our dedicated customer support team is available to assist you with any issues or inquiries you may have, ensuring a smooth and hassle-free learning experience.
Prepare for JAMB with confidence, knowing that you have the most comprehensive and reliable resource at your disposal. Download our JAMB Past Questions and Answers App today and embark on your journey to exam success. With offline access, extensive question coverage, and user-friendly features, you'll be well-equipped to conquer the exams and secure your future.
Remember, success awaits those who are prepared. Start your preparation journey now and unlock your full potential with our app. Good luck with your JAMB exams!

bluejetty:00138711:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00138711:ios.description:
Retrain the patterns shaping your mind, body, and habits.
Most of what runs your life isn't a choice — it's a pattern. The 3pm sugar craving. The thought spiral before sleep. The flinch before you speak up. The reach for your phone, the doubt before the gym, the apology you didn't owe.
These patterns live below willpower. That's why discipline rarely fixes them. KURE works at the layer where they actually live — through guided hypnosis designed to rewire the loops that keep replaying.
How it works.
You put on headphones, get comfortable, and listen. That's it. Each session guides you into a focused, relaxed state where your mind is open to new patterns — and then plants them, gently, on repeat. Over time, the old loop loses pull. The new one starts to feel familiar.
What KURE can help you retrain:
• Cravings and emotional eating
• Anxiety, overthinking, racing thoughts
• Sleep that won't come or won't stay
• Confidence, self-talk, social fear
• Procrastination and avoidance loops
• Smoking, drinking, screen habits
• Stress that lives in your body
• Focus, motivation, follow-through
Why hypnosis — and why now.
Hypnosis isn't theatre. It's a clinically studied state of focused attention, used for decades to help people change habits, manage pain, sleep better, and quiet anxiety. KURE brings that same approach into a daily practice you can do from your couch — no clinic, no clock, no pressure.
What's inside:
• Guided pathways tailored to each focus area
• Core sessions, 10 to 30 minutes
• Booster sessions to deepen the work
• Sleep hypnosis tracks that keep working overnight
• Daily affirmations to carry the shift into the day
• Daily check-ins so you can see what's changing
• Sobriety counters for habits you're leaving behind
• Offline listening for travel, flights, and dead zones
• Light mode for daytime use
Built for repeated listening. Patterns formed over years don't dissolve in one session. KURE is designed for the long game — short enough to actually do daily, deep enough to actually work.
Put the headphones in. Let the pattern change.
Terms of Use: https://kureapp.health/general-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://kureapp.health/privacy-policy

Welcome to The MS-IL Group App!
Our app is designed to connect job seekers with career opportunities in manufacturing, warehousing, logistics, and more. Whether you’re looking for temporary or long-term employment, MS-IL makes it easy for you to stay connected with job openings, apply directly, and manage your work schedule — all from one place.

• Track Your Applications: Stay up to date on your job applications and get notified on their status in real-time.

• Direct Communication: Keep in touch with your designated Account Manager or employer and receive important updates on the go.

From flexible shifts to personalized assistance, we’re here to guide you through every step of your job search and provide opportunities for career advancement, including conversions from temp-to-hire to permanent placements. Your future starts with a single tap! Download The MS-IL Group App today and discover new opportunities with just a swipe.

bluejetty:00147204:ios.description:
FileCloud is the best content collaboration platform. It offers secure file sharing, sync and mobile access for small businesses, enterprises, universities, and hosting companies.
With FileCloud, easily secure, protect, and manage your company's data and intellectual property. FileCloud works on your own infrastructure or on-premises. It can be installed on your server, or with a trusted hosting partner. This gives you complete control over your data. 
FileCloud provides seamless mobile access to your existing network shares. Instantly open files, folders, and documents stored in your Enterprise FileCloud. Access company files quickly and securely with iOS devices.
Key Features
Remote File Access – Browse files and documents locally, save them, edit them, then re-upload them.
File Management - Create and delete folders and files, and search for documents from any location.
Sharing - With one click, share selected files and documents to colleagues or business partners.
Preview - Preview PDFs and documents.
Offline Access – Download files directly onto your iOS device to access them offline.
App support - Download files and open them using other applications.
File Versioning - Collaborate effectively using unlimited automatic file versioning.
Note: This app requires a FileCloud server to function. Your company provides this and an account for you.
No user data is collected.

bluejetty:00144637:ios.description:
LAAX APP – Get more mountain! 
Within EXPLORE you can find almost everything you need or want in LAAX, from the weather report to Q-alert webcams to your next delicious fondue. In addition, PLAY features new challenges and badges, the much-loved leaderboards and your personal statistics in one completely revamped, user-friendly view. This season, the SHOP is more versatile, personalized and appealing than ever, with new products ranging from tickets to merchandise. The SHOP also supports search, so if you can book it on the app, you can also search for it! 
EXPLORE your LAAX 
Wanna quickly check the open lifts, weather forecast and Q-alert cams? EXPLORE contains all the information you need for a perfect day on the mountain. New, intuitive, quick links give you access to all that essential live information with just one click. Also, from the EXPLORE home, swipe up to view all the content that has been specifically curated and personalized for you in your newsfeed. Whether it’s a bank, bakery or burger you’re looking for, you can now use the search in EXPLORE to learn the ins and outs of the destination. Find the restaurants you’re looking for and while you’re at it, reserve a table or order your meal with Mobile Ordering. 
SHOP for your ultimate mountain experience 
The shop has been redesigned to showcase the best deals on lift tickets and unique experiences available only in Laax. Find the perfect lift ticket for you, manage your keycards and head up the mountain in an easier and faster check-out flow than ever before.
If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact feedback@laax.com. We would be happy to help you!

bluejetty:00097621:ios.description:
A MED-Review surge com a missão de revolucionar o ensino das especialidades médicas. A plataforma digital, que já conta com mais de 3.500 alunos matriculados desde a sua criação em 2020, oferece uma solução completa para preparar o médico especialista não apenas para as provas de título e concursos, mas também para a vida profissional! 
Com o aplicativo MED-Review 1.0, os alunos elevarão o nível de treinamento com questões para outro patamar! Você terá a sua disposição:
ÁREA DE TREINAMENTO
1. Banco com milhares de questões comentadas em texto e vídeo pelos professores do curso.
2. Personalize o seu treinamento com vários filtros: especialidade, tipo de prova, anos, tema, subtema e até mesmo palavra-chave (no enunciado ou nas alternativas)
3. Assista à aulas em qualquer lugar, mesmo sem internet com a opção de download!
4. Revise flashcards e mantenha seu estudo consistente
5. Participe ativamente da comunidade MED-Review adicionando comentários às questões e enriquecendo o conteúdo a cada nova geração de alunos!
6. Gostou de uma questão ou um comentário específico? Com a função favoritar você cria o seu próprio pool de questões favoritas!

bluejetty:00095412:ios.description:
Uncover Hidden Messages and Train Your Brain with the Ultimate Cryptogram Puzzle Game
Step into a world of logic, mystery, and intellectual challenge with this all-new cryptogram puzzle game. Designed for thinkers, word game lovers, and puzzle fans alike, this game brings a modern twist to the classic cryptogram format. Each day presents a new encrypted message for you to decode - a famous quote, a clever saying, or a timeless proverb - all waiting to be uncovered. Whether you're looking to relax or give your brain a serious workout, this is the game for you.
Key Features:
Complete Rings: Stay motivated by playing the code games every day to fill your daily progress rings.
Train Your Brain: Improve memory, sharpen reasoning, and strengthen problem-solving skills.
Cryptogram Logic Puzzles: Thousands of handcrafted brain puzzles, and encrypted quotes to decode.
Daily Challenges: Return every day for a fresh cryptogram code games, and keep your solving streak going.
No Timers or Pressure: Enjoy the freedom to think, decode, and solve our tricky logic puzzles at your own pace.
How to Play:
Each of the cryptogram code games is a coded message where every letter is substituted with a different one. Your job is to decode it by figuring out the correct substitutions. Look for patterns, common words, or repeating letters to start. Tap letters to make guesses, swap characters, and refine your solution until the full message is revealed. Our brain puzzles are a rewarding challenge that exercises both logic and language skills. New to word games? You’ll find Cryptogram easy to pick up and hard to put down. Start playing today!
Cryptogram puzzles offer more than just entertainment - they’re a daily opportunity to stimulate your brain and strengthen your cognitive abilities. As you solve more brain puzzles, you’ll begin to recognize patterns more quickly and feel your skills improve over time. The daily ring completion feature adds a fun layer of motivation, keeping you engaged and coming back each day.
Whether you're a fan of word games, logic puzzles, or daily challenges, this cryptogram game is the perfect blend of clever design and lasting enjoyment. With no pressure and no distractions, it’s your personal space for thinking, learning, and unlocking something new every day.
If you're searching for a brainteaser that truly tests your logic and language skills, this is the word game for you. Each puzzle combines the satisfaction of a mental challenge with the joy of uncovering meaningful messages. Whether you're a seasoned solver or a newcomer to cryptograms, you'll find the perfect balance of difficulty and fun in every puzzle. It's a word game experience that feels fresh every day and keeps your brain engaged for the long haul.
Download the Cryptogram word game now and start decoding your way to sharper thinking and daily satisfaction.

We reverse-engineer player prop betting markets to calculate player projections and rankings for each position. Because the sportsbooks are constantly adjusting odds based on sharp action, injury reports, and real-time updates, the data you see in our app reflects the most current and efficient expectations available anywhere.

• Season-long fantasy football players looking to gain an edge

• Best ball drafters who want better rankings during draft season
• Fantasy basketball players who want reliable daily projections
• Anyone tired of vague advice from talking heads who never put their money where their mouth is

Whether you’re managing one team or ten, setting DFS lineups, or researching waiver wire moves, this app gives you the tools to dominate your league.

bluejetty:00124198:ios.summary: The officially licensed hero collection strategy RPG based on Masami Kurumada’s renowned Saint Seiya series is now available! Relive the epic saga, enriched with stunning landscapes and beautiful graphics to bring all your favorite Saints t
bluejetty:00124198:ios.description:
The officially licensed hero collection strategy RPG based on Masami Kurumada’s renowned Saint Seiya series is now available! Relive the epic saga, enriched with stunning landscapes and beautiful graphics to bring all your favorite Saints to life in full 3D! Enjoy the original BGM from the show as well as performances from the official Japanese voice actors for a truly first-class audiovisual experience!
Collect every character from the series! Mix and match to create your own strategies. In Knights of the Zodiac, even the weak can overcome the strong! Try out a wide range of engaging game modes~
[Thirty-Five Years - The Return of a Classic]
The Japanese manga classic returns in style!
As a next-generation game licensed by Kurumada Productions, Saint Seiya Awakening: Knights of the Zodiac lets you experience the time-honored battle manga like never before, from the Galactic Duel to Sanctuary's Twelve Temples; from Poseidon's Temple, to the Wailing Wall, and finally to Elysion!
Take a trip down memory lane with classic tracks such as "Pegasus Fantasy." Burn! My Cosmo, burn!
[Saints by the Hundreds: Ready for Action]
Your favorite heroes and villains are all here. Whether it's the unstoppable Pegasus Seiya, the compassionate Andromeda Shun, the Twelve Gold Saints, the Specters, or even the Goddess Athena herself: they're all waiting for you to summon them into battle.
The game brings over one hundred of Masami Kurumada’s original characters to your mobile device. Witness the birth of a new legend!
[Team Synergies & Epic Battles]
Build your dream team from a comprehensive selection of Saints, each with unique abilities and traits. With the right synergy, even Bronze Saints can defeat Gold Saint opponents! Use your strategy and wits to claim victory over the odds! Unleash your Saint's powerful abilities with just the tap of a finger and activate their Seventh Sense to unlock their true battle potential!
[Galactic Duels, Global Pick & Ban Duels]
Enter the Galactic Duels stage where Saints fight for the Gold Cloth! Test your skills against players from around the world in real-time PvP battles with balanced matchmaking! Utilize the Pick & Ban duel system adopted from the E-Sports to take your strategy to the next level!

bluejetty:00161914:ios.summary: פנגו (Pango), אפליקציית התחבורה החכמה לחניה, רכב ודרך המובילה בישראל, מציעה ל 3 מיליון לקוחותיה פתרונות תשלום כוללים אשר הופכים את הדרך לקלה ונוחה יותר. פנגו מרכזת במקום אחד את תשלומי התחבורה והשירותים הנלווים שנהגים ונוסעים צריכים. האפליקצ
bluejetty:00161914:ios.description:
פנגו (Pango), אפליקציית התחבורה החכמה לחניה, רכב ודרך המובילה בישראל, מציעה ל 3 מיליון לקוחותיה פתרונות תשלום כוללים אשר הופכים את הדרך לקלה ונוחה יותר. פנגו מרכזת במקום אחד את תשלומי התחבורה והשירותים הנלווים שנהגים ונוסעים צריכים. האפליקציה מאפשרת תשלום על חניה בכל הרשויות המקומיות ובמאות חניונים ברחבי הארץ, תשלום על מילוי דלק וכן על קניות בחנויות הנוחות של סונול, תשלום עבור שימוש בתחבורה ציבורית ( כולל נסיעה באוטובוס, ברכבת, בכרמלית וברכבת הקלה) , תשלום על נסיעה בכבישי אגרה, תשלומים הנוגעים לשטיפת רכב ושירותי חילוץ. כמו כן, החברה מספקת שירותים משלימים ללקוחותיה בעלי הרכבים ובהם איסוף לטסט וטיפול וביטוח רכב. עם פנגו חוסכים זמן ובכסף ונהנים משירותים מתקדמים היישר מהנייד שלכם.
חניה בכחול לבן – האפליקציה מאפשרת תשלום קל ונוח עבור חניה בכחול-לבן בכל הרשויות המקומיות בארץ. פשוט לוחצים על " פנגו הפעלת חניה " ואנחנו כבר דואגים לכל השאר.
תשלום בחניונים- השירות זמין במעל ל- 450 חניונים בפריסה ארצית ומאפשר יציאה מהחניון בלי לעבור בעמדת תשלום בחניוני אחוזות חוף, עזריאלי ועוד חניונים מובילים ברחבי הארץ. פשוט נכנסים לחניון, לוחצים על הלינק בהודעת הסמס ומשלמים רק עבור הזמן שחונים. החשבונית תגיע למייל ביציאה מהחניון.
פנגו סמארט- המסלול שחוסך זמן יקר ותשלומים מיותרים. 
טעית בהפעלת החניה? דוח אחד בשנה עלינו, בכפוף לתקנון.
* פנגו קאש- צבירת קאש לחניות בכחול לבן . 1 ₪ על כל נסיעה בתחבורה ציבורית, 10 אג' על כל ליטר תדלוק בתחנות סונול, 10% מעלות השטיפה. 
* שירות זזתי- המזהה את תנועת הרכב, מכבה את החניה אוטומטית וחוסך לכם עלויות.
* שירות החניון המהיר- מאפשר חניה בחניונים ברחבי הארץ מבלי לעבור בעמדת התשלום ומבלי לשלם עמלת הפעלה. 
תשלום בתחבורה ציבורית- מתקדמים לתשלום חכם באמצעות אפליקציית פנגו ונהנים מנוחות ומזמינות מירבית ללא צורך בהנפקת כרטיס רב קו או בחישוב חוזה הנסיעה הכי משתלם עבורכם או בדאגה שהכרטיס נסיעה שלכם תמיד טעון ועליכם. הרשמו באפליקציה ללא עלות, והתחילו לנסוע בתחבורה ציבורית ולשלם בקליק וללא התחייבות!
פנגו תדלוק- מתדלקים בתחנות סונול במחיר משתלם עם אפליקציית פנגו, צוברים goods ונהנים מתדלוק נוח ומקופונים משתלמים לחנות הנוחות.
שירותי חילוץ- לנסיעה בראש שקט. השירות כולל: החלפת גלגל במקרה של פנצ'ר, מונית שמגיעה ליעד לאסוף אתכם במקרה של תאונת דרכים, תדלוק עד אליכם במקרה שנתקעתם בלי דלק, התנעת הרכב במידה והמצבר התרוקן ועוד.
פנגו ביטוח- מציע לכם הליך דיגיטלי מהיר במחיר משתלם.
פנגו עד הבית- במקום לחכות שעתיים בטסט, לבזבז יום עבודה במוסך או לחפש פנצ'רייה לא מוכרת על הדרך, פנגו עד הבית, שירות VIP מבית פנגו, יאסוף מכם את הרכב, יבצע לו טסט וטיפול ויחזיר לכם אותו
כבישי אגרה- שירות כבישי אגרה חוסך לכם את הרמזורים ועוזר לכם לעקוף את הפקקים וליהנות מדרך חלקה. מצטרפים עם פנגו כמנויים בקליק וללא עלות ומגיעים ליעד בצ'יק. השירות חוסך לכם את תהליך ההצטרפות באתר "הנתיב המהיר" או את התשלום במזומן בעמדת התשלום. אם אתם באזור הצפון תוכלו לקחת את כביש 6 חוצה צפון (ממחלף יוקנעם עד מחלף סומך) למרות שמנוי למקטע זה נפרד מהמקטע המרכזי של כביש 6 (הנתיב המהיר לתל אביב )
שירות "לאן הגעתי" – שירות ללקוחות פנגו בלעדי המאפשר בחירה אוטומטית של אזור החניה בו אתם נמצאים בתפר בין ערים ובנקודות תפר בין אזורים ורחובות, כדי שלא תטעו באזור החניה שבחרתם.
תיקון פנצ'ר – כחלק מפנגו שירות לקוחות, מנויים לשירות, יוכלו לתקן פנצ'ר במגוון תחנות ברחבי הארץ. השירות ניתן ללא הגבלה של תיקונים וללא השתתפות עצמית.
פנגו לעסקים- שירות פנגו לעסקים עובד עם למעלה מ 10,000 לקוחות עסקיים, מהחברות הקטנות ועד לחברות הגדולות והמובילות במשק, המקבלות שירותים חדשניים ומתקדמים, לצד ניהול מיומן ומקצועי ושירות אמין וקשוב במוקד עסקי ייעודי. השירות משנה לחלוטין את צורת העבודה הארגונית ומציע יתרונות בכל התחומים הקשורים לעולמות החניה והרכב.
מגוון פעולות בשירות עצמי באפליקציה:
- אזור אישי: פירוט החניות האישי ואפשרות שליחת הפירוט למייל מתוך האפליקציה.
- צפייה בפירוט חיובים ואפשרות שליחת חשבוניות למייל.
- עדכון רכבים ,נהגים ומספרי טלפון באמצעות האפליקציה
- עדכון פרטי אשראי לחיוב.
היום זה כבר ברור לכולם: אפליקציית פנגו מציעה את הפתרון המתקדם והמוביל ביותר בישראל לשירותי חניה, רכב ודרך.
יש לכם שאלות או רעיונות לשיפור ושדרוג האפליקציה? מוזמנים ליצור איתנו קשר.

פנגו סמארט- המסלול שחוסך זמן יקר ותשלומים מיותרים. 
טעית בהפעלת החניה? דוח אחד בשנה עלינו, בכפוף לתקנון.

* פנגו קאש- צבירת קאש לחניות בכחול לבן . 1 ₪  על כל נסיעה בתחבורה ציבורית, 10 אג' על כל ליטר תדלוק בתחנות סונול, 10% מעלות השטיפה. 
 
* שירות זזתי- המזהה את תנועת הרכב, מכבה את החניה אוטומטית וחוסך לכם עלויות.
  
* שירות החניון המהיר- מאפשר חניה בחניונים ברחבי הארץ מבלי לעבור בעמדת התשלום ומבלי לשלם עמלת הפעלה. 
 
תשלום בתחבורה ציבורית- מתקדמים לתשלום חכם באמצעות אפליקציית פנגו ונהנים מנוחות ומזמינות מירבית ללא צורך בהנפקת כרטיס רב קו או בחישוב חוזה הנסיעה הכי משתלם עבורכם או בדאגה שהכרטיס נסיעה שלכם תמיד טעון ועליכם. הרשמו באפליקציה ללא עלות, והתחילו לנסוע בתחבורה ציבורית ולשלם בקליק וללא התחייבות!

פנגו תדלוק- מתדלקים בתחנות סונול במחיר משתלם עם אפליקציית פנגו, צוברים goods ונהנים מתדלוק נוח ומקופונים משתלמים לחנות הנוחות.

שירותי חילוץ- לנסיעה בראש שקט. השירות כולל: החלפת גלגל במקרה של פנצ'ר, מונית שמגיעה ליעד לאסוף אתכם במקרה של תאונת דרכים, תדלוק עד אליכם במקרה שנתקעתם בלי דלק, התנעת הרכב במידה והמצבר התרוקן ועוד.

פנגו ביטוח- מציע לכם הליך דיגיטלי מהיר במחיר משתלם.

פנגו עד הבית- במקום לחכות שעתיים בטסט, לבזבז יום עבודה במוסך או לחפש פנצ'רייה לא מוכרת על הדרך, פנגו עד הבית, שירות VIP מבית פנגו, יאסוף מכם את הרכב, יבצע לו טסט וטיפול ויחזיר לכם אותו

כבישי אגרה- שירות כבישי אגרה חוסך לכם את הרמזורים ועוזר לכם לעקוף את הפקקים וליהנות מדרך חלקה. מצטרפים עם פנגו כמנויים בקליק וללא עלות ומגיעים ליעד בצ'יק. השירות חוסך לכם את תהליך ההצטרפות באתר "הנתיב המהיר" או את התשלום במזומן בעמדת התשלום. אם אתם באזור הצפון תוכלו לקחת את כביש 6 חוצה צפון (ממחלף יוקנעם עד מחלף סומך) למרות שמנוי למקטע זה נפרד מהמקטע המרכזי של כביש 6 (הנתיב המהיר לתל אביב )

שירות "לאן הגעתי" – שירות ללקוחות פנגו בלעדי המאפשר בחירה אוטומטית של אזור החניה בו אתם נמצאים בתפר בין ערים ובנקודות תפר בין אזורים ורחובות, כדי שלא תטעו באזור החניה שבחרתם.

תיקון פנצ'ר – כחלק מפנגו שירות לקוחות, מנויים לשירות, יוכלו לתקן פנצ'ר במגוון תחנות ברחבי הארץ. השירות ניתן ללא הגבלה של תיקונים וללא השתתפות עצמית.

פנגו לעסקים- שירות פנגו לעסקים עובד עם למעלה מ 10,000 לקוחות עסקיים, מהחברות הקטנות ועד לחברות הגדולות והמובילות במשק, המקבלות שירותים חדשניים ומתקדמים, לצד ניהול מיומן ומקצועי ושירות אמין וקשוב במוקד עסקי ייעודי. השירות משנה לחלוטין את צורת העבודה הארגונית ומציע יתרונות בכל התחומים הקשורים לעולמות החניה והרכב.

מגוון פעולות בשירות עצמי באפליקציה:
- אזור אישי: פירוט החניות האישי ואפשרות שליחת הפירוט למייל מתוך האפליקציה.
- צפייה בפירוט חיובים ואפשרות שליחת חשבוניות למייל.
- עדכון רכבים ,נהגים ומספרי טלפון באמצעות האפליקציה

- עדכון פרטי אשראי לחיוב.

היום זה כבר ברור לכולם: אפליקציית פנגו מציעה את הפתרון המתקדם והמוביל ביותר בישראל לשירותי חניה, רכב ודרך.
יש לכם שאלות או רעיונות לשיפור ושדרוג האפליקציה? מוזמנים ליצור איתנו קשר.

bluejetty:00142053:ios.description:
Practice for exactly the CDL knowledge tests you need, and know when you are ready for each one.
CDL Permit Test builds a study path around the license you are actually applying for. Pick your state, your class (A, B or C), whether your vehicle has air brakes, and the endorsements you plan to take. The app then shows which knowledge tests your agency will give you and tracks your readiness for each one, so you can see which test still needs work and which one you can walk into.
WHAT YOU GET
- 934 practice questions across 9 knowledge tests, written from the FMCSA Model Commercial Driver's License Manual
- A plain explanation for every answer, plus a note on why each wrong choice is wrong
- Full-length test simulator: real topic weights, the 80 percent pass mark, a timed clock that submits for you, flags, a navigator and a result by topic
- A readiness score for each test, from your recent answers and how much of it you have covered
- Spaced review: questions you miss come back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days until you have them
- 97 key figures: the numbers examiners expect you to know, such as air pressure thresholds, stopping distances and time limits
- 42 questions with the road sign, hazmat placard or package label drawn on screen
- Exam day: every test your class needs, back to back under one clock, each scored on its own pass mark
- Handbook mode: read every question in a topic with its answer and reasoning, no timer
- Bookmarks, mistake review, score history and a score trend per test
- A daily goal, a streak, an optional daily reminder and test-date reminders
- Works offline, no account, no ads
TESTS COVERED
 General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, Doubles and Triples (T), Tank Vehicles (N), Hazardous Materials (H), Passenger Transport (P), School Bus (S), Pre-Trip Inspection.
FREE AND PRO
The app is free to use, with a daily practice limit and a limited number of full-length tests. An optional Pro upgrade removes those limits and unlocks the rest of the study tools. What Pro includes, and the price in your local currency, is shown in the app before you buy.
USE IT FOR ANY STATE
Alabama DPS, Alaska DMV, Arizona MVD, Arkansas OMV, California DMV, Colorado DMV, Connecticut DMV, District of Columbia DMV, Delaware DMV, Florida DHSMV, Georgia DDS, Hawaii DMV, Idaho DMV, Illinois SOS, Indiana BMV, Iowa DMV, Kansas DMV, Kentucky DMV, Louisiana OMV, Maine BMV, Maryland MVA, Massachusetts RMV, Michigan SOS, Minnesota DVS, Mississippi DMV, Missouri DOR, Montana MVD, Nebraska DMV, Nevada DMV, New Hampshire DMV, New Jersey MVC, New Mexico MVD, New York DMV, North Carolina DMV, North Dakota NDDOT, Ohio BMV, Oklahoma DPS, Oregon DMV, Pennsylvania DMV, Rhode Island DMV, South Carolina DMV, South Dakota DMV, Tennessee DOS, Texas DMV, Utah DMV, Vermont DMV, Virginia DMV, Washington DOL, West Virginia DMV, Wisconsin DMV, Wyoming DOT
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically at the same price and period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged within that 24-hour window. Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings. Where a free trial is offered, any unused portion is forfeited if you buy a subscription during the trial. Prices may vary by region. A one-time purchase, where offered, is not a subscription and does not renew.
IMPORTANT
This app is study material based on the FMCSA Model Commercial Driver's License Manual. It is not legal advice, is not affiliated with or endorsed by any state licensing agency, and does not replace your state's official manual or tests. Test length, pass marks and some rules vary by state. Check your state's current manual before test day.

Create designs for social content, branding, and creative projects using 3D t
bluejetty:00035031:ios.description:
Tenada is a mobile graphic design editor for creating unique visuals with 3D text, logos, posters, covers, thumbnails, animations, and AI-powered creative tools.
Create designs for social content, branding, and creative projects using 3D typography, templates, motion effects, custom fonts, background removal, transparent PNG export, and visual editing tools.
[Graphic Design with 3D Text]
Create eye-catching graphics with Tenada’s 3D text tools.
• Design posters, covers, thumbnails, intros, and social graphics with bold 3D typography.
• Edit text and objects in real 3D space with depth, shadows, lighting, and perspective.
• Apply materials such as metal, glass, leather, fabric, and more.
• Transform text into circles, waves, cylinders, curves, and folding styles.
[Logo & Text Design]
Turn words into unique logo-style visuals.
• Create 3D text logos, name designs, brand visuals, and animated logo designs.
• Customize fonts, colors, outlines, shadows, bevels, gradients, and textures.
• Add your own fonts or use built-in font styles.
• Design logos and text graphics for profiles, posters, thumbnails, intros, and brand content.
[Posters, Covers, Thumbnails & Social Graphics]
Start from templates or create your own design from scratch.
• Make posters, flyers, album covers, thumbnails, banners, profile images, and social posts.
• Combine text, images, videos, stickers, shapes, and effects in one workflow.
• Use background removal, transparent PNG export, and editable templates to finish faster.
• Export high-quality images and videos in the aspect ratio you need.
[Animation & Motion Design]
Add motion to your graphic designs.
• Animate text and objects with motion presets.
• Create animated intros, logo animations, typography videos, and short-form visuals.
• Customize 300+ animation and visual effect presets, including particle count and speed.
[AI Creative Tools]
Use AI as part of your design workflow.
• Generate AI visuals and combine them with Tenada’s 3D editing tools.
• Create AI portraits, avatars, characters, styled images, and other visual assets.
• Preview your artwork with AI-powered mockup and design features.
• Edit AI-generated images with text, effects, animation, and layout tools.
[Why Tenada?]
Tenada combines easy mobile editing with real 3D text, motion graphics, logo design, visual effects, and AI tools, helping you create bold, dimensional, and original visuals.
With Tenada Pro, you can unlock premium templates and graphic tools, and share your designs without a watermark.
Subscriptions automatically renew, but you can cancel anytime from the store at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, and you can manage your subscription anytime in your account settings.

bluejetty:00070097:ios.description:
Note: This game contains loot boxes and includes random-item purchases.
What kind of story will be written when thousands of players do battle, form alliances, and expand their territory on a realistic battlefield? What sort of conflicts will be sparked when historical legends join your ranks? How would you use the countless strategies available to you in a real war between kingdoms?
[Unique Points]
- Realistic Battlefield
Immerse yourself in a realistic simulation of the real world! Take in the sights of famous geographical wonders all over the world, including the Great Rift Valley, the Suez Canal, and the Alps! Traverse the sprawling map and take over countless historical cities and buildings as you make use of the geographical conditions to strategize and do battle. Set up your fortifications and conquer your enemies!
- Clash Between Civilizations
Civilizations that are too powerful may face united resistance from those that feel threatened. Keep that in mind as you battle against civilizations such as the Persians, Egyptians, and Japanese on your path to creating an everlasting one of your own.
- Fair Competition
Everyone starts on an equal footing, without VIP options, methods to purchase resources, or resource speed-ups! Claim resource points on the map as you develop your city from scratch. Unlock more features over time with proper planning and storage of resources. Strategize to gain an edge over others!
- Strategic Diplomacy
Your interactions with the various civilizations will change as you progress in the game. Join a guild and use the unique diplomatic features to quash enemies and build your own empire! Embark on grand expeditions and experience realistic shifts in advantage as you defend yourself against possible spies among your allies!
- Real-Time Strategy
All battles on the map are in real-time, and there's more to battles than just simply deploying your troops. Attack your enemies' weakest troops! Intercept their reinforcements! Team up with your allies to surround them! Let your strategic prowess shine as you employ various tactics to achieve victory! 
- Numerous Heroes
Recruit from over 100 different legendary Heroes to help you command your troops and manage your city! Get famous names in history, such as Julius Caesar, Alexander the Great, and Joan of Arc to help you establish your indomitable empire!
- Pairing Skills
Make your troops even stronger by pairing a large variety of skills with your Heroes! Train an invincible army and crush all who stand in your way!

Discord: https://discord.gg/cA6XrAAFP7
Official Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/EpicAgeOfficial/

Note:

3. Your account will receive confirmation of the next renewal and price within 24 hours before the end of your current subscription.

bluejetty:00121169:ios.description:
Read between the lines is a game where you have to solve puzzles (Dingbats, Dangbits, Mr&Mrs and Anagram puzzles).
------------ 
Dingbats : 
One puzzle, one phrase : try to identity the meaning hidden behind each drawing.
Play Read between the lines and train your brain by solving the puzzles. And if you have some difficulties, you can ask for clues or help from your friends to solve those wacky wordies.
Have fun recognizing or learning new idioms through the levels of the game.
------------
Dangbits : 
How do AIs see the world?
One picture, one idiom: can you guess the meaning hidden behind each image generated by an AI?
Exercise your brain by recognising or discovering many expressions.
------------
Mr & Mrs : 
Mr & Mrs have children. Can you guess the name of their offspring ?
Try to find the right first names and create funny full names.
------------
AnaQuiz : 
Rearrange the letters of the anagrams to create another word or phrase.
------------
New puzzles are regularly added to the game. If you have an idea in mind and would like it to be featured in a next release of the app, you can also send it.

bluejetty:00166859:ios.description:
Quiz AI is the all-in-one solution to help you conquer your academic challenges effortlessly. 
As an AI homework helper app, Quiz AI offers a convenient quick scan feature that effortlessly captures the problems of math, chemistry, biology, physics, etc. and instantly analyzes the content and provides you with the most accurate answers.

Scan to Solve
Our solver engine is powered by powerful Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, ensuring accurate and efficient problem-solving. Simply scan any math problem, and Quiz AI will provide you with step-by-step solutions and explanations.

Our AI homework helper can answer all sorts of questions typically used in tests, including Mathematics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Grammar and Vocabulary. This is your go-to study companion and help you ace any tests and quizs.
Step by Step Explanations
Quiz.AI offers detailed, step-by-step explanations for each problem solved. You'll not only get the right answers but also gain a deeper understanding of the underlying concepts.

bluejetty:00114384:ios.description:
Say the Word on Beat – Rhythm Speaking Challenge
Say the Word on Beat is a fun and creative rhythm challenge app where you speak words in perfect sync with the music beat. Watch the music video, follow the visual cues, and record your reaction as you speak each word at the right moment.
Whether you want to practice rhythm, create entertaining videos, or challenge yourself, this app turns your voice into a game.
How It Works
The screen is split into 2/3 camera view and 1/3 music video
Follow the beat and read the words shown in the boxes
Speak clearly and stay on rhythm
Record your video reaction in real time
Save your video or download it to your device
No complicated setup. Just tap, speak, and play.
Choose Your Challenge Level
Test your rhythm skills with different difficulty modes:
Easy – Slow tempo, simple words
Hard – Faster beats, tighter timing
Impossible – Extreme speed for true rhythm masters
Each level offers a unique challenge and keeps the experience fresh.
Key Features
Rhythm-based speaking challenges
Built-in camera filter to record videos
Ready-to-play music videos
Multiple difficulty levels
Save and download recorded videos
Simple, fast, and fun user experience
Perfect for content creators, music lovers, and anyone who enjoys rhythm games.
No musical background required – just follow the beat.
Start the Beat Challenge Now
Download Say the Word on Beat and see if you can keep up with the rhythm.
Speak fast. Stay on beat. Beat the challenge.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
Privacy Policy: https://cemsoftwareltd.com/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Use: https://cemsoftwareltd.com/term.html

We'd love to hear from you!

bluejetty:00088100:ios.summary: Photo Vault helps keep private photos, videos, contacts, notes, and files protected behind a secure passcode. Store private media in a secure vault and access it only with the numeric PIN you set. The app is designed with a discreet privacy
bluejetty:00088100:ios.description:
Photo Vault helps keep private photos, videos, contacts, notes, and files protected behind a secure passcode. Store private media in a secure vault and access it only with the numeric PIN you set. The app is designed with a discreet privacy screen, helping keep your private vault protected on your device.
Protect Private Photos and Videos
Import photos and videos into private app storage so they are separated from your regular photo gallery. Organize your private media into albums, browse hidden photos and videos in one secure place, and manage your files with simple controls for renaming, restoring, and deleting items.
Secure Gallery Vault
Photo Vault provides a dedicated space for personal media you prefer to keep private. The vault can be locked behind your PIN, helping prevent casual access to your private photos, videos, and files.
Discreet Privacy Screen
The app uses a simple private access screen for secure entry. Enter your password and press the "=" button to unlock your private vault.
Private Contacts and Notes
Go beyond media privacy by storing sensitive contacts and notes inside the app. Keep personal information protected and accessible only through your secure vault.
Supported Media
Photo Vault supports common image and video formats, including JPG, PNG, GIF, and more. You can import, view, organize, restore, and delete private media from inside the app.
Free features may include:
- Secure photo and video vault
- PIN-protected access
- Discreet privacy screen
- Photo and video import
- Private albums and media organization
- Restore and delete tools
- Secure contacts and notes storage
- Support for common image and video formats
Optional paid features require a subscription or separate in-app purchase. These may include:
- Unlimited imports or expanded storage options
- Advanced privacy tools
- Fake vault / deceptive vault
- Premium app icons or icon concealment features
- Additional backup, organization, or security features
- Other premium settings and customization options
FAQ
How do I access the vault?
Enter your password and press the "=" button to unlock.
What if I forget my password?
Enter "11223344" on the PIN screen and press "=" to retrieve your password by answering your security question.
How do I restore a private file?
Long-press the file to enter edit mode, then use the restore button.
Are my hidden files stored online?
Your files are stored on your device. Back up your hidden files before changing devices, deleting the app, or performing a factory reset.
Subscription Information
Some features require a paid subscription or separate in-app purchase. Prices may vary by location. Subscriptions are charged through your Apple ID account and automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy:
https://calculator-x-d5d2a.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use:
https://calculator-x-d5d2a.web.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00068515:ios.summary:
Say goodbye to fumbling for coins, remembering parking space numbers, or that long trip back to the car to put something on the dashboard. With ParkSmart–MobilePay, all that hassle is a thing of the past. 
To make it as easy as possible, d
bluejetty:00068515:ios.description:
Say goodbye to fumbling for coins, remembering parking space numbers, or that long trip back to the car to put something on the dashboard. With ParkSmart–MobilePay, all that hassle is a thing of the past. 
To make it as easy as possible, download the secure app in advance and enter your license plate number and credit card information. (You can even enter multiple vehicles.) Then, the whole process is as simple as 1-2-3. 
1) Once you arrive at the lot, enter the parking lot location number on the sign. 
2) Select how long you’ll be staying. 
3) Pay with a single click. 
ParkSmart–MobilePay will then send you confirmation and a receipt via text, and you’re all done. 
Of course, you can also enter your license plate number and credit card information when you arrive, but with ParkSmart lots all over Northern California, why not make things as simple as possible and download the app today? 
In fact, you can even get directions to the parking lot of your choice. Just select the icon of the lot that works best for you, and ParkSmart–MobilePay will send directions to your phone. 
If you’re looking for monthly parking, many ParkSmart–MobilePay locations have monthly parking options as well. After booking your monthly space in advance, you can park in the lot each day without having to worry about re-entering your car or license plate information. 
We know parking is never high on your list of fun things to do, but with ParkSmart–MobilePay, parking is as painless as parking can be.

bluejetty:00116370:ios.name: Color Block Buster
bluejetty:00116370:ios.summary: No timer. No rush. Step into Color Block Buster, where thrilling block puzzle challenges meet dynamic 3D visuals in a satisfying and addictive gameplay journey. This isn’t just any ordinary block puzzle game—it’s a full-blown block buster e
bluejetty:00116370:ios.description:
No timer. No rush. Step into Color Block Buster, where thrilling block puzzle challenges meet dynamic 3D visuals in a satisfying and addictive gameplay journey. This isn’t just any ordinary block puzzle game—it’s a full-blown block buster experience built to test your strategy, reflexes, and puzzle-solving skills!
In Color Block Buster, your mission is clear: move colorful blocks through clever paths, unlock doors, and solve mind-twisting block puzzle setups. As a true block buster, you’ll face hundreds of challenging levels, each more exciting than the last. It’s time to enter the world of block jam, where chaos meets logic, and every move matters.
Features You’ll Love in Color Block Buster:
*No timer: Play freely with no stress, just relax and enjoy.
*Unique Block Puzzle Mechanics: Slide, rotate, and blast your way through complex block puzzle levels designed to challenge your mind and reflexes. Each block buster moment feels fresh and exciting, with clever mechanics that keep you thinking.
*Immersive Block Jam Levels: Dive into colorful 3D environments full of twisty paths and unexpected obstacles. The block jam experience keeps evolving with each level—no two puzzles are ever the same!
*Strategic Gameplay: Every great block buster needs a sharp mind. Think ahead, use space wisely, and find the best solutions to even the toughest block puzzle challenges.
*Hundreds of Levels, Endless Fun: Explore an ever-expanding universe of block puzzle stages, from beginner-friendly boards to hardcore block buster 3D tests. There’s always a new puzzle waiting!
*Smooth Controls, Stunning 3D Visuals: Enjoy intuitive gameplay in a visually engaging 3D world. From satisfying slides to explosive block buster combos, every interaction feels polished and responsive.
*Unlock Rewards & Master the Game: Complete each block puzzle level, collect your rewards, and prove you're the ultimate block buster! Keep playing to unlock special modes, tougher block jam levels, and exclusive boosts.
How to Play:
*Slide the blocks to their color-coded doors
*Think before every move, some paths are trickier than they seem
*Clear the stage to progress and enter deeper into the block puzzle journey
*Watch out for block jam challenges that’ll test your logic and patience!
Why Color Block Buster Is a Must-Play:
*The perfect blend of challenge and relaxation
*A fresh twist on the classic block puzzle genre
*Great for fans of block jam, strategy games, and satisfying visuals
Ideal for puzzle lovers who crave that satisfying block buster moment when everything clicks
Get ready to break through the jam, conquer the chaos, and become the ultimate block buster champion! Whether you love brainy challenges or just want a relaxing way to unwind, Color Block Buster is the block puzzle game you've been waiting for.
Download now and let the block busting begin!

bluejetty:00032404:ios.description:
Enjoy unlimited sim free domestic and international calling and texting from anywhere in the world! All you need is a WiFi connection, and you can call and receive phone calls from any phone, directly on your mobile. Get multiple phone numbers for various needs and record call to never miss important information. It is just like having a second number for you to call and text from without adding an extra sim card. Easily keep your personal and professional life separate with the Call app on your iPhone.
What’s more? Call uses smart™ routing technology which ensures that you get the cheapest possible rates for your international phone calls and texts. Now stay in constant touch with your friends and family through phone calls, texts, location sharing, group messaging and MMS. You also get to save money on expensive long distance calls and avail roaming services for free! With the Call app, you never have to worry about expensive calls or texts, even when traveling abroad!
Call is the ideal companion for personal as well as business use.
FEATURES: 
Enjoy sim free unlimited international & local calling
In build call recorder - record phone calls and never miss an important update
Avail smart routing for the cheapest rates
Sync mobile contacts instantly & have a separate address book
Set custom caller ID and get multiple phone numbers
Enjoy group texting and send mass text messages
Mark your favorite contacts
Send your location in a click
Access your account from any device - iPhone, iPod, iPad
Filter spam calls & block fraudulent callers
BENEFITS:
Go Global - Call and text anyone, anywhere in the world.
Built in call recording - Record conversation with a tap
Save Money - Much cheaper than using your regular phone plan.
Work-Life Balance - Stay organized with separate numbers for your work and personal life
Travel - Call local numbers even when you are abroad.
Roaming - No need to worry about roaming charges when you are abroad.
Premium Numbers - Call premium numbers with no extra charge.
Does Everything - Ideal for both personal and business use.
Optimized for iPad, iPod
CALL IS PERFECT FOR
Travel - Call local phone numbers even when you are abroad right from your mobile.
Social - Call and text your friends who live around the world.
Business - Make international calls without extra charges.
HOW IT WORKS
Step 1. Download the app
Step 2. Select your country
Step 3. Set your caller ID
Step 4. Dial and Call
Yes, it’s that simple!
ARE CALLS & TEXTS LIMITED?
With Call, there are no limits to the amount of calls you make and texts you send.
No contracts. No advertisements.
TERMS OF USE AND SUBSCRIPTIONS 
1. Subscription duration is 1 week.
2. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
3. Initial payments are charged to a user's iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
4. Charges for renewal occur within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
5. Subscriptions can be managed by the user and auto-renewal turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
6. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
7. Fair Use Policy - Call reserves the right to limit any or all of the above services based on what it deems to be abusive practices, unusually high usage or what Call deems as 'Fair Use'. 
8. Privacy Policy: https://call.crowdedroad.com/privacy
9. Terms of use: https://call.crowdedroad.com/terms

bluejetty:00165655:ios.summary: Breathwrk, now a part of Peloton, is #1 breathing app for Sleep, Stress, Focus, and Energy. Breathwrk is a simple yet powerful way to improve your mental and physical well-being in just seconds with neuroscience based breathing exercises. J
bluejetty:00165655:ios.description:
Breathwrk, now a part of Peloton, is #1 breathing app for Sleep, Stress, Focus, and Energy. Breathwrk is a simple yet powerful way to improve your mental and physical well-being in just seconds with neuroscience based breathing exercises. Join the millions breathing with Breathwrk across the world today! 
Peloton All Access, Guide and App+ Members have Breathwrk provided for free as part of their membership. After downloading the latest version of the Breathwrk App, Peloton members should follow the instructions and log in with their Peloton username or email and password.
Breathwrk makes it fun and easy to learn and master breathwork with guided breathing exercises. Get a full sensory experience with customizable sounds, visuals, haptic vibrations, and breath coaches. Build your practice by setting reminders, tracking streaks, and following Breathwrk’s recommended protocols.
Breathwrk adapts to your lungs, goals, and the time of day to improve your body and mind. Explore an extensive library of guided exercises and classes that help improve stress, anxiety, sleep, energy, focus, Heart Rate Variability (HRV), lung capacity, blood pressure, and more. It’s not magic, it's neuroscience!
Discover and master the same techniques used by psychotherapists, athletes, sleep doctors, yogis, neuroscientists, and breath experts like some of the world's leading breath experts!
Breathwrk is recommended by top psychologists, mental health experts, and even elite coaches. It is fast, easy, yet powerfully effective. You can do Breathwrk anytime, anyplace, and anywhere!
Change your breath, change your life!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
* 100s of exercises and classes
* Daily classes updated every 24 hours
* Habit tracking and reminders
* Custom Reminders
* Streaks & Levels
* Lung score and exhale tests
* Apple Health Integration
* Mindfulness Minutes
* Offline Access
* And More
CALMING EXERCISES
* Activates your parasympathetic nervous system
* Reduces cortisol, lowers stress, and improves mood
* Relaxes muscles, lowers heart rate, and blood pressure
* Improves heart rate variability (HRV) and lung capacity
* Leads to long-term neuroplasticity
FOCUSING AND ENERGIZING EXERCISES
* Activates your sympathetic nervous system
* Improves focus, cognition, and memory
* Enhances physical performance and readiness
* Improves heart rate variability (HRV) and lung capacity
* Leads to long-term neuroplasticity
SLEEP EXERCISES (4-7-8)
* Activates your parasympathetic nervous system
* Reduces cortisol, lowers stress, and improves mood
* Relaxes muscles, lowers heart rate, and blood pressure
* Improves heart rate variability (HRV) and lung capacity
* Leads to long-term neuroplasticity
HEALTH EXERCISES
* Helps alleviate pain, headaches, and cramps
* Helps improve lung capacity and improves heart rate variability (HRV)
* Helps with cravings from quitting smoking and vaping
* Helps lower blood pressure and heart rate
FEATURED IN:
Forbes, RollingStone, Healthline, Goop, Vogue, The Skimm, GQ, and much more!

bluejetty:00164045:ios.summary: The official Burger King India app is now available for you to place your order, be it for safe and contactless dine-in, takeaway or food delivery. With the App, you can Have It Your Way in a few simple steps, and earn yourself some Crown r
bluejetty:00164045:ios.description:
The official Burger King India app is now available for you to place your order, be it for safe and contactless dine-in, takeaway or food delivery. With the App, you can Have It Your Way in a few simple steps, and earn yourself some Crown rewards while you’re at it.
Taste, Your Way
We take your Trust in Taste very seriously, which is why with the Burger King App you have access to the freshest additions to the menu.
Want something big, juicy and flame grilled? Want it made Your Way with double patties extra cheese? We got a Whopper for you.
Craving those munchies? We got fries of more than one kind.
Feeling like going back to the classics? We got that irreplaceable taste for you.
Need to shake off those blues? We got some thick shakes to cheer you up.
Order through the App to let the King adapt to your taste, and recommend food items according to your preferences. 
Offers, Your Way
The Burger King app is Home to all the exclusive deals on your favourite dishes from the Burger King Menu. Download the app for meal prices like you’ve never seen before!
Use your crown points to redeem further discounts and offers.
BK Loyalty Program
The King always rewards loyalty. Earn crowns points on the Burger King app with each order. The more you collect, the greater the reward for you!
Pro tip: Shake your phone once you’ve downloaded the app to earn your crowns before you start filling up your cart.
Order Your Way
Wanna eat your Whopper at home in your pyjamas? The App’s got you covered with BK Delivery. Enjoy your freshly flame grilled Whopper brought to you at your doorstep through safe deliveries.
Wish to enjoy your meal on-the-go? Have it your way with zero contact ordering and safe takeaways by placing your order on the App. P.S- Do not blame us if you finish most of your Hi-Fries on your way back home.
Looking for the full Burger King experience with safe dine-ins while wearing the crown? Use this opportunity to earn some crowns as well on the Burger King app while going contactless in Your Way of ordering at the stores.
Finally, the King
Find out more about the Home of the Whopper on Brand Wall and you’ll learn the BK lingo in no time. At Burger King, we like to keep things real & authentic, just like the flavours in our food. Get a sneak peek into the King’s journey and how the Flame Grill came about. Learn what makes the Whopper so Imperfectly Perfect. After all, we take our food (not ourselves) very seriously.

bluejetty:00161630:ios.description:
Themes Go has been upgraded to offer you more personalized customization options. Themes Go provides multiple trending widgets for your phone, including interesting dynamic island, lockscreen widgets, pet widgets, wallpapers, themes, icons, social widgets designed for couples and friends, and much more. Moreover, Themes Go offers you a wider range of Standby content choices, enriching your standby experience and allowing you to enjoy a more diverse and personalized experience. With Themes Go, you can unlock the boundless potential of your phone and make it truly unique to your style and preferences.
【Dynaminc Island Animations】
Themes Go brings you an array of astonishing dynamic island animations, each choice injecting new vibrancy and personality into your phone. From playful and adorable animals to mesmerizing and fantastical landscapes, you will discover countless options that allow your phone to shine with unique charm. No matter what style or ambiancae you prefer, Themes Go offers you the perfect dynamic island animation choice.
【Pet widgets】
Themes Go allows you experience the joy of virtual pet ownership, we offer a diverse range of animal options, allowing you to freely indulge in online pet companionship. Whether you prefer dogs, cats, rabbits, or even beloved characters such as Patrick Star and SpongeBob SquarePants, you can choose and nurture your favorite pet. What's more, these adorable creatures will interact with you, bringing happiness and fulfillment to your life. They will communicate with you, caring about every aspect of your well-being, providing endless moments of joy and companionship.
【Social widgets】
Social widgets enable you to care for the people who matter to you anytime, anywhere. Whether it's your family, partner, or friends, Themes Go allows you to stay updated with their latest updates and express your longing for them at any moment. By creating personalized social widgets, you can have real-time insights into the distance, status, step count, and engage with those who are important to you.
【Themes】
Themes Go provides you limitless themes, bringing a touch of personalization to your device. Whether you are an anime enthusiast, a basketball fan, a gamer, a movie buff, or someone who appreciates the beauty of nature, we have a wide range of stunning and engaging themes tailored just for you. 
【More Standby options】
Themes Go also provides you with even more entertaining Standby styles. In Standby mode, Themes Go presents you with a variety of captivating background options. Whether you prefer dynamic or static designs, each one is filled with charm and entertainment. Elevate the uniqueness of your Standby mode with Themes Go's delightful backgrounds. You can also explore more Standby widget experiences.
【Aesthetic Wallpapers】
Explore a wide variety of high-definition, exquisite wallpaper styles to enhance the beauty of your smartphone screen. Whether you prefer natural landscapes, abstract art, captivating urban cityscapes, adorable animals, or even your favorite sports like basketball and football, beloved anime characters, or iconic movie themes, we offer a rich selection that allows your screen to constantly reflect your preferred style.
【Other Widgets Options】
In addition to the mentioned widgets, Themes Go also offers you other options, including clocks. You can choose your preferred clock style, whether it's a sweet or cool design, and Themes Go will meet your needs. X-Panel, Weather, Photo Wall, Quick Launcher, Countdown, Quote, Activity, and more are available.
If you encounter any problems when using Themes Go, please feel free to contact us at any time. If you like our product, your praise will be our unremitting driving force.

Efficiently manages in-app iCloud files, quickly freeing up cloud space and making cloud file management lighter and more organized.

Automatically categorizes documents, emails, and cache files; one-click management of chat history for quick management of phone files.

bluejetty:00185385:ios.description:
Begin your journey from lowly stable hand to dressage super star! Join our horse loving online world where you can customise your character, tame beautiful horses, bring them to your stable and train them for challenging show jumping championships.
Welcome to Meadowcroft
A small, centuries old town surrounded by rolling fields and vast, open plains. Sleepy. Rustic. Idyllic. Full of animals big and small. A paradise of peace and tranquillity. A town with a passion for horses that’s as old as the foundations it was built on. Home to Layla, lowly stable hand. A girl who, though surrounded by horses each and every day, has never yet sat astride one, but all that is about to change!
Ride with Your Friends
Ride your horse as a girl with all your friends as you set out on adventures to explore the outskirts of your farm and beyond in glorious 3D!
Endless Customisation
Create an amazing look for you and your horse as you compete for glory in the Meadowcroft Show Jumping Competitions. From helmets and jodhpurs for you - and saddles, leg wraps and masks for your horse, there are thousands of looks you can create.
Tame Beautiful Horses
Create a magical bond with wild horses such as the Mustang, Dapple Grey and Appaloosa as you tame and care for them, preparing the stallion to be ridden as you set out on your quest.
A Mystery to Solve
Uncover the mystery of the fabled fantasy sky riders - mystical Pegasus and Unicorn horses who once roamed free in the haven above the clouds.
Join the Showjumping Academy
You may be invited to join the prestigious Meadowcroft riding academy, a school that’s seen countless thousands of equestrians pass through its gates and over its grasslands. Compete against other students in equestrian competitions as you uncover the mystery of the sky riders.
Craft Items
Explore the world and mine resources to create beautiful accessories for your horse such as saddles, bridles, blankets and more!
Care for Your Horse
Complete horse care quests by crafting hay, horseshoes and other items for your horse to keep her in high spirits. The happier your animal, the better it will jump in equestrian events. 
More than just a simulator, this game takes mobile equestrian games to a new level! Foxie Ventures would like to welcome you to the Horse Riding Tales family! We will be adding lots of new content, from a Shetland pony to more fantasy pegasus & unicorn horses to challenging breeding quests. Kick off your interactive adventure and download free today! 
SUBSCRIPTION
Monthly VIP Subscription
• Monthly Benefits: Explore beyond the town, collect resources and build stables faster & get stable hands to look after your horse.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Terms of Service & Privacy Policy
By downloading this app you are agreeing to our terms of service which can be found at: https://www.foxieventures.com/terms
Our privacy policy can be found at:
https://www.foxieventures.com/privacy
In-App Purchases
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.
A network connection is required to play. Data fees may apply if WiFi isn’t connected.
Website: https://www.foxieventures.com
