bluejetty:00119878:ios.name: Animal Puzzle Toddlers
bluejetty:00119878:ios.summary: A fun puzzle game for toddlers and kids from ages 1 to 6 featuring 26 cute cartoon animals such as cow, horse, goat, sheep, pig, dog, elephant, giraffe, monkey, lion, dolphin, owl, rhinoceros, zebra, parrot, tiger, turtle and more in 30 sha
bluejetty:00119878:ios.description:
A fun puzzle game for toddlers and kids from ages 1 to 6 featuring 26 cute cartoon animals such as cow, horse, goat, sheep, pig, dog, elephant, giraffe, monkey, lion, dolphin, owl, rhinoceros, zebra, parrot, tiger, turtle and more in 30 shape & tangram puzzles!
When a puzzle is completed children are rewarded with a variety of fun celebrations and interactions such as balloon popping.
The fun matching activities help improve visual perception, knowledge of shapes & develop fine motor skills by dragging and dropping puzzle pieces to match their holes. Perfect for preschoolers.
Features
• Animal Sounds! (excluding sea animals, giraffe & turtle)
• Kids Safe, please see our Privacy Policy
• Original high quality cartoon art drawn by professional children's book illustrator
• Four different themes: Farm, Jungle, Sea (Underwater) & Savannah
• Automatic advance to the next puzzle
• Three different puzzle styles with increasing difficulty levels
• Interface & touch controls designed for toddlers
• Press & hold button to limit menu access to parents
• Option to hide/show locked puzzles to prevent accidental purchases
The first 4 puzzles are free, all of the remaining ones can be unlocked easily via single in-app purchase. Once unlocked, there are no further in-app purchases or other dialogs.
If you have previously purchased simply tap on "Restore Unlock Purchase" button in settings menu (gear icon on the top right corner) to unlock puzzles on all of your iOS devices.
PRIVACY POLICY
We take privacy very seriously, this app:
Does not contain ads
Does not contain integration with social networks
Does not contain web links
Does not use analytics / data collection tools
Does contain a single in-app purchase to unlock full version
ATTENTION 
If you don't want your child to accidentally upgrade to the full version, make sure to disable in-app purchases via the settings menu of your device.
If you are representing an Educational Institution or simply prefer to purchase full version without in-app purchases, "Educational Edition" of this app is also available.
WE VALUE YOUR FEEDBACK
If you like our app, please take a minute to rate and review it.
If you have any questions or need help, please reach us at http://www.pixelenvision.com/support/ or by sending an e-mail to support@pixelenvision.com

bluejetty:00124106:ios.description:
August 19th, 2022
Newest add-on content, Dance of the Throne, is now available!
The Soul of Obsession carrying the will of all Demiurges has been summoned to Solas again, and it's here for revenge!
The leader of Demiurge, Elena, will be arriving as a playable character in this mode. Dance in a flurry of dual blades and experience a completely new challenge in Solas.
20th Aug 2020
"The Tides of Oblivion" DLC is available!
New story, maps and playable character.
Adventure with Jerold to explore the cursed Ichthyosauria!
■ Devices support:
- System run iOS 9 and above
- iPhone 6s and above
- iPad models with 2G RAM or more
■ Description
Pascal's Wager is an action role playing game with the style of dark fantasy. The game provides its players with top-notch picture quality and a feast for the senses that the mobile platform has never had before. In the game, the world is shrouded by dark mist, where light is dim and mysterious. People there become lunatic, and nobody knows the secrets behind that.
Players can play multiple characters to experience the strong storyline and reveal various hidden areas of the map. Along the way, they will fight unbelievable enemies, confront epic bosses, and embrace overwhelming death and truth. All the while, they'll be engrossed by a magnificent soundtrack performed by a world-class orchestra.
■ Features
- An incredibly Rich and Deep story, 20 or more hours of content
- Four operable characters, with different combat modes and skill trees
- Dozens of different enemies, bringing extensive experience of hectic battles
- Diversified NPCs, responding to independent subplots
- Three-dimensional map with multiple layers
- Cinematic performance and storytelling, fully voiced dialog
- Powerfully attractive soundtracks, performed by a world-famous symphony orchestra
- Full controller support to ensure the best possible gameplay experience
- Substantial post-launch DLC adding to the story and characters
■ Story
In ancient times, a natural disaster brought the Sun from high in the Sky to the depths of the Ocean, allowing a mysterious dark fog to blanket the World. 
Simultaneously, Colossi, beings that were revered by descendants, roamed the lands for the very first time. 
These Colossi, which emit the sparks of light that disperse the black fog, bring the only hope to mankind. 
Thousands of years later, humanity has long grown accustomed to following in the footsteps of these revered beings as they travel through the black fog. 
However, just as how the Sun was mysteriously brought down from the Sky, these Colossi have also began to fall mysteriously...
Terrence, a courier whom was expelled by the Church, has learned that his long estranged wife Teresa, may have some connection to the recent fall of the Colossi. 
Setting forth on a journey filled with anguish, deception and possible redemption, Terrence seeks to find his wife and the truth behind their World.

¡Descarga la app y abre tu cuenta sin costo! Sólo necesitas ser mayor de edad, contar con nacionalidad mexicana y tener a la mano tu INE o pasaporte vigente. Al crear tu cuenta, recibirás automáticamente el Nivel 2, que permite depósitos mensuales de hasta 3,000 UDIS. Después, podrás solicitar el Nivel 4 para depósitos de hasta 30,000 UDIS.
No importa tu experiencia en finanzas o el monto que tengas para invertir; te guiamos y ayudamos a elegir la mejor opción para invertir tu dinero y aprovecharlo más, sin esfuerzo, comisiones ni cobros ocultos.
DINN es la cuenta de inversión y tarjeta de débito de Banco Actinver, que en lugar de dejar tu dinero inactivo, lo pone a trabajar generando intereses diarios del 10% o del 50% de CETES a 28 días, según el saldo promedio mensual en tu cuenta.
Incluye una tarjeta de débito en línea exclusiva para compras en línea (CVV dinámico), y una física (con tecnología Contactless®) Visa Internacional válida en todo el mundo. Además, obtienes cashback en compras realizadas en comercios participantes.
Tenemos diferentes estrategias de inversión con distintos niveles de riesgo, volatilidad, rendimiento esperado y tiempo sugerido para invertir, nuestras estrategias invierten en fondos de inversión creados y operados por expertos de Actinver:
- Conservadora: Invierte en Actimed, un fondo compuesto por deuda gubernamental y corporativa (como Cetes y bonos) con la más alta calificación crediticia para que tu inversión crezca a paso seguro.
- Balanceada: Invierte en Impulsa, un fondo Multiactivo que se adapta continuamente a las condiciones del mercado. Con un respaldo en deuda sin perder de vista instrumentos como acciones, fibras, entre otros.
Accede a un Multiseguro de Protección Personal y Patrimonial ¡sin costo adicional! Al llegar a un monto mínimo invertido de $20,000 MXN.

bluejetty:00015907:ios.description:
A true and totally 3D app for learning human anatomy with muscle action movies, 3D position quiz and audio pronunciation, built on an advanced interactive 3D touch interface. 
***Want to try the app for free? Click on related apps and download the free version.
Features:
- You can rotate models to any angles and zoom in and out
- Virtual dissection: Peel layers of muscles and reveal the anatomical structures below them.
- more than 100 muscle action movies
- physiology animation videos
- Major bone markings
- Muscle descriptions: Origin, Insertion, Nerve, Action
- 3D location quizzes to test your knowledge
- Audio pronunciation for all anatomy terms.
- Latin names
- Search the name of anatomical structure and reveal the 3D location
- Switch on/off different anatomy systems
- Both male and female reproductive systems are available
- Load and Save Views (bookmaker function)
- Information from Wikipedia and Gray's anatomy textbook
- Great for learning anatomy and physiology
- Support French, Spanish and German languages!
Contents:
- Skeleton (all bones in our body)
- Ligaments 
- Bone markings
- Muscles (145 muscles, highly detailed muscle models)
- Circulation (arteries, vein and heart)
- Nervous system
- Respiratory system
- Reproductive system ( both male and female )
- Urinary system
- 3D Ear
- 3D Eye

bluejetty:00154522:ios.description:
The classic brick breaker game with a new twist! Your new Arkanoid addiction!
Can you be the villagers' hero and break them out of the monsters' stronghold?
Keep up with the bouncing ball and deflect it with your paddle in this classic breakout game!
From the creators of Coin Dozer and Prize Claw 2, Brick Breaker Hero is a whole new Arkanoid adventure!
Monsters have come to terrorize each kingdom in the land, and the villagers need a hero!
A hero has come, wielding a powerful shield and armed with magic spells to cast at the monsters and their brick obstacles. Will the Hero prevail, defeating the monsters and breakout the villagers?
Brick Breaker Hero is the breakout Arkanoid game you need to play!
Direct the Hero through the adventure, bouncing the ball off the shield and into the fray of obstacles. Break and destroy each brick, much like classic Arkanoid, until you've succeeded each level's mission! Destroy enemy minions, collect treasure, clear levels, and break out the helpless citizens!
- Classic brick breaker Arkanoid breakout gameplay with a modern, mobile twist!
- Over 200 fun and challenging levels!
- Many power-up spells your hero can cast, containing spectacular effects and aiding your quest to win each level!
- Unique kingdoms, each with their own theme and unique adventure!
- Boss and mini-boss fights, each having a new ability to challenge your hero!
- Easy to play, difficult to master: Try to achieve 3 stars on each level!

bluejetty:00082280:ios.description:
Web Messenger - Dual Chat helps you manage multiple chat accounts easily on one device. Access web chat, use dual accounts in parallel space, and connect quickly with phone number login. protect important conversations with secure chat backup options. Designed for speed and convenience, it allows smooth switching between accounts without logging out. Stay connected to personal and business conversations in one secure place.
Key Features of the Web Messenger - Dual Chat application:
1)Dual Chat - Parallel Space Support
Use two chat accounts on one device, keep work and personal chats separate, and switch instantly without logging out.
2)Login with Phone Number
Connect securely using your phone number for quick access. Simply enter your number, verify, and start chatting right away across multiple accounts.
3)Chat Backup & Restore
Protect important conversations with easy backup and restore options. Keep your messages safe and accessible whenever needed.
4)Web Messenger Access
Connect easily through web mode with a quick QR scan. Enjoy fast syncing and manage multiple accounts seamlessly on one device for efficient communication.
5)Direct Chat Without Saving Number
Send messages to any number without saving it in your contacts. Simply enter the phone number, start chatting immediately, and save time when contacting new clients, customers, or temporary numbers.
6)Simple & Clean Interface
Enjoy a smooth experience with a clean design that makes navigation easy for everyone.
Manage two accounts on one phone with Web Messenger - Dual Chat, secure phone number login, stable web access, direct chat without saving contacts, and reliable backup features - all in a simple, fast, and organized experience.
Web Messenger - Dual Chat is ideal for professionals, small business owners, freelancers, online sellers, and everyday users who manage multiple conversations daily. Switching between accounts becomes quick and stress-free while keeping chats organized and easy to access.
Enhance your chatting experience with the Web Messenger - Dual Chat app, the ultimate tool for managing your chats. Explore the myriad features designed to make your chatting Messenger usage seamless and enjoyable.
Disclaimer:
The Web Messenger - Dual Chat is an independent tool and is not affiliated with any other app. It is designed to back up chats for personal use. Please respect the privacy of your contacts and ensure you have the right to back up and share messages responsibly.

bluejetty:00120526:ios.description:
Reading Trainer improves your reading speed and reading comprehension with many challenging and fun exercises. App Store Rewind Award Winner – App of the Year DE, CH, AT
- Significant increases in your reading speed 
- Eye-exercises and improvements in your mental capacity 
- Improves reading comprehension and memory
This app provides everything you need to read texts of all types faster, more effectively and most of all, with better retention. 
The PowerReader allows you to get your daily work done while practicing important reading skills. 
Learning reading techniques has never been this much fun! 
Double your reading speed in just a few days. 
Trial users have used this software to increase their reading speed by an average of 143% in 10 days. 
Do you currently need 30 minutes to read the daily paper? Soon you will read two papers and, in addition, another chapter in an interesting non-fiction book – within the same time period. 
Combining the iPhone with this entirely new app provides the ideal platform to achieve measurable results with a minimum of effort. 
But that’s not all: You will have fun mastering the skills you need to attain effective reading techniques and significantly increase your reading speed; this means: 
- Rapid recognition of numbers, letters and words 
- Flexible eye movements 
- Improved ability to concentrate 
- Increased vision span 
The app guides you through the individual training steps. 
The software immediately recognizes your strengths and weaknesses. The statistics function lets you see and track your progress. 
The results of each training exercise are charted for your review. More stars mean that you are getting closer to your objective: more effective reading skills and with it extremely high reading speeds. 
You can check your reading speed at any time using different reading tests from a variety of topics. 
Questions about the text are used as a secondary test to assess your retention ability. This is the ideal combination for mastering effective reading skills and high retention rates. 
But beware: you might get hooked since early progress will motivate you to work on your skills regularly. 
It is fun and you are doing something to stay mentally fit at the same time. 
We recommend that you train regularly but not excessively to ensure best results. 
Who needs this app? 
- Anyone reading more than half an hour a day 
- Executives 
- Secretaries 
- High-School and College students 
- Purchasing and Sales Professionals 
Who can benefit from this app? 
- Do you often feel that you take too long to read something? 
- Do you return to previous passages because something was not clear? 
- Are you easily distracted while reading? 
- Do you have difficulty recalling what you read? 
If you answered ‘Yes’ to any of these questions, then this app is what you need.

bluejetty:00190789:android.description:
Dive in this NEW exciting game with a cute little newborn baby to grow up.
To make this possible, your warm care will be needed all the time. 
A baby will grow up in front of your eyes, and you will become a caring parent. All you need to do is give love, and you shall receive one.
At the beginning you will have to take care for a baby in a basket till his 6th month. After that the baby will grow, and it will leave his comfort basket, and it will go on a soft, warm and cozy carpet. 
Amazing new feature will be unlocked when baby grow old to 6th month. The feature is called – Face Detection.
What does the Face Detection do?
It’s similar to Animated Emojis. Using the front camera of your smartphone, the Face detection will analyze your face, and it will your baby’s face with your own face. And now the baby will be doing the same head movements you do. Super fun, and It’s real time. The baby will look like you.
As you continue to grow up your baby, the game will unlock new amazing features such as, football, basketball and many more other funny things to do. The baby game will also give you the full freedom to furnish the baby room, you will be able to change the room as you wish. You can change the baby’s clothes, the name of the baby, his gender, skin color and many, many more other things.
Dive into this super adventure game, and have fun.
For recommendations, and new features please contact us by email.

bluejetty:00183601:ios.description:
Mobile Banking from Somerset Regal Bank lets you bank securely anytime, anywhere from the convenience of your mobile device!
The Somerset Mobile Banking App is free* and allows you to:
• View your Instant Balance with a single tap, or login to view your Account History including check images
• Transfer funds between your accounts
• Schedule a Transfer in the future, or set up a recurring transfer
• Pay bills, manage bill pay contacts and view bill payment history
• Set-Up Real-Time Push Notification Alerts to stay informed of account activity instantly
• Deposit checks to your account by simply taking a picture of the check
• Locate the closest Somerset Regal Bank branch or ATM
• Manage your Somerset Regal Bank Debit Card
If you already have a Somerset Regal Bank Online Banking account, just download the Somerset Regal Mobile Banking App and login using your existing username and password. 
If you are not already enrolled in Online Banking, download the Somerset Regal Mobile Banking App and click the First Time User link to set-up both your Mobile Banking and Online Banking account. Once established you’ll have the convenience of both Online Banking and Mobile Banking to help make managing your accounts easier and more convenient.

bluejetty:00158363:ios.description:
Send real postcards, invitations and greeting cards with your own photos – straight from your iPhone or iPad, worldwide!
# HOW DOES IT WORK?
It's very simple:
- select your photos
- write your message
- add the recipient's address
- personalize the stamp if you wish
- send it!
We then print your card and ship it worldwide.
# SIMPLYCARDS PRODUCTS
Choose from 3 customizable formats:
- The standard postcard, 4.3" x 5.9", printed on special postcard paper (330 g) and laminated on the photo side, like traditional postcards.
- The XL postcard, identical to the standard postcard but 5.9" x 7.9", for a guaranteed wow effect!
- The Duo card, folded to 5.5" x 5.5", with 4 printed sides on high-quality cardstock (280 g) and sent in a beautiful white envelope, for all occasions!
# EVERY OCCASION IS A GOOD REASON TO SEND A PERSONALIZED CARD
Vacation postcard,
travel postcard,
birthday card,
Christmas card,
birth announcement, wedding invitation, baptism invitation,
invitation card,
greeting card,
thank-you card,
...
Or simply a card to share your best photos and make your loved ones happy!
# THE ADVANTAGES OF SIMPLYCARDS
- start from a ready-made template and personalize it however you like
- play with photo arrangements and layouts
- select photos from your iPhone or iPad, or directly from your Facebook or Dropbox account
- also choose beautiful artist photos from the Pixabay image library
- enjoy a wide choice of themes: birth, wedding, birthday, love, travel, invitation, thank you, condolences...
- personalize the stamp with a photo of your choice
- choose from a wide range of writing styles, colors and sizes
- sign your card with your fingertip
- access the addresses of your contacts and of cards you've already sent
- search for an address you don't know
- add a QR code to the card so your recipient can reply to you
- prepare several cards in advance with drafts
# HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?
To pay for your cards, buy a pack of credits: the more credits you buy, the less each one costs (packs of 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 75 or 150 credits).
Take advantage of the many promo codes we offer regularly!
Payments are secure and can be made by credit card or PayPal.
1 postcard = 1 credit
1 XL postcard = 2 credits
1 Duo card = 2 credits
Worldwide shipping is included!
Price example:
*** pack of 20 credits + promo code WELCOME = $2.55 per postcard with stamp! ***
Earn free credits by inviting your friends.
# GUARANTEED QUALITY: 100% SATISFACTION!
- professional photo-printing quality
- PEFC-certified paper, to respect our forests
- quality-checked to ensure a perfect print
- fast processing: cards are printed and shipped the next business day (Monday through Friday)
# OUR TEAM IS ALWAYS HERE FOR YOU
If your card hasn't arrived, or if you're unhappy for any other reason, we'll resend it free of charge or refund you.
SimplyCards customer service is always here for you (even on Sundays!).
Contact us by email (support@simplycards.com) or through the FAQ section of the app.
We'd love to hear from you.
See you soon on SimplyCards!

bluejetty:00145100:ios.summary:
Introducing Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter – a captivating blend of two classic gameplay styles in one thrilling adventure! collect and explore unique marine creatures while solving puzzles under the sea!
Dive into Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter
bluejetty:00145100:ios.description:
Introducing Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter – a captivating blend of two classic gameplay styles in one thrilling adventure! collect and explore unique marine creatures while solving puzzles under the sea!
Dive into Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter , where traditional bubble shooting meets innovative spinning mechanics. Explore the best of both worlds with two exciting modes: Classic Pop and Spin & Shoot. Whether you prefer the relaxing challenge of popping stationary bubbles or the dynamic excitement of spinning puzzles, Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter has something for everyone!
In Spin Bubble - Ball Shooter, not only will you enjoy the dynamic spinning bubble mechanic, but you'll also get the chance to dive into a vibrant underwater world. As you progress through levels, you'll unlock and collect a variety of sea creatures that roam freely in your aquatic playground. These delightful creatures bring life to the game as you pop bubbles, solve puzzles, and explore the mysteries of the ocean.
Two Gameplay Modes:
Classic Pop Mode：Ball Shooter 
By aiming, shooting, and matching bubbles of the same color. With over 8000 levels of strategic puzzle-solving, this mode delivers an immersive experience for bubble-shooting fans. Collect power-ups, use boosters, and clear obstacles as you travel through enchanted lands!
Spin & Shoot Mode ： Spin Bubble
Experience a fun twist with this spinning variation of the classic match-3 puzzle! The rotating bubble clusters add a layer of excitement to every shot, making it an addictive yet relaxing puzzle experience. Master the spinner mechanics, pop bubbles strategically, and uncover new worlds with powerful boosters and surprises.
Key Features:
● Two Exciting Modes
Enjoy both Classic Pop for strategic gameplay and Spin & Shoot for a dynamic puzzle experience.
● Collect Marine Creatures

bluejetty:00131068:ios.description:
Plan your hunt and find more success in the field with onX Hunt. Access 1.8 billion acres of public land, 161.5 million private properties, and 15,880 unique hunting units. Use GPS navigation, 3D offline maps, and localized species data to know where you stand.
Understand the landscape with Satellite, Lidar Topo, and Hybrid Basemaps. Save Offline Maps and feel confident in your backup plan with onX SOS. Research property lines and locate hunting properties to avoid accidental trespassing. Monitor optimal weather conditions and find new opportunities nationwide with custom Map Layers.
Keep your hunt safe, organized, and efficient. View Trail Cameras for recent activity, display routes on your vehicle dash, and sync industry-leading rangefinders and binoculars. See your hunting group’s live locations and share Map Markups with nearby devices.
Trusted by 5,000 game wardens, find more game and hunt smarter with onX Hunt.
onX Hunt Features:
▶ What tools can I use to prepare for the hunting season?
Stack the odds in your favor with Hunt Research Tools. Use onX Hunt on desktop to know your draw odds, tag trends, and harvest statistics. Access Huntin’ Fool’s expert research as an Elite member and set reminders for application deadlines.
▶ How do I know where I can legally hunt?
Use private land boundary data with landowner names to know where you stand (U.S. only). Identify GMUs, Hunting Units, public land, and state land hunting maps. View terrain with 3D Lidar Topo, Satellite, and Hybrid Basemaps. Add Waypoints and set Optimal Wind conditions.
▶ How can I customize and share my hunt?
Hunt smarter with terrain analysis tools and scout any tag with state-specific Map Layers. Research conditions, cell coverage, access points, wildlife, soil, and more. Collaborate by sharing Hunt Areas or Tracks, and see your partners move with live, session-based Location Sharing.
▶ Can I navigate without cell service and hunt alone safely with onX Hunt?
Download Offline Maps to view the details you need, no matter where you are. Monitor localized weather forecasts and record your path. Maintain your bearings with our built-in GPS and pinpoint areas using Compass Mode. Unlock onX SOS to access professional dispatch and rescue coverage.
▶ Which tools does onX Hunt integrate with?
Display maps on your vehicle’s dash with Apple CarPlay and mark your location from your wrist using Apple Watch. Drop Waypoints automatically by syncing with compatible rangefinders and binoculars. Connect trail cameras to see images in real-time and receive localized Insights on deer movement.
▶ Premium Membership:
Access all of the features listed above in a single state or Canada.
▶ Premium+ Membership:
All Premium benefits but for two states, or one state plus Canada.
▶ Elite Nationwide Membership:
Get a purpose-built solution for dedicated hunters and the game they pursue, including:
• Proprietary maps for all 50 states and Canada
• TerrainX 3D Viewer, Recent Imagery, Route Builder, Deer Movement Forecast
• In-dash navigation with Apple CarPlay
• Elite-exclusive pro deals and expert resources
• Draw Odds and Application Tools
▶ onX SOS:
When something goes wrong in the field, onX SOS connects you to a 24/7 professional rescue team that coordinates help and covers rescue and evacuation costs.
• Available as an add-on subscription for $49.99/year
• Powered by Overwatch x Rescue (OxR)
▶ Government Information & Data Sources
onXmaps, Inc. does not represent any government or political entity, though you may find various links to public information within our services. For more info, click on the associated .gov link.
• https://data.fs.usda.gov/geodata/
• https://gbp-blm-egis.hub.arcgis.com/
• https://www.arcgis.com/home/group.html?id=00f2977287f74c79aad558708e3b6649#overview

▶ Privacy Policy: https://www.onxmaps.com/privacy-policy
▶ Feedback: Please contact us at support@onxmaps.com

bluejetty:00018665:ios.summary: We believe that food is humanity's strongest bond. It plays on all your senses and can take you to places you’ve never been. We have always treated food as an experience, which is why our goal is to ensure that what we offer is food for the
bluejetty:00018665:ios.description:
We believe that food is humanity's strongest bond. It plays on all your senses and can take you to places you’ve never been. We have always treated food as an experience, which is why our goal is to ensure that what we offer is food for the soul.
Our story begins in 2006 when our founder, Jalal Abu-Gazaleh, was supplying top-tier 5-star hotels all over Cairo with premium meat and seafood. After introducing an unprecedented quality of Australian beef to the Egyptian market, it became clear there was a hunger for such products amongst the Cairo community. We made customer satisfaction the root of our mission to revolutionize the way people shop for their groceries, making it less of an errand and more of a joyful journey.

bluejetty:00126034:ios.summary:
Всего за несколько минут в день вы научитесь составлять предложения на английском.
Мы специально оптимизировали уроки для мобильных устройств. Информация дается в сжатом виде, затем методом многократного повторения закрепляется в памяти.
bluejetty:00126034:ios.description:
Всего за несколько минут в день вы научитесь составлять предложения на английском.
Мы специально оптимизировали уроки для мобильных устройств. Информация дается в сжатом виде, затем методом многократного повторения закрепляется в памяти. 
В короткие сроки вы научитесь правильно строить простые выражения, незаметно для себя выучите много новых слов. 
Как проходят занятия
Занятия проходят в игровой форме. Программа предлагает простое выражение на русском языке. Из английских слов на экране нужно составить правильный ответ. Если вы ответили правильно программа похвалит вас, если вдруг ошиблись – подскажет правильный ответ.
Правильный ответ озвучиваются.
В любое время можно прочитать теоретический материал или заглянуть в подсказку. Подсказка синхронизирована с заданием. 
В качестве подсказки предлагается таблица спряжения английских глаголов по временам. Отображается тот глагол, который употребляется в задании.
Занимаясь в программе, вы попутно выучите основные неправильные глаголы.
Метод хорошо зарекомендовал себя для начинающих изучать английский с нуля и для продолжающих.
Список уроков:
1. Базовая форма глагола.
2. Местоимения. Вопросительные слова.
3. Глагол "to be". Предлоги места. Like/Want.
4. Притяжательные местоимения.
5. Профессии. Этикет.
6. Степени сравнения прилагательных. Указательные местоимения.
7. Слова-параметры. Употребление much и many.
8. Предлоги и параметры времени.
9. There is / There are.
10. Предлоги направления и движения.
11. Модальные глаголы can, must, should.
12. Continuous
13. Прилагательные. Описание людей. Погода
14. Present Perfect
15. Повелительное наклонение
16. Фразовые глаголы
Материал изучается последовательно. Контроль изучения реализован следующим образом:
• за правильные ответы начисляются баллы
• без активации доступен один урок
• после активации доступны все уроки по мере набора 4.5 балла в предыдущем
Алгоритм начисления баллов:
Программа помнит 100 последних ответов, количество ПРАВИЛЬНЫХ ответов делит на 100 и умножает на 5. Чтобы набрать 4.5 балла, надо ответить правильно на 90 вопросов из 100.
Алгоритм расчета баллов позволяет быстро перейти к следующему уроку, если вы знаете тему хорошо, и не позволит этого сделать, если ваших знаний недостаточно.
Для тех, кто хорошо знает язык, в программе реализован режим повышенной сложности (включается в настройках). В сложном режиме ответ требуется ввести с клавиатуры по буквам, а не выбрать из представленных на экране вариантов. То есть надо знать как пишутся английские слова.
Подробнее об этой и других программах для изучения иностранных языков читайте на нашем сайте:
* http://polyglotmobile.ru/
Присоединяйтесь к нам ВКонтакте.
* http://vk.com/polyglotmobile
Условия использования:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00091554:ios.description:
Download The Short Years app and create your first baby book chapter in just five minutes!
Once a week, The Short Years App will remind you to upload a photo and answer a couple of questions about your baby’s milestones and special moments. Many parents tell us they do this while feeding their baby or watching a show on Netflix.
We’ll turn your text, photos, and even video into beautiful baby book pages!
Once you’ve purchased your book, we will start printing and shipping your pages to you every time you complete three chapters in the app. Just pop them in your book!
And, if you want to capture all of the sweet memories until your baby turns five, simply add on “The Toddler Years” at checkout. Doing so will allow you to access The Toddler Years chapters in your app and to receive these extra chapters in print to add to your baby book. 
The Short Years Baby Book has a premium fabric cover, handcrafted to stand up to a lifetime of enjoyment and measuring 11.5” x 9.25”. It is bound with three matte black rings, making adding pages to it a breeze.
The book includes:
*19 chapter covers (+ an additional 5 if you upgrade to The Toddler Years) for easily organizing your book’s pages as they are shipped to you.
*Hands and feet prints pages to take with you to the hospital or birth center.
*Six lined journaling pages for jotting down extra notes 
*Personalized name card for cover
*Free printing and shipping of all 119 of your baby book pages documenting baby’s first year.
Discover the easiest way to document and cherish your sweet one’s first year!

bluejetty:00017306:ios.description:
BUILD YOUR DREAM TOWN!
Welcome to Township, a thrilling city-building and farming game where you become the mayor of your own town!
Build houses, factories, and community buildings, grow crops on your farm, and decorate your town just the way you like. Take part in limited-time events, compete in exciting regattas, and earn exclusive prizes!
Need a break from city planning? Jump into relaxing match-3 puzzles to earn rewards, speed up your progress, and unlock even more fun - all available offline!
Township - the perfect blend of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!
GAME FEATURES:
● Unlimited creativity: Design and build the metropolis of your dreams!
● Engaging match-3 puzzles: Complete fun levels to earn rewards and boost your progress!
● Exciting competitions: Test your skills against players from around the world in regular competitions - win prizes and make unforgettable memories!
● Exclusive collections: Gather valuable artifacts, rare antiquities, and colorful profile pictures to showcase your achievements!
● Offline play: Enjoy Township anytime, anywhere - even without an internet connection!
● Vibrant community: Meet friendly characters with unique personalities!
● Social connections: Play with your Facebook and Game Center friends or make new friends in the Township community!
Why You'll Love Township:
● A unique mix of city-building, farming, and match-3 gameplay!
● Stunning graphics and charming animations
● Regular updates with fresh content and special events
● Personalize your town with a wide variety of decorations
Township is free to play, but some in-game elements (including randomized items) can be purchased for real money. If you don't want to take advantage of this option, simply turn it off in your device's Restrictions menu.
A Wi-Fi or internet connection is not required to play.
*An internet connection is required to access competitions and additional features.
Do you like Township? Follow us!
Facebook: facebook.com/TownshipMobile
Instagram: instagram.com/township_mobile/
Need to report an issue or ask a question? Contact Player Support through the game by going to Settings > Help and Support. If you can't access the game, use the web chat by clicking the chat icon in the lower right corner of our website: https://playrix.helpshift.com/hc/en/3-township/
Privacy Policy:
https://playrix.com/privacy/index.html

Unlock the power of your mind alongside Mark Stephens, a leading
bluejetty:00145137:ios.description:
Struggling with sleeplessness, fatigue, or smoking cessation? Look no further. Let meditation and hypnosis be your guide to overcoming these challenges with the MindFree app.
Unlock the power of your mind alongside Mark Stephens, a leading hypnotherapist and bestselling author. Through a combination of meditation and hypnotherapy, you'll retrain your brain to shed excess weight, alleviate anxiety, and achieve holistic well-being.
Discover a comprehensive range of audio and video sessions tailored to address various aspects of your life, from improving sleep quality to boosting confidence and overcoming addictions. With over 400 sessions available, ranging from 3 minutes to 3 hours, you'll find the perfect solution to meet your needs.
The MindFree app is designed for users of all levels, with interactive features perfect for beginners and advanced users alike. Take control of your body and mind, and embark on a journey towards mindful eating, addiction cessation, and overall happiness.
Explore new features such as Habit Buster and Negative Anchoring to facilitate behavioral change, along with daily meditation sessions to kickstart your mornings and unwind in the evenings. Plus, enjoy an enhanced user experience with improved Session and News pages.
Choose from specialized programs like "Think Slim" for weight management, "Think Sleep" for deep relaxation, and "Think Calm" for stress relief. Whether you're looking to conquer phobias, boost confidence, or increase motivation, MindFree has you covered.
Stay on track with customizable reminders and daily affirmations, ensuring consistency in your practice. Interact with flying butterflies for encouragement and tap on shining stars for actionable steps towards your goals.
Join the MindFree community today and take the first step towards a healthier, happier you.
Subscription terms and pricing:
MindFree offers an auto-renewing monthly subscription at only $12.99 AUD/month and an auto-renewing yearly subscription at only $124.99 AUD/year to provide you with unlimited access to all MindFree sessions while you maintain an active subscription. MindFree also offers a lifetime subscription for $499.99 AUD which is paid for by a one-off upfront payment with unlimited access to all MindFree sessions forever.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Monthly or annual subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You may manage your subscription, including turning off auto-renewal, by going to Account Settings after the purchase.
Read more about our terms of use at www.mindfreeapp.com/terms-of-use. Our privacy policy is at www.mindfreeapp.com/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00098378:ios.description:
Scale for Weighing & Grams turns your phone’s camera into a pocket-sized scale. Just snap a photo of an item and our AI instantly estimates its weight with impressive accuracy, letting you choose the unit—grams, ounces, pounds, kilograms, and more.
Key Features
 • AI-Powered Weight Estimation (Requires In-App Purchase)
Point, shoot, and receive a precise weight reading in seconds—no external hardware needed.
 • Multi-Unit Conversion (Requires In-App Purchase)
Instantly toggle between metric and imperial units so you always get numbers that make sense to you.
 • Smart Object Detection (Requires In-App Purchase)
The app automatically identifies common items (fruits, packages, ingredients, coins, and beyond) to fine-tune its calculations.
 • Measurement History (Requires In-App Purchase)
Keep a tidy log of every object you’ve weighed, complete with photos, dates, and notes for easy reference.
 • Custom Calibration (Requires In-App Purchase)
Improve accuracy by calibrating the AI with everyday household items you already trust (e.g., a 1-liter water bottle).
 • Accessibility-First Design
Large fonts, voice prompts, and a clean layout ensure everyone can capture weights with confidence.
Whether you’re portioning ingredients, estimating postage, or just satisfying curiosity, Scale for Weighing & Grams makes weighing effortless—anywhere, anytime. Full functionality requires an active subscription.

Key Featu
bluejetty:00015578:ios.description:
Picture Bird is a useful and smart bird identifier app that can recognize any bird species by photo or sound. Simply take/upload a picture of a bird or record a bird's sound, and you can get everything you want to know about it. 
Key Features:
Accurate Bird ID:
With machine deep learning technology in pictures and sound recognition, the Picture Bird app can identify up to 10,000+ bird species with incredible accuracy. bluejetty:00080116:ios.description:
Dive into a world of puzzle perfection with "Match Family" – your ultimate destination for endless matching fun! 
With a blend of captivating levels and exhilarating challenges, this puzzle-matching game promises hours of engaging gameplay that not only entertains but also sharpens your sorting prowess. 
Embrace the opportunity to become a matching maestro as you navigate through a series of diverse missions, all while enjoying a leisurely and satisfying gaming experience.
Engage your brain, enjoy a relaxing yet fun time as you sift through goods, matching them into triples, and embark on various missions.
With its user-friendly mechanics, this game is perfect for both beginners and seasoned players looking to refine their strategy and logic skills. 
Whether you're at home or on the go, "Match Family" offers the convenience of offline play, allowing you to dive into the puzzle world anytime, anywhere.
How To Play:
- Keep your eyes peeled and tap on three identical tiles to connect and create triples in a delightful display of matching prowess.
- Immerse yourself in the satisfying process of sorting and matching, with the goal of clearing all target items from the screen to progress through the levels.
- Rise to the occasion by meeting the unique objectives set at the start of each level, propelling yourself towards the pinnacle of 3D puzzle game mastery!
- Time is a precious commodity here! Each level is a race against the clock, urging you to strategize swiftly to fulfill the level's objectives.
- Finding yourself in a bind on a particularly tough level? "Match Family" comes equipped with a suite of powerful boosters designed to help you navigate through sticky spots. Deploy these extraordinary aids to progress through the game and unveil an array of exciting items, including fruits, animals, candy, and much more!
Key Features:
- Harness the power of incredible boosters to overcome challenging scenarios with ease.
- Experience beautifully crafted match 3D levels that captivate and challenge.
- Embark on engaging brain-training missions designed to sharpen your cognitive abilities in a fun and interactive way.
- Enjoy a relaxing, easy-to-play triple-matching game that's the perfect remedy for unwinding.
- "Match Family" is entirely free to play, offering the convenience of enjoying the game both online and offline. No need for Wi-Fi or an internet connection!
Prepare to be enthralled by a gameplay experience that keeps you glued to your screen for hours on end. 
And remember, while Triple Match 3D ads provide a glimpse into the game, the actual gameplay is packed with even more excitement and challenges. 
Don't wait any longer – your ultimate puzzle adventure awaits!

Share your feedback with us to help us continue improving!
Email: brogameacc4top@outlook.com
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/happygaming-ios-pp
EULA: https://sites.google.com/view/happygaming-ios-eula

bluejetty:00132244:ios.summary:
► ARE YOU A FARMER OR A FIGHTER?
In this fun new idle role-playing game, you’re both, with sidelines in mining, crafting, construction and management too. In fact, you’re a king, with a kingdom to protect, expand and develop, and if you wa
bluejetty:00132244:ios.description:
► ARE YOU A FARMER OR A FIGHTER?
In this fun new idle role-playing game, you’re both, with sidelines in mining, crafting, construction and management too. In fact, you’re a king, with a kingdom to protect, expand and develop, and if you want to succeed there’s a lot of work ahead of you. Start with just a small squad of swordsmen and a few berry trees, then get working to build a city, feed your people, raid enemy castles for resources and experience, expand your army and turn your tiny village into a flourishing and fearsome empire.
► ARE YOU WORTHY OF THE CROWN?
• Turn your swords to plowshares: Start the game farming berries, sell them at market to feed your hungry people and use the coins you make to invest in the development of your kingdom and your wars of conquest. 
• …and your plowshares into swords: Spend the profits you make from crafting in this all-action RPG on expanding and upgrading your army, with five different types of soldier to recruit and improve. Turn your small band of raiders into a mighty horde of fiercely armed knights and archers, ready to conquer the known world.
• Head for the longboats: Time management and resource mining aren’t enough: a great king has to prove themselves in battle. So, once you’ve taken care of your subjects’ basic needs, earned coins and upgraded your army, sail off to war, raiding over 90 enemy towns and castles for plunder and XP.
• The builder king: Equip your town with new houses and facilities. The game has over a dozen different types of resources for you to craft into over 150 different new buildings and industries, from warehouses to taverns to luxurious palaces, that will also bring you idle profits when you’re out of the game.
• By royal command: Of course, a king needs soldiers, but you’ll also need a whole host of other workers to keep your kingdom and your idle income ticking over. Hire and upgrade farmers, woodcutters, miners and more to really make your craft empire flourish.
• Go ballista: Start every battle with a bang by using the ballista to hit the enemy where it hurts. Upgrade this powerful weapon to get access to ten increasingly destructive types of projectiles so you can really show the enemy who’s king of the castle!
► ARE YOU READY FOR A ROYAL ADVENTURE?
Download King or Fail now and dive into an all-action RPG that combines crafting, conquest and world-building in a fun and addictive casual format. If you like the idea of role-playing as a hard-working, hard-fighting medieval monarch determined to build the biggest, fiercest, most prosperous kingdom, you’re guaranteed to enjoy King or Fail. Failure—like boredom—just isn’t an option.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Heritage South CCU Mobile Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Heritage South CCU Mobile Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Heritage South Community CU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00129451:ios.name: Emperor of Mahjong: Tile Match
bluejetty:00129451:ios.summary: Travel back in time to Ancient Rome in Emperor of Mahjong®! A struggling settlement in a remote but beautiful corner of the Roman Empire needs your help to be restored to its former glory. Play thousands of tile matching levels, meet charis
bluejetty:00129451:ios.description:
Travel back in time to Ancient Rome in Emperor of Mahjong®! A struggling settlement in a remote but beautiful corner of the Roman Empire needs your help to be restored to its former glory. Play thousands of tile matching levels, meet charismatic characters, follow the suspenseful storyline and build this close-knit village into a sprawling Roman city!
This game is a unique and epic combination of city building and tile pairing, tied together with a storyline full of twists and turns, Mediterranean culture, and an atmospheric and vibrant setting of Ancient Rome. You’ve been named the prefect of a troubled settlement in a distant corner of the Roman Empire. Help the determined residents revive their community after a disastrous betrayal by your scheming predecessor, Cassius. Reconstruct an impressive settlement that’s worthy of legends, thwart Cassius’ evil machinations and ensure that fortune favors your citizens once again! On your way to prosperity, collect achievements and get special tools, such as the Shuffle booster (which gets you out of a difficult situation), the Firecracker booster (which blows up multiple pairs of tiles) and many other innovative features that can enhance your gameplay experience!
● PLAY through a unique blend of mahjong and city building in one game
● GO on an adventure through Roman history, fantasy, and myths
● MEET villagers, nobles, craftsmen, Gods and mortals on your way to glory
● MASTER thousands of immersive marjong, majong, majhong, mah-jongg or mahjongg levels – these are the popular ways to misspell “mahjong”
● WIELD incredible boosters and power-up combos
● UNLOCK a variety of beautiful buildings and landmarks in the city to rebuild and upgrade
● FOLLOW your friends’ progress with the innovative built-in social network
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings
You can play this game even if you’re offline!
Game available in: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Ukrainian.

bluejetty:00127919:ios.summary:

Measuring a length is now easier than with a las
bluejetty:00127919:ios.description:
Measure anything with CamToPlan! Horizontally and vertically! Length, distance, area of any surface… Measure everything with this virtual ruler and tape measure thanks to augmented reality. 
Measuring a length is now easier than with a laser meter or any other measure tool. You draw your measurement lines in 3D thanks to the camera directly on the video of your phone or tablet. You export your plans in PDF, PNG or DXF. CamToPlan is the AR measuring app that brings your measures from cam…to…plan !
For personal or professional use, always measure like a pro. Thanks to Virtual Reality (VR), you can measure floors, dimensions of walls, windows, doors or a whole home in a few seconds. No more tape measure or ruler needed!
This app has infinite applications for everybody:
- Personal use: the length measure app for the handyman who loves DIY !
- Real estate professionals (real estate agent, interior design decorator or designer, architect, topographer, energy adviser...): this app will help you make a floorplan of a house, apartment, a specific room of a flat.
- Construction workers can use it to quickly measure jobs : concreter, tile layer, carpet fitter, painter, drywall guy, plasterer, builder, carpenter, electrician, plumber, slater... 
- For gardener, landscaper, swimming pool builders and maintenance, digger, earth-moving, navvy: this app also works outside
- Cost estimation professionals: this length measure app can make pricing estimates, it will be a great assistant for quantity surveyor, price studies technician, economist…
- Building industry: foreman, site manager or engineer can drop their tape measure and ruler to perform a quick measurement check
How does this measuring app work?
It relies on ARKit by Apple. Machine learning algorithms combine the device sensors data (accelerometer, gyroscope…) with odometry which analyses in real time the video of the camera and relies on visual details of images, in order to scan the environment and find the position and rotation angle of the device.
Please note: 
- you can measure in metric (meters, centimeters) or imperial units (feet, inches)
- the app measures distances horizontally (= on the ground) and vertically!
- no need to remove the furniture from the room for measurements. The application determines the intersection between the floor and the target, even if it is hidden.
- The application may have difficulty with some types of tiles.
- The accuracy is not guaranteed.
- you can move while performing measurements to get closer to your target point, for maximum precision, even if it is not visible and calculated by extrapolation.
CamToPlan Premium = 
+ No ads
+ Vertical mode
+ Expert mode
+ Unlock Edit & Export
+ Access all your drawings
CamToPlan Premium is a recurring subscription. You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by going to your account settings on the App Store. Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your Apple ID account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
Terms of use: http://misc.tasmanic.com/camtoplanterms2.html
Privacy policy: http://misc.tasmanic.com/iosctppolicy2.html

bluejetty:00186898:ios.summary: General Aviation news, interviews, pilot safety tips, and listener questions answered. These clear and concise, “just the facts” podcast audio recordings deliver relevant information for all pilots, and student pilots who want to learn to f
bluejetty:00186898:ios.description:
General Aviation news, interviews, pilot safety tips, and listener questions answered. These clear and concise, “just the facts” podcast audio recordings deliver relevant information for all pilots, and student pilots who want to learn to fly, without the fluff and banter sometimes found in podcasts. The episodes are strictly about General Aviation; when an airline story is discussed, its always in the context of what a GA pilot could learn from an airline-related story or accident. 
We also interview aviation leaders who are in the news in our NewsMakers episodes. In some of these episodes, survivors of an aircraft accident or incident share what they learned.
You can find aviation news on lots of web sites. But I bring you a perspective on the news that comes from over forty years as a pilot. In addition to news, on each show I talk in depth about a pilot skill or safety issue. And I spend a lot of time researching information, so you can rely on what you hear. Listeners have given me tons of feedback, and they say they find the show interesting, informative, and chock-full of relevant content and commentary. They like that the show is to the point and doesn't waste their time.
Why I do the Show. I created Aviation News Talk because, while I love being a cohost on the Airplane Geeks podcast, there isn't enough time on that show for me to share all the information I’d like with listeners. And, as I listened to other aviation podcasts, I wasn't finding the kind of general aviation show I was looking for. I teach flying 5-6 days a week, and often after a flight, I think, “I need to share this information with other pilots to help keep them safe.” That's why I started this show...to provide valuable information that might help save a life (and I've already been told by one pilot that something I told her saved her life!). 
Your Host. Max Trescott is the 2008 National Certificated Flight Instructor of the Year. He is a Cirrus Platinum CSIP flight instructor who helps potential Cirrus SR20 and SR22 buyers around the country evaluate the many tradeoffs involved in deciding whether to buy a new versus a slightly used Cirrus. He’s based in the San Francisco Bay area and specializes in teaching in G1000, Avidyne, and Perspective glass cockpit airplanes such as the Cessna, Diamond, and Cirrus planes, and Eclipse and Phenom jets. bluejetty:00149813:ios.description:
HeartsApp by Heartfulness Institute is an app for Heartfulness functionaries, primarily for trainers and volunteers.
The app is a one-stop shop designed to help trainers and volunteers in their day-to-day Heartfulness-based activities.
HeartsApp enables trainers to conduct online meditation sessions and to track online and offline (in-person) meditation sessions.
Here are the features of HeartsApp for Trainers
- Trainers can register new users

bluejetty:00065565:ios.summary:

Backed by neuroscience and mindfuln
bluejetty:00065565:ios.description:
Struggling with binge eating, emotional eating, or stress eating? Eat Right Now® helps you break free from food cravings and build mindful eating habits that last—without dieting, restriction, or guilt. 
Backed by neuroscience and mindfulness, Eat Right Now is clinically proven to reduce craving-related eating by 40%*. The program helps you retrain your brain so you can stop overeating, manage food cravings in real-time, and finally feel at ease in your relationship with food. 
Whether your goal is weight loss, better health, or freedom from overeating, Eat Right Now gives you the tools, lessons, and support you need to change your eating habits for good. 
Join Eat Right Now to… 
- Identify what triggers emotional and stress eating habits 
- Practice mindful eating techniques to enjoy food without guilt 
- Reduce craving-related eating one step at a time 
- Build long-term habits that support weight loss and health naturally 
With Eat Right Now, you will receive: 
- Daily guided lessons to learn at your own pace 
- Mindfulness exercises, theme weeks, and bonus content 
- Interactive tools to work with food cravings in real-time 
- 24/7 moderated community and journal 
- Live weekly sessions with our team of behavior change experts 
- Optional weight management modules 
- Customizable daily goals and reminders 
For individuals, Eat Right Now offers a 7-day free trial and subscription plans. On the 7th day of your free trial, your subscription will officially begin. 
Subscription plans: 
- 1-month: $24.99 USD 
- 6-month: $99.99 USD 
- 1-year: $129.99 USD 
Eat Right Now also offers Weight Loss and Diabetes Prevention Program tracks through employers, health plans, and public sector. Contact us at Sharecare to learn how you can provide Eat Right Now to your population. 
Enterprise version developed by clinicians and in accordance with CDC guidelines. 
*According to a 2017 study from University of California San Francisco. 
PRICING & TERMS 
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country's residence. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. 
Your Eat Right Now premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end term and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes Account Settings after purchase, but refunds will not be provided for the unused portion of the term. 
Need help with the app? Please email support@goeatrightnow.com or go to https://claritasmindsciences.zendesk.com/hc/ 
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://www.sharecare.com/terms/privacypolicy 
For scientific references: https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=GjmDbisAAAAJ&view_op=list_works&sortby=pubdate

bluejetty:00019169:ios.description:
Türkiye'nin en çok oynanan online kelime oyunu 27 milyon üyeye ulaştı! Bu başarıya ulaşmamızı sağlayan tüm oyuncularımıza teşekkür ediyoruz. Siz de Kelimelik ailesine katılmak ve arkadaşlarınızla Türkçe kelime oyunu keyfini yaşamak için hemen ücretsiz oyunumuzu indirin.
Oyunumuzun Özellikleri:
>> 2 farklı oyun modu: Klasik Kelimelik ve 5'lik
>> İsterseniz 3 güne kadar hamle süresi olan sakin oyunları, hızlı oynamak istiyorsanız 2 dakika hamle süreli seri oyunları oynayın. 
>> 5'lik oyun seçeneği ile 5 turluk kıyasıya rekabetin tadına varın.
>> Aynı anda 20'ye kadar oyun açabilir, bu sayede bekleme olmaksızın oyuna devam edebilirsiniz.
>> Her hafta düzenlenen Süper Lig'e katılarak şampiyonluk mücadelesine girebilirsiniz.
>> Facebook hesabınız ile giriş yaparak arkadaşlarınızı oyuna davet edebilir, eski ve yeni dostlarınız ile karşılıklı oynayabilirsiniz.
>> Dilerseniz rastgele oyuncular ile de oyun oynayabilir, yeni arkadaşlıklar kurabilirsiniz.
>> Oyun oynarken karşınızdaki kişi ile sohbet edebilirsiniz.
>> PRO üyelik ile reklamları kapatabilir, puanları otomatik hesaplatabilir, seri oyun açabilir, aynı anda açılabilecek oyun sayısını arttırabilir, farklı pro görünümüne ulaşabilirsiniz. Ayrıca PRO üyelere harf tablosu özelliğini hediye ediyor ve 10 kişilik arkadaş listesi özelliğini de açıyoruz.
>> Otomatik puan hesaplayıcı ile puanınızı otomatik olarak anlık hesaplayabilirsiniz.
>> Seri oyun seçeneği ile dakika bazında hamle süresine sahip oyun açabilirsiniz.
>> Harf tablosu ile hangi harften kaç tane kaldığını öğrenebilirsiniz.
>> Arkadaş listesi ile sık oyun oynadığınız kişileri ekleyebilir ve onlara kolayca ulaşabilirsiniz.
>> Renkli çerçeve ile profil çerçeve renginizi değiştirebilir, kart resimleri ve rozetler ile oyuna karakterinizi katabilirsiniz.
Oyunumuz sizden gelen istekler doğrultusunda sürekli olarak geliştirilmektedir. Tüm öneri ve eleştirilerinizi iletisim@he2apps.com adresine gönderebilir, https://facebook.com/KelimelikOyunu ve https://twitter.com/KelimelikOyunu hesaplarımızı takip edebilirsiniz. 
Oyunumuzda Türk Dil Kurumu Güncel Türkçe Sözlüğü 'nü referans almaktayız. Bu sözlüğe https://sozluk.gov.tr adresinden ulaşabilir, kelimelerimizi kontrol edebilirsiniz.
Kelimelik sunucu masraflarını karşılayabilmek için oyun içerisinde bulunan reklamlardan gelir sağlamaktadır. Yayınladığımız reklamlar ile siz oyuncularımıza verdiğimiz rahatsızlıktan dolayı özür dileriz.
İsterseniz oyun içi satın almaları kullanarak PRO üyelik satın alabilir, bu şekilde reklamları kapatıp aynı anda 50 oyun açma gibi özelliklere kavuşabilirsiniz. PRO üyelerimize puan hesaplayıcı, seri oyun, harf tablosu ve renkli çerçeve özelliklerini ücretsiz veriyor ve 10 kişilik arkadaş listesini kullanmalarını sağlıyoruz. 
Oyunlarımızla ilgili güncel duyurulara ulaşmak için aşağıdaki kanallardan bizi takip edebilirsiniz:
Web: http://he2apps.com 
Facebook: http://facebook.com/KelimelikOyunu 
Twitter: http://twitter.com/KelimelikOyunu
E-posta: iletisim@he2apps.com
Kelimelik oyunumuzu indiren, ve üyelik oluşturarak oyuna giriş yapan tüm kullanıcılarımız "Kelimelik Üyelik ve Kullanım Sözleşmesi" içerisinde yer alan hükümleri okumuş, anlamış ve kabul etmiş sayılır. Kelimelik Üyelik ve Kullanım Sözleşmesi belgesine aşağıdaki adresten ulaşabilirsiniz:
http://he2apps.com/kelimelik/kelimelik_uyelik_sozlesmesi.html

bluejetty:00117704:ios.description:
Play and create your own Football Soccer Results Pools with GameOn
Create your friend group, make your predictions, follow live matches, and compete to see who knows the most about football / soccer.
With GameOn, you can play Pools for the Copa América, UEFA Euro, Libertadores, Sudamericana, national and international leagues, and much more.
Whether you call it a Pool, Prode, Penca, or simply “predicting results,” this app is for you. Organize competitions with friends, family, or coworkers, and enjoy soccer like never before.
--
Show off how much you know about soccer with your predictions
Predict match results before they start and earn points according to the rules. The more correct predictions you make, the higher you rank in your group.
-- 
Points for correct predictions:
• Exact result: 6 points
• Winner + goal difference: 4 points
• Winner or draw: 3 points
You can change your predictions until the match begins.
--
Create your own Pool or Group and join other groups
GameOn is made for sharing.
Create private and personalized groups for your friends, family, or coworkers. Easily invite others via WhatsApp, Telegram, email, or social media.
Each group has its own ranking, prediction history, and a private chat to comment on matches, celebrate correct predictions, or throw some playful banter.
Want to join an already created pool? You can also join official Pools for each tournament, open to all users.
--
Clear organization by rounds and dates
Find all matches organized by date or by round, depending on the competition.
Navigating through tournaments is easy and intuitive. Whether you want to make all your predictions at once or day by day, you can do it however you prefer.
--
Live matches and personalized notifications
Follow all matches live with minute-by-minute updates.
GameOn lets you receive notifications for match starts, goals, halftime, and final results.
Additionally, you can set alerts only for the leagues or teams you're most interested in.
--
All the info you need to improve your predictions
Want to predict with strategy? Access all the relevant information before and during the match:
• Updated standings after each match
• Live statistics: possession, shots on goal, attacks, fouls, etc.
• Match details: time, stadium, referee, and more
--

Create your friend group, make your predictions, follow live matches, and compete to see who knows the most about football / soccer.

• Exact result: 6 points

bluejetty:00075963:ios.description:
沉浸式的單機體驗，帶你回到純真的童年......
放肆的在這碩大的武林探索！

現在加入煙雨江湖，燕雲風起，劍鳴十六聲，劍指天下，稱霸武林！
超沉浸單機武俠RPG遊戲《煙雨江湖》
這，就是你期待已久的武俠!
還記得，以前玩遊戲，看劇情感動到痛哭流涕？
還記得，以前玩遊戲，拼命逛社群找攻略的樂趣？
還記得，以前玩遊戲，都想要到處搜尋以找到寶物？
《煙雨江湖》將打破你對手遊的想像，以無盡的江湖世界，融入百萬字跌宕起伏的故事劇本。你將在這裡，探索超深入劇情，無限解鎖新地圖，享受最原汁原味的單機武俠遊戲!
【遊戲特色】
【開放世界，給你最狂的自由體驗】
無盡武林地圖，任你自由遊歷，參加節慶活動，踏遍沙漠雪山，尋找奇人異士。最開放的江湖世界，超豐富隱藏彩蛋，等你來搜索!
【百萬字劇情，打造最沉浸的江湖武林】
自由探索NPC劇情，極致互動體驗，你的每一項選擇都將隨機觸發不同江湖事件。用玩的方式，解開一道道煙雨江湖故事主、支線!
【解鎖千本武學秘笈，你是誰你說了算】
鐵布衫、倚天劍訣、凌波微步、五毒神掌、韋陀心法
天下武功，千千萬!
你將踏訪各地武館、挑戰江湖隱士，獲取各式武學秘笈，外練武學套路，內通經脈心法。你練就的水上漂，真實可見!
【天下門派，全部精通】
太乙、少林、泠月、蒼狼、天刀五大門派，鼎足天下。棍拳劍槍刀，各具特色。從門派任務到上乘武學，你或可成為門派掌門，或可叛門拜師，你，可以練就所有武功，成就一個人的武林! 最真實武林情境，由你選擇!
【超多種江湖日常玩法，練就一身絕技】
行走江湖者，必身懷絕技也。除了一身武藝，你還將學會各種日常技藝，釣魚酒藝煉丹庖丁鍛造所有你想學的古老技藝，這江湖都有!
【結伴高手，輪番上陣】
江湖夥伴各有所長，有醫者有平民有江湖遺孤。通過不同事件，你將結交資質不凡夥伴，自由發展他們的天賦，學習多種經典陣型，臨敵上陣，手刃綠林!
本遊戲輔級：12 級
本遊戲內容涉及暴力、不當言語
本遊戲為免費使用，但遊戲部分內容或服務需另行支付其他費用
請注意遊戲時間，避免沉迷遊戲，可能影響身心健康

現在加入煙雨江湖，燕雲風起，劍鳴十六聲，劍指天下，稱霸武林！

超沉浸單機武俠RPG遊戲《煙雨江湖》
這，就是你期待已久的武俠!

還記得，以前玩遊戲，看劇情感動到痛哭流涕？
還記得，以前玩遊戲，拼命逛社群找攻略的樂趣？
還記得，以前玩遊戲，都想要到處搜尋以找到寶物？

《煙雨江湖》將打破你對手遊的想像，以無盡的江湖世界，融入百萬字跌宕起伏的故事劇本。你將在這裡，探索超深入劇情，無限解鎖新地圖，享受最原汁原味的單機武俠遊戲!

【遊戲特色】
【開放世界，給你最狂的自由體驗】
無盡武林地圖，任你自由遊歷，參加節慶活動，踏遍沙漠雪山，尋找奇人異士。最開放的江湖世界，超豐富隱藏彩蛋，等你來搜索!

【百萬字劇情，打造最沉浸的江湖武林】
自由探索NPC劇情，極致互動體驗，你的每一項選擇都將隨機觸發不同江湖事件。用玩的方式，解開一道道煙雨江湖故事主、支線!

【解鎖千本武學秘笈，你是誰你說了算】
鐵布衫、倚天劍訣、凌波微步、五毒神掌、韋陀心法
天下武功，千千萬!
你將踏訪各地武館、挑戰江湖隱士，獲取各式武學秘笈，外練武學套路，內通經脈心法。你練就的水上漂，真實可見!

【天下門派，全部精通】
太乙、少林、泠月、蒼狼、天刀五大門派，鼎足天下。棍拳劍槍刀，各具特色。從門派任務到上乘武學，你或可成為門派掌門，或可叛門拜師，你，可以練就所有武功，成就一個人的武林! 最真實武林情境，由你選擇!

【超多種江湖日常玩法，練就一身絕技】
行走江湖者，必身懷絕技也。除了一身武藝，你還將學會各種日常技藝，釣魚酒藝煉丹庖丁鍛造所有你想學的古老技藝，這江湖都有!

【結伴高手，輪番上陣】
江湖夥伴各有所長，有醫者有平民有江湖遺孤。通過不同事件，你將結交資質不凡夥伴，自由發展他們的天賦，學習多種經典陣型，臨敵上陣，手刃綠林!

bluejetty:00070997:ios.description:
This app lets you listen to your favorite parts of songs.
—THE STORY—
Oftentimes at the gym or while driving, I used to fumble with my phone to restart a song or skip ahead to my favorite part. 
It was both annoying and unsafe.
I wished my phone could just read my mind and play the parts I wanted.
So I built an app that does exactly that.
It's *life changing* for me, and I think you'll enjoy it as much as I do.
— PLAY YOUR FAVORITE PARTS —
Pelascope lets you clip songs: choose where songs start and stop. You can use this to cut out long intros, loop verses, skip over middle parts you don't enjoy, and anything else you can think of.
It's easy to get started: (1) download, (2) add music, and (3) use your finger to set the start & stop points on songs.
— ADD APPLE MUSIC & SPOTIFY SONGS —
You can import songs and playlists directly from Apple Music and Spotify. It's fast and easy: see the instructions in the app.
— ADD SCREEN RECORDINGS & AUDIO FILES —
Add screen recordings from Camera Roll or audio files from Files.
---
Features:
• Customize start and end times for songs (single clip)
• Add multiple clips to a song
• Loop song clips
• Export songs from "My Music" section
• Artist Emoji — decorate "Now Playing" with emojis when your favorite artist is playing
Import From Anywhere:
• Add songs & playlists from Apple Music or Spotify
• Import screen recordings from your camera roll
• Download audio from remote URLs (e.g. mp3 files)
• Import audio from Files
More Features:
• Dark, Light, and (WL)Red themes
• Drag and drop to rearrange playlist order
• Add GIFs to artwork
• Share songs with friends (supports automatic conversion between Apple Music & Spotify)
• Add custom artwork
• Unlimited playlists and songs
• Music play stats
Real User Reviews:
• “Love the way this app works” — User review, March 2021
• “This is the best music modifying app!!” — User review, January 2021
• “This app is the second coming of god” — User review, June 2020
Pelascope Pro:
Pelascope is free to use, but it offers advanced functionality for a one-time purchase. See in-app for more details.
Privacy Policy: https://www.saturdaytechnologies.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.saturdaytechnologies.com/terms

bluejetty:00184779:ios.description:
Play classic solitaire card games with Solitaire City - one of the first 500 apps on the original iOS App Store that launched in 2008!
Enjoy Klondike Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, FreeCell Solitaire, Pyramid, TriPeaks, and many more in one of the most complete solitaire collections available. Learn new games as you play with interactive training and hints - no confusing rules to read.
Whether you love classic solitaire or want to learn new solitaire card games, Solitaire City includes a unique interactive training system that teaches you the rules while you play. No confusing instructions - just start playing and learn every solitaire game naturally.
Complete each solitaire game as quickly as possible to earn higher scores. Compete against players around the world on Game Center leaderboards and see how your solitaire skills compare with friends and global players.
Nearly 70 Solitaire Games and Variations
Enjoy one of the largest solitaire collections available:
• Klondike Solitaire (6 variations)
• Spider Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• FreeCell Solitaire (7 variations)
• Double Klondike Solitaire (3 variations)
• Spiderette Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• Tri-Peaks Solitaire (2 variations)
• Scorpion Solitaire One, Two and Four Suits
• Alternations Solitaire (4 variations)
• Three Shuffles and a Draw
• Demon/Canfield Solitaire (4 variations)
• Poker Squares (4 variations)
• Pyramid Solitaire (4 variations)
• Cribbage Squares (3 variations)
• Golf Solitaire (4 variations)
• Casket Solitaire (2 variations)
• Eliminator Solitaire (3 variations)
• Yukon Solitaire (3 variations)
• La Belle Lucie
• Demon Fan
• Shamrocks
• Fan
• Super Flower Garden
• Baker's Dozen Solitaire
• Blind Alleys Solitaire (2 variations)
• Accordion Solitaire (2 variations)
Solitaire City Features
• Universal iPhone and iPad solitaire app
• Smooth tap or drag card gameplay
• Classic Klondike solitaire (patience)
• Windows Solitaire rule numbers.
• Beautiful HD graphics for all Retina displays
• Enhanced HD graphics on iPad
• Play solitaire in portrait or landscape
• Rotate your device during play
• Stunning card animations and visual effects
• Fast timed scoring system
• Game Center leaderboards & achievements
• Interactive solitaire training system
• Hint / Suggest Move button
• Detailed solitaire statistics
• Listen to your music while playing
• Fun sound effects and customizable sound themes
• Custom card backs and backgrounds
• Use photos from your album as card backgrounds or card backs
• Multiple card deck styles
• Replay the same solitaire deal anytime
• Unlimited undo moves
• Automatically saves your game
• Left-handed and right-handed play options
Notes:
• Three Shuffles and a Draw and La Belle Lucie appear under the Fan Games section.
• Enable Confirm New/End Game in Settings if you want confirmation before ending a game.
• Prefer playing solitaire in bed? Lock the screen orientation to portrait or landscape in Settings.
• You can either drag cards onto other cards or use the Tap to Move feature - tap on a card to highlight it grey and then tap where you want it to move to. You can turn Tap to Move off from the Solitaire City Settings screen if you always drag cards.
Try our other games: Yatzy Master, 10 Pin Shuffle, and Silly Saucers, also available on the App Store.

bluejetty:00128117:ios.name: Stud Finder: AI Metal Detector
bluejetty:00128117:ios.summary:
Find hidden metal behind walls using your phone's magnetic sensor.
Stud Finder turns your iPhone's built-in magnetometer into a wall scanner and EMF meter. It detects ferrous metal (iron, steel) by measuring changes in the magnetic field i
bluejetty:00128117:ios.description:
Find hidden metal behind walls using your phone's magnetic sensor.
Stud Finder turns your iPhone's built-in magnetometer into a wall scanner and EMF meter. It detects ferrous metal (iron, steel) by measuring changes in the magnetic field in microteslas (µT): metal studs, the nails and screws that hold drywall to wood studs, steel pipes, rebar and other magnetic objects.
HOW IT WORKS
Your phone measures the magnetic field around it. When you open the app, a short guided calibration takes a baseline away from metal: you tilt the phone around a ring, and if metal nearby throws it off, the app tells you and starts over. After that, a rise over the baseline means there is metal close by. Slide the phone slowly across the wall: on a wood stud it beeps at each screw, and on a steel stud it beeps all along.
WHAT THE READINGS MEAN (above baseline)
- Empty wall: about the baseline (10–60 µT)
- Nail or screw: +5 to +20 µT
- Paper clip or washer: +20 to +50 µT
- Pipe or screwdriver: +50 to +100 µT
- Metal stud: +80 to +150 µT
- Strong magnet: +150 to 300+ µT
FEATURES
- Shows where your iPhone's sensor is, with a light at the edge of the screen that turns red over metal
- Guided calibration that checks you did it right
- Real-time µT reading
- Adjustable sensitivity
- Sound and vibration alerts
- Four-step tutorial
- Works without internet
TIPS FOR BETTER ACCURACY
- Take off the phone case before calibrating
- Calibrate away from walls, tables, appliances and laptops
- Pass the spot the app marks over the wall: on some iPhones it is at the top, on others at the bottom
- Beeps everywhere? Calibrate again near that wall, or lower the sensitivity
USE IT TO
- Locate studs behind drywall before hanging a shelf or a TV
- Find hidden screws, nails and steel pipes
- Measure magnetic fields around devices and magnets
Note: the magnetometer only reacts to magnetic (ferrous) metal. It does not see wood, plastic, copper or aluminum.

bluejetty:00039170:ios.description:
Ситимобил — это сервис для заказа такси, а также доставки посылок и грузов. Являясь популярной и доступной службой городской мобильности, мы каждый день помогаем миллионам людей, обеспечивая свободу перемещения и предлагая выбрать лучший вариант поездки или услуги для любой жизненной ситуации:
• Такси — на все случаи жизни. Различные тарифы - Эконом, комфорт, комфорт плюс, бизнес, минивэн, детский, мульти
• Доставка — когда можно не ехать, но нужно передать документы, ключи или чемодан 
• Грузовое такси — заказать грузовой автомобиль теперь просто, как и легковое такси, всего лишь указав начальную и конечную точку поездки в приложении «Ситимобил»
• Эвакуатор — можете быть уверены в том, что ваш автомобиль будет аккуратно погружен, зафиксирован и доставлен до места назначения опытным водителем-оператором эвакуатора.
• Программа лояльности, кешбэк — мы начисляем 2% от суммы завершенного заказа такси бонусами на счёт. 1 бонус = 1₽. Бонусами можно оплатить до 20% поездки на легковом такси
• Такси заранее — можно сделать предварительный заказ. Если для вас важно, чтобы автомобиль прибыл в определенное время, вы можете заказать его заранее
• Работаем с 2007 года
• Круглосуточная служба поддержки 
Города присутствия: Москва, Санкт-Петербург, Волгоград, Воронеж, Екатеринбург, Казань, Краснодар, Красноярск, Нижний Новгород, Новосибирск, Омск, Пенза, Пермь, Ростов-на-Дону, Самара, Саратов, Тольятти, Ульяновск, Уфа, Челябинск и другие. Мы работаем более чем в 100 городах России и планируем расширять свою географию!
