bluejetty:00130756:ios.description:
Welcome to the delightful world of Vita Crossword - a calming, mindfulness-inspiring crossword puzzle game that has been meticulously crafted for seniors. Anchored in our unwavering commitment to facilitate an ideal blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, we embark upon celebrating the beauty and strength of words in a traditional crossword setting.
The games we have released or are about to release include vita solitaire, vita word search, vita block, vita color, vita Jigsaw, vita FreeCell, Vita Spider Solitaire, Vita Crossword, Vita Mahjong...
What sets Vita Crossword apart from its brethren is the emphasis on drawing logical connections between words. Unlike its sibling, Vita Word, this iteration requires players to harness the power of overlapping letters intelligence to unravel interconnected word puzzles. It's a graceful ballet of cognition, language, and logic that injects an additional layer of intrigue and satisfaction into your gameplay experience.
Our tenacious commitment to delivering the most exceptional gaming experience tailored for elderly users is unambiguously portrayed through every feature of Vita Crossword. The user interface proudly features larger letter tiles and grid squares to ensure reading and interaction are as effortless as possible - minimizing strain on the eyes. Our controls are intuitive, and grasped, thereby ruling out technology-induced anxiety. These attributes combine harmoniously to create not just an environment that is senior-friendly, but also enjoyable and empowering.
While our puzzles lean more towards the simpler side of the difficulty spectrum in Vita Crossword, catering to beginners or those yearning for a serene hobby, we've thoughtfully woven challenging constituents to retain the interest of even seasoned crossword enthusiasts. Hence, ensuring they are continuously mentally stimulated.
Vita Crossword isn't merely a peaceful hobby; it's also a personal trainer for your brain! Regular engagement with our puzzles can assist in decelerating cognitive decline, enhancing memory recall, and preserving mental agility—All occurring against a backdrop of relaxing, beautifully designed backgrounds that amplify your sense of tranquility.
In summary, Vita Crossword extends:
- A user-friendly application design that’s visually comfortable, easily navigable, and elder-empowering.
- A variety of intellectually stimulating crossword puzzles encompassing various difficulty levels.
- A gentle yet intriguing challenge via the intertwining logic of crosswords.
- Serene backdrops create the perfect ambiance for a tranquil gameplay experience.
- Regular updates to maintain interest and engagement.
Your journey towards relaxation, mental activation, and peaceful enjoyment can be initiated at Vita Crossword. This place is - Where Every Letter Intersects With Fun masquerades as a starting point for your enchanting voyage into the sphere of calming amusement, diverse skill development, and brain fitness. Don't postpone peace and enjoyment any longer! Step into the tranquility of Vita Crossword, where we promise you a safe, welcoming space for seniors to explore the timeless charm of crossword puzzles. Forget circumventing the complexities of modern games; embrace the straightforward pleasure offered by Vita Crossword today! Embrace the world within the gridlines where relaxation meets fun, and every day is a new opportunity to exercise your cognitive skills while having a great time. GlacierGrid Cooling Intelligence Platform (GCIP) prevents food waste with refrigeration monitoring and reduces electricity bills by optimizing energy consumption of HVACs and refrigerators. Both efforts result in lower CO2 emissions. 

With GlacierGrid's mobile app it’s fast and easy to manage daily operations, make HVAC temperature adjustments, and reduce food spoilage by taking action when alerts occur. Leading brands like McDonald, TGI Fridays, and Dominos rely on GlacierGrid for energy management and refrigeration monitoring.

This app includes popular features such as:
• Real-time temperature and humidity monitoring
• Customizable alert notifications when issues occur
• Temporary HVAC setpoint adjustments
• Temperature logbooks for compliance reports
• Equipment performance review and insights
• Team and user management
• Easy plug-and-play onboarding

If your employer already has an account, simply download the app and sign in to access your company's content.

About GlacierGrid:
GlacierGrid’s mission is to reduce CO2 emissions by helping customers prevent food waste and reduce their electricity bills. Thousands of customers trust us with their refrigeration monitoring and energy management needs.

bluejetty:00123137:ios.summary:
Your bank in your pocket. Secure, fast and anytime, anywhere. It starts here. 
Not a Santander customer already? Well hi there! Come on in and make yourself at home. Simply download the App and we'll guide you through an application to jo
bluejetty:00123137:ios.description:
Your bank in your pocket. Secure, fast and anytime, anywhere. It starts here. 
Not a Santander customer already? Well hi there! Come on in and make yourself at home. Simply download the App and we'll guide you through an application to join us* 
Already a customer? Nice one! You can get started by using your usual log on details (Don't already have log on details? Visit santander.co.uk to register – it's quick & easy) 
Now, we're pretty proud of our App and we've got good reason to be - it's award winning* Not only that, but it's secure, fast and you can use it anywhere, anytime, which is great if you're bit of a night owl. 
Here's the basic lowdown on what you can do: 
•            check your balance and statements. We know, it's a pretty scary task to do after a big night out 
•            not sure if you've already paid for something? Search transactions will let you find out instantly 
•            transfer money between your Santander accounts. Perfect if you want to put some spare cash away for a rainy day, or save for that new car 
•            send money to other people. Which is great if you're splitting the bill 
•            check your Direct Debits and standing orders 
•            control your card, 'freeze' it in those moments where you're sure your cards somewhere in the house, just not sure where 
•            pay in cheques, up to £5k a day 
•            we've got some handy features like My Money Manager and My Home Manager. Let’s just say it'll make things a lot more 'insightful' 
•            thanks to biometrics, payment authorisation and discreet mode you can rest easy knowing you're banking securely. 
But you can do so much more too! 
Head on over to the "Products & Offers" section in our app to find out more. We can help you get to where you want to be 
That's enough reading for now, let's get stuck in. Tap "Download" and see for yourself. 
————————————————————————— 
We know, the small print can be kind of boring. But it's important too. So, here it is… 
(1) Applications are subject to status, eligibility, and credit scoring 
(2) Our app won an award - Best Digital Financial Inclusion Initiative 2024 at the Global Retail Banking Innovation Awards 
For full details of our product range, key facts documents and terms & conditions, visit www.santander.co.uk 
Remember: 
• Never share a One Time Passcode (OTP) or your Security Number with anyone. Not even a Santander employee. 
• Santander will never call to ask to log on to your mobile device or computer, or ask you to download any type of software 
Always manage your push notifications in our Mobile Banking App and turn push notifications off in our app on any old devices you’re no longer using to make sure you don’t miss important notifications. 
Interest rates within our Play Store images are for visual purposes and may not be the latest rates. 
This app is available in English language only.
Santander Mobile Banking will not run on devices that have been jailbroken. 
Please make sure you have the latest Apple software on your phone so that our app runs smoothly. Your device will need to be running iOS version 16 or above to use this app. 
Apple, Touch ID and Face ID are trademarks of Apple Inc. registered in the US and other countries. App store is a service mark of Apple Inc. 
Santander UK plc. Registered Office: 2 Triton Square, Regent's Place, London, NW1 3AN, United Kingdom. Registered Number 2294747. Registered in England and Wales. www.santander.co.uk. Authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority and the Prudential Regulation Authority. Our Financial Services Register number is 106054. You can check this on the Financial Services Register by visiting the FCA’s website www.fca.org.uk/register. Santander and the flame logo are registered trademarks.

Stay ahead of your travel plans with our comprehensive *flight tracker* app, designed to keep you updated on real-time flight information. - Player stats & reports

- Keep your app updated to get the latest performance improvements, including digital ticket enhancements, bug fixes and newly added features.
- Stay Connected! Enable your Push Notifications and Location Services to receive alerts about breaking news, live videos, injury updates, special offers and more, directly to your device.

bluejetty:00091664:ios.summary:
Much more than a powerful, personalized schedule for students and teachers at The College Preparatory School.
SCHEDULE
CPS Campus brings you an all new experience for an all new school year. A new rotating schedule dynamically populates w
bluejetty:00091664:ios.description:
Much more than a powerful, personalized schedule for students and teachers at The College Preparatory School.
SCHEDULE
CPS Campus brings you an all new experience for an all new school year. A new rotating schedule dynamically populates with your customized courses, and notifies you when your classes begin and end. Want to create a meeting? Just long press on any block in your schedule to create an event in your calendar. Want to export your schedule? Tap on the share button to do so and add school holidays to your calendar. Style your courses with the all-new Palette Studio. And you can add schedule widgets to your Home Screen. 
HOME
The Home page intelligently organizes your current and next classes, Common Classroom details, RHF points and drop-in classes, and more. And you can rearrange and configure the information that's displayed, and dive into to designated pages from the top.
CLUBS & SPORTS
Follow the student clubs and athletic teams you join to receive personalized notifications for their meetings or games. View their individual pages for leaders, members, links, upcoming meetings, future games, and search for just what you need anytime. And if you're a club leader, you can customize your page with link, plus request a meeting or bake sale straight from the app.
CAMPUS ID
Also, everything—that means schedule, clubs, and sports—securely syncs across your Apple devices via your Campus ID, including CPS Campus for macOS. Your Campus ID gives you access to the new school Directory as well, where you can see other students’ classes, socials, clubs, and more. And with powerful privacy features, you’re in control of what you share with others.

Come play a fantasy board game where you roll dice and travel to hundreds of gorgeous and interactive boards! - Open card packs, trade cards with friends and club mates, and complete your album to win HUGE rewards!
Download now and start rolling the dice in PRIZE KINGDOMS!
Need help? Tap the Support button in the settings menu in the Prize Kingdoms game, or send us a message at support@prizekingdoms.com.

bluejetty:00097157:ios.summary: Flash Drive – Backup My Data is a powerful, easy-to-use app designed to transfer my data, back up, manage, and protect your digital life. Whether you’re switching phones with a smart switch, freeing up storage, or organizing files across de
bluejetty:00097157:ios.description:
Flash Drive – Backup My Data is a powerful, easy-to-use app designed to transfer my data, back up, manage, and protect your digital life. Whether you’re switching phones with a smart switch, freeing up storage, or organizing files across devices, Flash Drive gives you full control of your photos, videos, contacts, and documents in one secure place.
Built for modern storage needs, Flash Drive – Backup My Data works seamlessly with popular flash storage solutions such as thinkplus, usb c drive, kingston pendrive, usb c otg, samsung flash, ugreen, sandisk drive, orico c drive, xiaomi flash, hp memory stick, memory stick, hp flash, lexar c drive, and other usb devices. It’s the ideal companion if you’re looking for an experience similar to the sandisk memory zone app or need a simple way to transfer my data quickly and safely.
Simple Backup & Smart Switch
Moving to a new phone? Flash Drive – Backup My Data acts as a reliable smart switch, helping you back up and restore your photos, videos, and contacts with just a few taps. It’s perfect for users familiar with tools like my verizon app or sandisk memory zone app, but looking for a more flexible solution across different storage brands.
Works With Your Favorite Flash Drives
Connect your rospe flash drive, ixpand drive, usb c drive, hp memory stick, thinkplus, xiaomi flash, or any compatible usb device to instantly manage and move files. Whether you’re using sandisk storage or another brand, Flash Drive – Backup My Data keeps everything organized and accessible.
Key Features
Transfer My Data Easily
Quickly transfer my data between your iPhone, flash drive, and computer—no internet required.
Organize Your Files
Browse, copy, move, rename, or delete files with a clean, intuitive interface inspired by the best of the sandisk memory zone app experience.
Free Up Space
Move large photos and videos to a usb, usb c drive, or ixpand drive to instantly reclaim space on your device.
Automatic Backup
Set up automatic backups so your memories are always protected when you connect your flash drive—ideal for everyday use or phone upgrades with a smart switch.
Secure Your Data
Add password protection to keep sensitive files safe on your sandisk, rospe flash drive, or other supported storage.
Storage Insights
See total, used, and available space at a glance on your connected usb, hp memory stick, or xiao

bluejetty:00150685:ios.description:
LiveEQ is the leading mobile equestrian app! Find horses, stables, equine jobs, trainers, events, service providers and more on LiveEQ for FREE. List your stable, horse, job, business listing and more completely free. LiveEQ is the best tool to grow your equestrian business and to find new opportunities in the horse world. Discover how the leading equestrian app can open doors for you today.
Discover horses that meet your criteria with helpful filters such as breed, age, discipline, price, and more. Locate stables or instructors in your area that provide the services you need at the right price and location for you. Find new events to build your show calendar from A-rated to local school shows. Browse equestrian jobs to discover your next opportunity in the equine industry. 
FIND HORSES
Filter through our extensive list of breeds, age ranges, disciplines and more to find the horse that fits you! Listing a horse for sale or lease? Build a beautiful listing quickly and for free on LiveEQ! Receive and respond to message inquiries directly within the app so you don’t have to give out your personal information until you’re ready. 
LOCATE STABLES
Looking for a new home for your 4-legged best friend, or maybe a riding program for yourself or someone you know? Filter by location, discipline, services offered, price and much more to find the perfect set up before you even go through a tour. When you're ready to meet, send the stable a direct message and start a conversation directly in the app! 
Stable owners and managers can create a beautiful profile to get in front of new potential clients. Users can go directly to your website, call a phone number you list, or message you directly in the app to set up new appointments. 
MEET INSTRUCTORS
Whether you're a complete beginner or a seasoned professional, a good coach is irreplaceable. That's why we've made it easier than ever to connect with instructors and trainers of all skill levels and price ranges! If you're an instructor looking for new clients - simply create a free Professional profile and get instant responses! 
PLAN YOUR EVENT CALENDAR
Horse shows can be hard to find. Use our easy search and filtering functions to plan your complete horse show calendar from A rated events to local schooling shows. Event managers: easily list your show with your class lists, entry forms, and more in minutes. 
FIND EMPLOYMENT AND EMPLOYEES
Finding equine jobs through word of mouth or Facebook groups is a thing of the past. With LiveEQ, you can browse thousands of jobs in the equine space tailored to your skill level and availability. Looking for new employees? Create a new job posting in minutes and start receiving messages from applicants!
FIND A SERVICE PROVIDER OR LIST YOUR BUSINESS
On LiveEQ, it's completely free to list your equine business! Create a service provider listing for your Farrier, Equine Dentistry, Equine Photography business and many more. LiveEQ makes it easier than ever to find service providers that meet your criteria. Filter by price range, service, and location to quickly get in touch with providers that can care for your horses needs.

bluejetty:00179465:ios.summary:

Whether you're a beginner or experienced meditator,
bluejetty:00179465:ios.description:
Find calm in just 5 minutes. Over 100 guided meditation sessions, breathing techniques, mood journaling, and sleep programs — everything you need to build a lasting mindfulness practice.
Whether you're a beginner or experienced meditator, Mindfulness gives you the tools to reduce stress, sleep better, and understand your emotional patterns — at your own pace.
GUIDED SESSIONS
100+ voice-guided meditation sessions across 12 topics:
• Sleep — Guided body scans, evening wind-downs, and deep relaxation (10–50 min)
• Anxiety — Calm racing thoughts and find your center
• Stress — Quick decompression and deep stress-relief practices
• Morning — Energizing routines to start your day with intention
• Self-Compassion — Cultivate kindness toward yourself
• Focus — Sharpen concentration and cut through mental fog
• Social Anxiety — Build confidence and ease in social situations
• Gratitude — Guided appreciation practices for a positive outlook
• Awareness — Deepen present-moment observation
• Navigating Change — Find stability during life transitions
• Imposter Syndrome — Recognize your worth and overcome self-doubt
• Anger & Emotions — Cool down, set boundaries, and master your reactions
Each topic includes standalone sessions and multi-day programs.
MEDITATION COLLECTIONS
Audio-guided meditations for every need:
• Mindfulness and deep relaxation
• Sleep and rest
• Self-esteem and confidence
• Walking meditation
• Mindful eating
• Pain relief and body relaxation
• Stop smoking
From 2 to 50 minutes, beginner to advanced.
MOOD JOURNAL
Track how you feel before and after each meditation. Choose from 40 emotions, add tags, discover patterns, and get Apple Intelligence insights. The app suggests the right session or technique for your emotional state. Syncs across devices with iCloud.
BREATHING TECHNIQUES
60+ courses and lessons teaching meditation skills:
• Breathing, body scan, visualization, focus
• Courage and change — anxiety, grief, forgiveness
• Wisdom — non-dual awareness, contemplative inquiry
• Daily life — procrastination, decision-making
Beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels.
AMBIENT SOUNDS
Layer rain, ocean, forest, river, fire, or white noise into any session.
PRACTICE INSIGHTS
Charts and statistics for streaks, practice time, and consistency.
TIMER MODE
Silent meditation timer with customizable bells.
DAILY TIPS
A fresh mindfulness tip every day.
MORE FEATURES
• Apple Health integration
• Personalized reminders and mood-based recommendations
• 10 languages supported
• Beautiful, distraction-free design
WHY MEDITATE?
Scientific research shows regular meditation leads to:
• Reduced stress and anxiety
• Improved focus and concentration
• Better sleep quality
• Greater emotional well-being
"Meditating daily for 8 weeks creates significant changes in brain areas associated with memory, well-being and stress." — Sara Lazar, Massachusetts General Hospital
Start your journey today — just 5 minutes is all it takes.
---

With CheqUPI, your stay, whether for leisure, business, or long-term, is met with the easiest and most authentic way to transact financially, just like the locals do.
Features include:
• Blazing fast and secure digital payments via UPI
• Scan QR code and pay at 55 million merchants across India
• Make online payments using your own UPI handle
• Top-up funds anytime, anywhere using international credit/debit cards
Getting Started
• Download the app
• Sign up using international/Indian phone number
• Pay a one time activation fee
• ⁠Top-up your wallet and make your first UPI payment
• 24/7 friendly customer support
• ⁠Complete in-person verification
Please Note:
1) Currently, as per government norms, foreign nationals from countries on the FATF list and FATF grey list are not permitted to use the app.
2) Due to regulations, Cheq app can only be used while you're within Indian borders. Our servers detect your current location and restrict transactions being initiated from outside Indian borders.
3) You need to complete the in-person verification process by either visiting our partner branches or booking an agent.
4). Documents required are
Foreign nationals (Passport, a valid Indian Visa)
OCIs (Passport, OCI card)
NRIs (Passport, valid foreign country ID)
5) Payments can only be made to registered merchants. Individual (P2P) payments are not permitted
CheqUPI wallet is powered by Transcorp International Limited, an RBI regulated PPI license and AD2 license holder. Your data and money are stored safely & securely within India. Your money is safely parked in an RBI approved bank account hosted with Transcorp International Limited.
Visit our website for more details https://www.chequpi.com/ or call/Whatsapp on +919845563750 to know more.

bluejetty:00090549:ios.description:
The Swachhata-MoHUA is the official app of Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), GOI. 
The app enables a citizen to post a civic-related issue (eg; a garbage dump) which is then forwarded to the city corporation concerned and thereafter assigned to the sanitary inspector of the particular ward. 
The app has been built by IChangeMyCity – a division of Janaagraha, a Bengaluru based non-profit working to improve the quality of life in India’s cities and towns.
How does it work?
Take a picture of the Civic-related issue using your smart phone, and post it in one of the following categories.
・Garbage dump
・Garbage vehicle not arrived 
・Dustbins not cleaned
・Sweeping not done
・Dead animals
・Public toilet(s) cleaning
・Public toilet(s) blockage
・No water supply in public toilet(s)
・No electricity in public toilet(s)
The app will capture the location while the picture is being taken. Just type in the landmark of the complaint location. The complaint will then be assigned to the concerned sanitary inspector/engineer.
You can also vote up on any other complaint relevant to you. You will get regular updates on the status of the complaint in the form of a push notification with the ‘Resolved’ image uploaded by the assigned sanitary inspector/engineer. 
You can also reopen the complaint if you are not satisfied with the resolution of the complaint.

bluejetty:00114492:ios.description:
- Free AI roleplay chat. Create characters, build stories, stay safe.
Talk the way you imagine. Spark Chat is a character-first AI roleplay app where you can freely create companions, set personalities and boundaries, and co-write stories that remember context—safely and in your style.
What you can do
- Roleplay with depth: Chat with AI companions that adapt to your tone and keep long-context memories for richer stories across fantasy, sci‑fi, romance, adventure, slice‑of‑life, and more.
- Create your own characters: Define personality, backstory, goals, relationships, and conversation starters. Save templates for quick reuse.
- Build story worlds: Organize characters, locations, timelines, and lore to keep multi-chat narratives consistent.
- Style and control: Adjust creativity, tone, and response length. Use presets to stay in-character.
- Safe by design: Clear content filters, block/report tools, and privacy options put you in control.
- Share and discover: Explore community prompts and character templates, or publish your own.
- Multilingual: Roleplay in multiple languages.
Why it stands out
- Character-first memory for believable roleplay.
- Flexible creator tools without complex setup.
- Fast, high-quality AI replies tuned for storytelling.
How it works
1. Pick or create a character.
2. Start a chat, set the scene and tone.
3. Evolve the story together and manage your world.
4. Save and share characters and templates.
Pricing
- Free to start. Optional in‑app purchases/subscriptions for extra messages and advanced features.
Notes & safety
- AI may generate fictional or inaccurate content. Verify facts if needed.
- Not for professional advice (medical, legal, financial, etc.).
- No explicit sexual content. We enforce safety filters and community guidelines.
Support
Contact Email: xmingze10@163.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.caigirl.top/privacy-policy-ios.html
User Agreement: https://www.caigirl.top/user-policy-ios.html

bluejetty:00186958:ios.summary:
ABC MAGIC PHONICS 2 - Learn Letter Sounds the Right Way! Science-Backed Phonics for Early Reading Success!
Unlock your child's reading journey with ABC MAGIC PHONICS 2! Built on the foundational Science of Reading, this engaging app focuse
bluejetty:00186958:ios.description:
ABC MAGIC PHONICS 2 - Learn Letter Sounds the Right Way! Science-Backed Phonics for Early Reading Success!
Unlock your child's reading journey with ABC MAGIC PHONICS 2! Built on the foundational Science of Reading, this engaging app focuses on the crucial alphabetic principle, teaching your child the essential sounds of lowercase letters – the key to unlocking reading success.
Give your child the fundamental tools they need to become a confident reader. Just as numbers form the basis of math, understanding letter sounds is the cornerstone of reading. By mastering these sounds, your child gains the power to decode words and build a strong reading foundation.
ABC Magic Phonics 2 directly addresses the alphabetic principle – the understanding that letters represent sounds and that these sounds can be blended together to form words. Grounded in the Science of Reading, our app prioritizes teaching letter sounds, the most effective way to initiate reading skills.
 *Master Letter Sounds: Learn the primary sounds of all lowercase letters – the building blocks of 95% of printed text.
 *Scientifically Sound: Based on the Science of Reading, focusing on the proven method of teaching letter sounds first.
 *Engaging Visuals: Each letter is paired with four phonetic photo images that clearly represent its sound.
 *Multi-Sensory Learning: Combines visual (colored letters, photos), auditory (letter sounds, photo names), and kinesthetic (touching to hear) learning.
 *Repetition & Rhythm: The app's design incorporates repetition and rhythm to aid memorization of letter sounds.
 *Lowercase Focus: Smartly prioritizes lowercase letters, which make up the vast majority of written words.
 *Distraction-Free Learning: All unnecessary elements are removed, allowing your child to concentrate on letter-sound associations.
 *Builds on Prior Learning: A natural progression for children who may have used previous apps in the series.
 *Prepares for Future Reading: Lays a solid foundation for more advanced phonics skills and reading fluency.
Give your child a smart start! Unlike traditional methods, ABC Magic Phonics 2 focuses on lowercase letters first. Why? Because 95% of the words in books and periodicals are in lowercase. By prioritizing these essential letters, you're maximizing your child's learning efficiency.
Children actively engage by touching letters to hear their sounds and touching photos to hear their names. This auditory reinforcement, combined with clear visual associations, makes learning fun and effective. Young learners will enjoy repeating the sounds they hear, solidifying their understanding.
Created by a team of experienced educators using accelerated learning techniques and Montessori principles, ABC Magic Phonics 2 has been rigorously tested and loved by preschool children.
Help us make learning even better! Please share your feedback and suggestions as we continue to improve ABC Magic Phonics 2.
Give your child the magic of phonics! Download ABC Magic Phonics 2 today and set them on the path to reading success!

bluejetty:00185147:ios.description:

+ 2-3mins playtime per game

bluejetty:00023405:ios.description:
Have you ever thought how your future baby will look like? And what if you had a child with a celebrity? Will your baby be cute and adorable? Let’s find out together!
Our baby generator will merge your and your partner’s photos to create your future kid’s face according to your settings and let you see the baby growing. 
◆ Baby’s age
There are five options to choose from: baby, child, teenager, adult and random. 
◆ Baby’s gender
Will it be a baby boy or a baby girl’s photo - it’s up to you! If it doesn’t matter, press the randomizing button then.
◆ Resemblance to parents
Would you like your future baby’s face be more like yours or your partner’s? Again, you can choose a random setting and get surprised by results.
◆ GIF creation
Get the photo of your future child or make a GIF and see your baby’s getting older in an animated picture!
◆ AI baby name generator
Finding the perfect name just got easier! Our new baby name generator offers thousands of options to explore right within the app.
Have fun and share your results with friends! 
PLEASE READ:
- The length of subscription is 1 week, 1 month, and 2 months. You can cancel your subscription at any moment. 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
- The paid version of the application provides unlimited generation of photos of the future baby using artificial intelligence, the choice of the age of the child, the gender of the child and the similarity with one of the parents, as well as the ability to share the result and save the result in GIF format.
- Free version without subscription provides the generation of a photo of a future baby of any gender only twice in 24 hours. Save photo as GIF with watermark only.

bluejetty:00131986:ios.name: الملكة - حاسبة الحمل و الدورة
bluejetty:00131986:ios.summary:
تطبيق الملكة هو أفضل تطبيق نسائي باللغة العربية للنساء يساعد حساب الدورة الشهرية، حساب الحمل، متابعة الحمل، متابعة أعراض الحمل طيلة فترة الحمل لحمل سليم وصحي، حساب ايام التبويض عبر حاسبة التبويض لزيادة فرص الحمل.
تطبيق الملكة يساعدك لتعيشي
bluejetty:00131986:ios.description:
تطبيق الملكة هو أفضل تطبيق نسائي باللغة العربية للنساء يساعد حساب الدورة الشهرية، حساب الحمل، متابعة الحمل، متابعة أعراض الحمل طيلة فترة الحمل لحمل سليم وصحي، حساب ايام التبويض عبر حاسبة التبويض لزيادة فرص الحمل.
تطبيق الملكة يساعدك لتعيشي حياة صحية وأسرية أفضل عبر متابعة الدورة الشهرية، تاخر الدورة ، حساب ايام التبويض لزيادة فرص الحمل والمساعدة فى حمل متأخر للنساء ايضا يعرفك فترة الامان كوسيله امنه لمنع الحمل بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعراض الحمل عبر اسابيع الحمل ويعرفك اعراض الحمل المبكرة لحمل صحي ومريح
تعرفي أكثر على مميزات تطبيق الملكة .. 
 حساب الدورة الشهرية ومتابعة الدورة الشهرية : 
تسجيل مواعيد الدورة الشهرية، وتلقي تنبؤات دقيقة بموعد الدورة الشهرية القادمة وأيام التبويض.
تسجيل الأعراض الصحية والحالة المزاجية يوميًا للمساعدة على فهم التغيرات في جسمك لحياة أفضل
متابعة تقويم الدورة الشهريه شهريا دورة منتظمة 
حلول الحمل المتأخر للنساء وزيادة فرص الحمل من خلال حاسبة التبويض
حساب أيام التبويض بدقة لتحديد أفضل وقت للحمل.
متابعة الحمل: 
حساب الحمل عبر تقويم الحمل لمعرفة موعد الولادة.
متابعة الحمل طيلة فترة الحمل لحمل صحي وسليم ومريح
استكشاف اعراض الحمل المبكر والحصول على معلومات ونصائح طبية موثوقة من خبراء مختصين.
مجموعة من أهم أدوات متابعة الحمل اسبوعًا بأسبوع وهم : 
 حاسبة وزن الأم
حاسبة الركلات
حاسبة الانقباضات
خاصية تطور الجنين
تنبيهات بأهم الفحوصات الطبية طوال فترة الحمل
حقيبة المولود اهم المستلزمات للام والجنين الولادة طبيعى او الولادة القيصري
مزايا إضافية أساسية لحساب الحمل والدورة الشهرية:
تنبيهات ذكية لموعد الدورة الشهرية وايام التبويض.
تقويم الحمل لتسجيل مواعيد الطبيب والأحداث المهمة.
تسجيل الأعراض والملاحظات والتغيرات المزاجية وتشخيصها بدقة وتقديم حلول متخصصة.
معرفة أفضل أيام التبويض للحمل وأيضاً فترة الأمان كوسيلة آمنة لمنع الحمل.
تنظيم الدورة الشهرية وأيام الحيض ومتلازمة ما قبل الحيض.
مجتمع داعم للتواصل مع نساء أخريات و مشاركة التجارب والمشكلات الخاصة مع التزام السرية التامة عبر المنتدى الذهبي.
 الاستشارات الطبية النسائية 
احصلي على استشارات طبية نسائية اونلاين مع افضل الأطباء، مخصصة لاحتياجاتكِ، موثوقة و سرية تماماً، متاحة على مدار الساعة لتكونى فى حياة أفضل
تجدين أفضل طبيب / طبيبة متخصصين لقديم لكِ استشارات دقيقة لدعمكِ في جميع مراحل حياة النساء من تنظيم الدورة الشهرية إلى متابعة الحمل، حمل متأخر للنساء، حمل مبكر هدفنا تقديم الافضل والعناية بصحتكِ العامة.
المزايا ذهبية :
 كورسات للنساء للصحة الأنثوية في جميع المراحل
كورسات نسائية مخصصة للمرأة العربية تشمل الصحة الجسدية والنفسية والجمال والرشاقة والاستعداد للحمل وأيضا الطفولة والأمومة وغيرها من المواضيع لحياة أفضل
 المنتدى الذهبي
 منتدى نسائي متكامل تشاركين فيه بكل استفساراتك بحرية وأمان دون تدخل الرجال، ويعرفك على الملكات من مختلف الدول. يمتاز المنتدى الذهبي بخاصية الهوية الخفية والمنشور المثبت.
 مقالات غير محدودة تشمل
الدورة الشهرية
فترة الحمل
مشاكل تأخر الحمل
العلاقة الحميمة
نصائح عن البشرة والشعر والجمال
خسارة الوزن
زيادة الوزن
 نسخة مميزة بدون إعلانات مزعجة
تصفح سلس ومريح عبر تطبيق الملكة وتجربة استخدام مريحة بدون الإعلانات المزعجة، مما يتيح لك التركيز الكامل على محتوى التطبيق دون أي تشويش.
حمّلي تطبيق الملكة الآن مجاناُ وانضمي إلى ملايين النساء اللاتي اخترن الملكة لتكون رفيقتهن في رحلة الأنوثة والأمومة.

تجدين أفضل طبيب / طبيبة متخصصين لقديم لكِ استشارات دقيقة لدعمكِ في جميع مراحل حياة النساء من تنظيم الدورة الشهرية إلى متابعة الحمل، حمل متأخر للنساء، حمل مبكر هدفنا تقديم الافضل والعناية بصحتكِ العامة.

  كورسات للنساء للصحة الأنثوية في جميع المراحل

  المنتدى الذهبي
 منتدى نسائي متكامل تشاركين فيه بكل استفساراتك بحرية وأمان دون تدخل الرجال، ويعرفك على الملكات من مختلف الدول. يمتاز المنتدى الذهبي بخاصية الهوية الخفية والمنشور المثبت.

bluejetty:00030542:ios.summary:
Improve your pain, posture, and performance at home or on-the-go with hundreds of training videos, guided plans, and live workshops with Dr. Michael Wasilisin and our certified Coaches.
Rooted in the MoveU Method, The MoveU App, simplifies
bluejetty:00030542:ios.description:
Improve your pain, posture, and performance at home or on-the-go with hundreds of training videos, guided plans, and live workshops with Dr. Michael Wasilisin and our certified Coaches.
Rooted in the MoveU Method, The MoveU App, simplifies body mechanics and movement by using fun, educational videos paired with a simplified cueing system meant to help you understand the root cause of your pain/issues and then teach you how to 1) overcome and resolve them 2) build strength and live without limits. Videos are organized by body region: Back and Core, Hip and Glute, Knees, Ankles and Feet, Head and Neck, Shoulder & Arms (Elbow, Wrist, and Hand), and finally, Pelvic Floor. Members can choose to begin with any region of their body; however, all content is also organized by pain, injury, strength, and exercise sequences utilizing the “search” feature.
To help Members stay on track, we also host weekly live workshops and Q&A’s with our board-certified DC, DPT, and Coaches who have graduated from the MoveU Method. Finally, we offer monthly prompts/challenges, guided workouts, and connection with other members via Social Media to ensure the highest degree of success. In addition to this, we host a New Member live meet up once a month where you’ll get initiated into how it all works.  Our mission is simple: we want you to move better to live better. Whatever “living” means to you, whether that’s being pain-free, reaching new fitness heights, or heck, just being more knowledgeable about your body. Everyone should be a lifelong mUver.   HOW TO JOIN?
▷ Already a Member? Sign-In to access your subscription.
▷ New? Try it for free! Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
MoveU App offers an auto-renewing subscription that will allow you unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your Account at confirmation of purchase.
Pricing varies by location and is confirmed prior to purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Cancel anytime in Account Settings.
For more information, see our: 
-Terms of Service: https://moveu.com/terms-conditions/
-Privacy Policy: https://moveu.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00024863:ios.description:
Lil Artist – Where Learning Meets Imagination! Inspire Curiosity, Build Confidence, Celebrate Creativity.
Welcome to Lil Artist, the all-in-one educational playground for kids aged 2 to 7. With fun-filled activities designed by educators and loved by parents, Lil Artist transforms screen time into a joyful learning journey. Whether it’s tracing ABCs, solving logic puzzles, exploring country flags, or enjoying interactive bedtime stories, every activity is crafted to nurture your child’s early skills while sparking their natural creativity.
Why Lil Artist?
Because kids learn best when they’re having fun. Our vibrant, voice-guided environment is 100% ad-free and offline-ready, so your little one can learn safely, anytime, anywhere.
What’s Inside Lil Artist:
Creative Exploration
 • Draw & Doodle: Freehand drawing tools for kids to express their ideas.
 • Coloring Books: Fun themes like animals, vehicles, shapes, and nature.
 • Tracing Games: Learn to write letters, numbers, names, and more.
Early Learning Adventures
 • Alphabet & Phonics Games
 • ABC & 123 Tracing
 • Flash Cards: Letters, animals, objects, and flags.
Smart Playtime
 • Logic Puzzles & Memory Games
 • Word Search for Little Thinkers
 • Math Fun: Learn counting and basic problem solving.
World Discovery
 • Discover Country Flags with interactive flashcards.
Imaginative Stories
 • Bedtime Tales with voice narration.
Designed for Early Development
 • Fine motor skills
 • Cognitive thinking
 • Color and shape recognition
 • Confidence building
Safe, Friendly, and Fun
 • Ad-free experience
 • Kid-safe interface
 • Offline mode for learning on the go
 • Soft music and gentle voiceovers for guidance
Whether your child is tracing letters for the first time or solving puzzles with a smile, Lil Artist makes every moment educational and exciting. Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers, it’s a world where creativity blooms and skills grow naturally.
If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach us at digitalholecorp@gmail.com. Download Lil Artist today and watch your child grow and learn with endless fun!

bluejetty:00132182:ios.description:
TripView displays Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane public transport timetable data on your phone. It features a summary view showing your next services, as well as a full timetable viewer. All timetable data is stored on your phone, so it can be used offline.
Features:
 - Trackwork and service interruption information
 - Real-time delay information and vehicle map (Subject to data availability)
 - Interactive maps (create your trip by clicking on your station/stop)
 - Multi-modal trip editor (customise exact change locations / lines)
Additional features in the full version of TripView:
 - Save your trips
 - No advertisements
 - Organise trips into folders
 - Alarms
 - View your favourite trips on Apple Watch
 - Siri Shortcuts
NOTE: Best efforts are taken to ensure timetable accuracy, but no guarantees are made. If you find an error in the timetable, please email support@tripview.com.au with details. No guarantees are made about real-time data availability. If the transit operator doesn't provide real-time data for a particular service, TripView will revert to showing the scheduled time, as per the timetable.

bluejetty:00014490:ios.description:
N2F: Make expense report management effortless
Say goodbye to paperwork, long hours, and manual data entry — with N2F, managing expenses is fast, simple, and fully digital.
Start your free trial today!
Just snap a photo of your receipt — N2F’s smart scan extracts all key details (date, amount, currency, taxes...) and instantly completes your expense report.
With legal archiving, you can confidently dispose of your paper receipts.
Got digital supplier invoices from Uber, EasyJet, Amazon, or PayByPhone? Just forward them to n2f@n2f.com, and they’ll be automatically added to your expense report.
The app works seamlessly on both smartphones and desktops via our web platform — saving time for everyone:
For Employees:
– Submit expenses in under 5 seconds using the mobile app
– Go paperless: snap your receipts, no need to keep them
– Mileage allowances calculated automatically (tax or custom rates)
– Generate clear, customizable PDF or Excel summaries
– Organize expenses by month, project, customer, or trip
– In a rush? Enter just the basics — N2F reminds you to complete it later
For Managers:
– Approve reports with a fully customizable workflow
– Save time with a smart, intuitive dashboard
– Instantly flag expenses over policy limits
– Simplify client billing — N2F takes care of it
For Accounting & Admin:
– No duplicate entries — N2F generates export files for your accounting software
– Automatically calculates recoverable VAT (for international use)
– Set company-specific expense rules and spending limits
– Instantly review receipts from the web dashboard
– Reimburse employees quickly via bank export files (SEPA supported for EU businesses)
– Easily manage your vehicle fleet and mileage tracking
For Executives:
– Save your teams time with streamlined processes
– Monitor travel budgets with powerful reporting tools
– Optimize business expenses and mileage reimbursements
– Reduce overall travel and expense costs
Want even more?
– Use the web app for batch entries and detailed reporting
– Supports all international currencies with real-time exchange rates
– Manage projects, clients, budgets, and travel expenses all in one place
– Create custom analytics and categorize expenses your way
– Quickly view your expenses in the “My Expense Reports” list
– Track travel and mileage costs by vehicle and time period
N2F is your all-in-one solution for business, travel, and mileage expense management — finally made efficient.
Seamlessly integrates with your favorite tools: Sage, Cegid, SAP, QuickBooks, Oracle, Workday, Microsoft 365, and more.
We also offer open APIs and web services to connect with your information systems.
Switching from another app? N2F makes the transition smooth — from Expensify, SAP Concur, Zoho, Rydoo, and more.
Need a specific feature? Got an idea to improve the app? Want a demo?
Get in touch — we’d love to hear from you!

What is the best way to deal with waves of zombie in an outbreak?

Do your part and kill zombies daily to earn rewards from missions, lucky draw and free loot crates!
Whether you just want to collect more powerful guns or just engage in thrilling shooting action, this game allows you to jump in and begin immediately. Once you start, you won't want to stop firing.
If you have any feedback or questions, contact us at support@potatoplay.com

bluejetty:00187239:ios.description:
Ninja Number is the Second Phone Number app that lets you choose how you want to communicate. Separate business and personal calls with a designated 2nd phone number. Our industry-leading technology is ‘Always On’ (and trusted for over 20 years by the biggest businesses in the world,) ensuring you have coverage 24/7/365! With Cloud Power and Artificial Intelligence, our app turns your phone into a Virtual Assistant. 
Separate business and personal calls. Always know who’s calling when you use Ninja Number as your business phone number through Virtual PBX. When you return calls with the app, your Ninja Number will display, keeping your personal number private. 
We’re excited to offer a 7-Day Free Trial for any user who signs up through our website - NinjaNumber.com
AI Auto Reply. Let Ninja Number handle customer questions for you! Customize questions and answers using AI-Powered Auto Reply, sit back and let your phone do the rest. Our best business app technology ensures your incoming texts and voicemails will be scanned for the questions you programmed and will text back with the answers you create. 
Cloud-Powered Visual Voicemail. Don’t pay extra for visual voicemail. With Ninja Number’s smart line technology, there’s no need to always answer the phone. Simply read your voicemails and text back – all within the same thread. 
Virtual Assistant Business App. Running a business is hard, so put your phone to work. Ninja Number organizes your SMS texts and voicemails, tags and filters your contacts and gives you detailed call tracking and analytics, so you don’t have to do it all. 
Loop in team members. Get extra call coverage by looping in four team members. Easily link your Ninja Number to other devices so that when a call comes in, all phones ring. You’ll only ever pay for one subscription. We can also port or transfer numbers for you! 
Live Ninjas On-Demand. Want call coverage even when you’re busy or in a meeting, and don’t want your VIP Calls going to Voicemail? With Live Ninjas On-Demand, a professional US-based live operator will answer your calls when you want them to. They’re trained to answer the phones like you would! Pay by the call and never miss another lead again. 
Leads without calls. Ninja Number’s virtual phone system empowers you to communicate the way you want. Prefer business text messages? With AI Auto Reply and Cloud-Powered Visual Voicemail, you can text securely and so can your linked team members all in the same thread. 
Ninja Number is a smart, protected Second Phone Line app with easy, simple setup. Choose a toll-free or local number to advertise to customers and clients. Want a toll-free vanity number? Our Support Ninjas will work with you to find the number that fits your business line. Your phone is smart, so put it to work. 
Currently available in the US only. Requires a Ninja Number Flex subscription to use. You will be charged $9.99 a month until canceled in iTunes subscription settings at least 24 hours before your current period ends. All charges are applied to your iTunes account. 
Terms of use: https://ninjanumber.com/terms/ 
Privacy policy: https://ninjanumber.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00176774:ios.description:
Learning languages has never been so easy! More and more people learn languages with LENGO every day. Join today and be part of our growing community!
LENGO IS FREE TO USE
Our goal is to make education accessible to anyone. Thus, all basic features are permanently free to use. We are continuously extending paid content as well as free content to make LENGO even better.
WHAT TO EXPECT
LENGO equips you with everything you need to learn the language you want. It has been shown that you can significantly reduce the time invested in learning a new language by using instant feedback, recurrent material, and other methodologies that LENGO supports. Another aspect that is likely to improve your learning success is the motivation methods, which are often missing from traditional language-learning methods. However, you still have to bring some initiative.
EXTRA CONTENT? THAT'S PREMIUM
With LENGO Pro, you unlock your full potential. You unlock everything you need to learn languages as quickly and successfully as possible.
ABOUT LENGO
LENGO is a language learning platform that strives to enrich global human interaction by improving people’s ability to communicate.
Privacy policy: https://www.lengo.io/about/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.lengo.io/about/terms
Questions? Contact us:
contact@lengo.io
---------------------------------------------------------------
Information about the auto-renewable nature of the subscription
A subscription is not essential to get access to the full learning materials. You can also gain access by uploading content that adds value to the community. Otherwise, content can be unlocked through in-app-purchases. However, subscriptions are useful for users who want full access without any further action required. The subscribed user does not have to pay attention to our digital currency. Therefore, full access to the app is Lengo Pro.
Each subscription will be automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be automatically charged at the same price for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your iTunes Account Settings. When a subscription is canceled, access to the app’s courses and features will expire at the end of the current payment period.

bluejetty:00087415:ios.description:
The official app of Falls Creek. Make the most of your day in our Winter Wonderland. Connect with your friends on the slopes, track your ski days, view real-time lift and trail status.
REAL-TIME LIFT AND TRAIL STATUS
Know which trails are groomed, which lifts are open, and when they are scheduled to open all in real-time.
REAL-TIME WEATHER DATA
No more guessing how many layers you’ll need with real-time weather including minimum temperature, wind speeds and how much snow has fallen in the last 24 hours.
VIEW LIVE SNOW CAMS
Keep an eye on snowfalls and see real time mountain views with live cams from various locations around the resort.
FIND AND TRACK YOUR FRIENDS
Stay connected with friends by creating your own private group. See their current location in real-time on the resort map, what run or lift each person in your group is riding and the difficulty rating.
TRACK YOUR DAY AND SEASON
Keep track of all the details about your ski day and season. How many days skied, runs completed and vertical kilometres logged are all at the touch of a button. If you have an Apple Watch, record your runs as a workout and see your workout in the Health app.
LEADERBOARD
Compete for the top spot on the Falls Creek Leader board through days skied, lifts ridden, and vertical metres logged.
SHOP ONLINE
Buy early and save on lift tickets, lessons, rentals and more.
Created exclusively for Falls Creek by the Resorts Tapped LLC.
Note: Location and Logging services require a GPS-equipped device. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00119491:ios.description:
Tomorrow’s digital banking, today. A seamless and innovative banking experience with QNB. Customize how you want to display your accounts, manage your credit cards and quickly pay your most common payments from the dashboard. Moreover, you can use contactless payments, card less ATM services, deposit cheques, register & subscribe for IPO, chat online with one of QNB agents at any time if need our help.
You can login with your QNB Mobile and Internet Banking user name and password, or if you forgot your credentials, you can securely reset through the App. If you have not registered yet, you can simply register selecting Register Now. If you are not yet a QNB customer, you still can enjoy many of our services.
You can update the App automatically by going to Settings/iTunes & App Store/Automatic Downloads.
For more information, please visit www.qnb.com/mobile

bluejetty:00042000:ios.summary:
Sober Sidekick - the sober community with addiction recovery support. Quit drinking alcohol today with your sober buddy app, with sobriety counter and tracker that helps you track daily your sober time.
You are never alone with Sober Sidek
bluejetty:00042000:ios.description:
Sober Sidekick - the sober community with addiction recovery support. Quit drinking alcohol today with your sober buddy app, with sobriety counter and tracker that helps you track daily your sober time.
You are never alone with Sober Sidekick.
Stop drinking, stay sober and get the right support. 
Your Sober Buddy App
Quit drinking with Sober Sidekick, a sobriety and addiction recovery app for those struggling with alcohol or drugs. Our sober community members are here to support you. Receive guidance on how to stay sober and start your recovery journey today
Join a judgment-free social network
Alcohol addiction is fed in isolation. Immerse yourself in an understanding community of users who are on the path to recovery too. Stop drinking alcohol, take the first step and remember, you are not alone in this. Quit drinking or using drugs - start your addiction recovery journey with Sober Sidekick, your sobriety app.
Track your addiction recovery daily
Stay sober, day after day, from alcohol and drugs. Track your daily progress with our sobriety tracker feature. Get sober - our sobriety counter helps you count the days clean and accomplish goals and keep the motivation up: one day, 30 days, 60 days, and more.
Sober Sidekick - More than a Social Network, a Valuable Sober Community
Sober social networks features within the app will help you create your support system. Sober time, addiction recovery struggles, and wins can be shared in anonymous posts. Receive and lend recovery support through comments or empathy badges (likes). You can also message users directly. Alcohol or drugs recovery relies heavily on community; connect with a supportive, ego-free social network.
All the addiction recovery help in one app
Addiction recovery support & resources are offered in the app. Have a direct line to 24/7 AA and NA meetings. You will find motivational content and blogs to support your journey to an addiction-free life. Our sober community is here to support and has the same goal - Quit drinking or using drug and start your addiction recovery journey today. 
Stop drinking alcohol, seek addiction recovery and join our Sober Sidekick community today, where users have access to addiction recovery resources and daily support. 
Sober Sidekick - Your sobriety counter and tracker to start your addiction recovery today. 
Here are our app features to make your recovery journey easier:
Sober Community:
- Addiction recovery isn’t easy; connect with accountability partners (AA meetings) to stay on track with sobriety goals
- Quit drinking and receive help: AA support is available every time you reach out, guaranteed!
- Our Sobriety tracker & counter app gives you everything you need to keep moving forward
Sober Tracker:
- Days sober can be tracked (days, weeks, months & years)
- Stay clean with our sobriety counter that helps you track days clean
- Sober time: track and hit milestones, then celebrate!
Sober Social Network:
- Sober stories: share social media posts, comments, and empathy badges (likes)
- Declare “I am sober” to the world, even if it’s anonymously
- Sober posts are anonymous, so you can keep your identity private
- Sober social network available through direct messaging feature
Addiction Recovery Resources:
- Addiction Recovery Counselors are available when you need help
- AA meetings and NA meetings via Zoom 24/7
- Sober perspectives and support available through motivational content and blogs
- Alcohol Treatment options, IOP treatments, Outpatient Programs, Substance Abuse Programs, Alcoholics Anonymous, Narcotics Anonymous, Dharma Recovery and more - unlock motivations and find what works for you!
Join our sober community to receive the support you need to get sober and stay that way.

Note: some features may be available dependin
bluejetty:00163757:ios.description:
This app lets you control your hearing aids from your mobile device. It comes with an app for Apple Watch helping you discreetly change programs and adjust volume (when within Bluetooth range).
Note: some features may be available depending on your hearing aid model. Check below for details.
• Adjust sound volume for each hearing aid together or separately
• Mute surroundings for better focus
• Switch between programs set by your hearing care professional
• Check battery levels
• Stream calls, music, and podcasts directly to your hearing aids (availability may vary depending on your phone model)
• Find your hearing aids if lost (requires location services always turned on)
• Access app support and troubleshooting solutions
• Meet your hearing care professional for an online visit (by appointment)
• Adjust streaming sounds with streaming equalizer (available for all hearing aid models except Bernafon Zerena)
• Adjust sounds around you with sound equalizer (available for Bernafon Revita, Encanta and Alpha XT models)
• Track your progress with HearingCoach feature (available for Bernafon Revita, Encanta and Alpha XT models)
• Handle wireless accessories paired with your hearing aids such as TV-A or SoundClip-A
• Connect to and adjust an Auracast™ broadcast (available for Bernafon Revita and Encanta models)
• Get reminders to replace your wax filters to maintain sound quality (available for Bernafon Revita and Encanta models)
• Reduce background noise while streaming with Smart Adaptative Streaming (available for Bernafon Revita)
First use:
You need to pair your hearing aids with this app to use it to control your hearing aids. 
App availability:
The app is compatible with most hearing aid models. If you have hearing aids from 2016-2018 and haven't updated them yet, a hearing aid update is required for this app to work. We recommend regular hearing aid updates during your routine check-up with your hearing care professional.
For optimal performance, we recommend updating your device to iOS 18 or later. To check the latest list of compatible devices, please visit:
www.bernafon.com/hearing-aid-users/hearing-aids/connectivity/compatibility

bluejetty:00014130:ios.name: BookScanner Book Leveler App
bluejetty:00014130:ios.summary: BookScanner has been rebuilt. Everything you scanned is still here. On first launch BookScanner brings your earlier scan history across by itself — nothing to export, nothing to restore, nothing to tap. The old library file is read and left
bluejetty:00014130:ios.description:
BookScanner has been rebuilt. Everything you scanned is still here. On first launch BookScanner brings your earlier scan history across by itself — nothing to export, nothing to restore, nothing to tap. The old library file is read and left exactly where it is, so the version you already had is untouched. Books that came over are marked "From your earlier scan history" in History, and the filter sheet will show you just those. You can run the import again from Settings whenever you like.
Your ATOS levels, AR quiz numbers, AR points, word counts, interest levels and Lexile measures come across exactly as BookScanner had them.
NOTHING TO BUY
Lexile measures, DRA, Fountas & Pinnell / Guided Reading Levels and grade equivalents are included for every owner. BookScanner has no in-app purchases and no subscriptions.
FIVE READING LEVELS, AND WHERE EACH ONE CAME FROM
- AR (Accelerated Reader) / ATOS — looked up, never estimated
- Lexile measures — looked up, never estimated
- Guided Reading Level (GRL) / F&P — looked up from Scholastic when Scholastic has it; otherwise BookScanner estimates it and marks it ≈
- DRA (Developmental Reading Assessment) — marked ≈ when BookScanner estimates it
- Grade level equivalent — marked ≈ when BookScanner estimates it
Above P, BookScanner doesn't estimate a Guided Reading Level: where Scholastic has no level for a longer chapter book, BookScanner shows none rather than a letter it can't stand behind.
NO BARCODE? FIND IT ANOTHER WAY
When a barcode won't scan, or it isn't the book's ISBN, type the book's title instead. On iPhone and iPad models whose camera can read text, BookScanner can also read the title from the cover or spine for you to check before it searches, or read the ISBN printed on the book.
NOW ON MAC
BookScanner runs on the Mac as well as on iPhone and iPad, on the same purchase. Scan with the webcam at your desk. Your history is kept in your own private iCloud database and syncs to your other devices.
UNITED STATES AND UNITED KINGDOM
The ARBookFind region switch is in Settings to choose your region.
IMPORT AND EXPORT
- Export your library to CSV — sixteen columns, including where each level came from
- Import a CSV, including a file exported from the earlier BookScanner
- Export to PDF for printing, and share a single book or your whole library
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Recently scanned books and one-tap scanning, right on your Home Screen.
Used by teachers since 2012.
Rave Reviews:
"My kids and I love this app. It's very helpful and convenient."
Get Started Today:
Download BookScanner now to simplify your reading comprehension tasks and stay organized!

**Lexile and the Lexile Framework are registered trademarks of MetaMetrics, Inc. BookScanner App and If Then Dev, LLC are in no way affiliated with MetaMetrics, Inc.
***BookScanner App and If Then Dev, LLC are in no way affiliated with Fountas & Pinnell or Heinemann Publishing
****Developmental Reading Assessment (DRA) is a trademark of its owner. BookScanner App and If Then Dev, LLC are in no way affiliated.

bluejetty:00025459:ios.description:
Arcush is a powerful, minimalistic daily planner app designed to help you organize tasks, boost productivity, manage schedules, and optimize time management. Whether you're planning work, personal errands, or long-term goals, Arcush provides the tools to stay focused, structured, and efficient.
Key Features:
- Time Blocking & Schedule Visualization – Structure your day, allocate time slots for meetings, tasks, and free time, and gain a clear overview of your agenda.
- Task Management & Prioritization – Use the Inbox to jot down ideas, add activities, and organize tasks effectively.
- Inbox Zero – Clear unnecessary tasks, focus on priorities and reduce mental clutter.
- Smart Calendar Sync* – Integrate work and personal calendars for a unified planning experience.
- Time Blocking* – Mark dedicated slots for deep work or important errands, and signal your availability to others.
- Color Coding & Organization* – Categorize and highlight tasks with colors to streamline scheduling.
- Quick Task Creation & Editing – Add tasks with minimal effort using an intuitive interface and a single-screen setup.
- Widgets & Quick Access – Create tasks instantly from your home screen without opening the app.
- Notifications & Smart Reminders – Get timely alerts for upcoming and overdue tasks, ensuring you never miss a plan.
- Recurring Task Automation* – Set up daily, weekly, and monthly tasks with flexible repeat options.
Arcush is designed for task management, time blocking, productivity tracking, goal setting, and daily planning. Whether you're managing work schedules, personal routines, meetings, deadlines, or habits, Arcush helps you stay organized and focused.
Boost efficiency with smart reminders, calendar integration, quick task entry, intuitive scheduling, and flexible recurring task options. With a clean and minimalist planner interface, Arcush simplifies your workflow while keeping your day structured.- Automate recurring tasks with daily, weekly, and monthly scheduling options.
Arcush is free to download and use, with premium features (marked *) available through Arcush Pro, offered as a monthly, yearly, or lifetime subscription.
Terms of Use – https://www.arcush.com/terms

bluejetty:00146293:ios.summary: With the KRUU App, the best moments from your celebration stay in one place. Easily discover, download, like, and comment on your photos in a shared gallery. The pictures from your KRUU Photo Booth are also automatically transferred to the
bluejetty:00146293:ios.description:
With the KRUU App, the best moments from your celebration stay in one place. Easily discover, download, like, and comment on your photos in a shared gallery. The pictures from your KRUU Photo Booth are also automatically transferred to the app after your approval. New: With the Audio Guestbook, you can listen to your guests’ voicemails again at any time. This way, not only pictures stay with you, but also personal words, lovely wishes, and funny messages.
WHAT THE KRUU APP OFFERS YOU:
Shared photo gallery: Collect the best photos from your event in a clear feed and share them with family, friends, and guests.
KRUU Photo Booth pictures included: Your photo booth pictures are transferred to the app free of charge and can be viewed, downloaded, and shared there.
Audio Guestbook: Listen to your guests’ voicemails again and again, even after the celebration.
Likes & comments: Interact with your favorite pictures and relive the best moments together.
Easy admin area: Manage your event and decide who you share your memories with.
Free to use: The KRUU App is free and contains no in-app purchases.
HOW IT WORKS:
Download the KRUU App and join an event or create a new one. Invite guests, collect your photos in one place, and discover all pictures in the app after the upload. There, you can like, comment, and download them.
WHY KEEP THE APP?
With the KRUU App, your pictures and voicemails are always within reach, even after the celebration. You do not have to search through your entire phone and can view or listen to your shared memories again at any time. You can also use the app for future celebrations with a KRUU Photo Booth.
DATA PROTECTION
Your photos are only visible to you and your invited guests. They are protected according to high data protection standards and stored on German servers.
WHO IS KRUU?
Since 2016, more than 300,000 photo booth customers have trusted KRUU. We are Europe’s market leader in photo booth rentals and work with over 70 team members in Bad Friedrichshall near Heilbronn, Germany.
Do you have questions or feedback? Feel free to contact us at support@kruu.com

bluejetty:00100391:ios.name: Juula - Track Your Dolma
bluejetty:00100391:ios.summary:
Calorie counting that knows dolma, biryani and kubba.
Most calorie apps are built around food you don't eat. Juula is built around Middle Eastern dishes, cooked the way they're cooked here. Rice weighed raw or cooked, chicken with or witho
bluejetty:00100391:ios.description:
Calorie counting that knows dolma, biryani and kubba.
Most calorie apps are built around food you don't eat. Juula is built around Middle Eastern dishes, cooked the way they're cooked here. Rice weighed raw or cooked, chicken with or without oil, one piece of dolma or a full plate. Every food comes with the portions people actually use, from a spoon to a plate.
LOG A MEAL IN SECONDS
• Take a photo. Juula names the dish, lists what's in it with grams, and you check it before it's added.
• Say it or type it. "Two pieces of kubba and a bowl of rice" works in Kurdish, Arabic or English.
• When a detail changes the calories a lot, like raw or cooked weight, Juula asks instead of guessing.
• Scan the barcode on packaged food. Your recent scans stay one tap away.
• Search more than 1,500 Iraqi, Kurdish and Middle Eastern foods and millions of packaged products, or log again from your recent foods and your own recipes.
KNOW WHAT YOU'RE EATING
• Calories, protein, carbs, fat and fiber, plus vitamins and minerals.
• Tap any nutrient to see which foods have the most of it.
• Browse foods by category, or filter for high-protein and other options.
• A report every week with your score, highlights and a day-by-day chart.
EATING OUT
• Browse menus from local restaurants, with calories for each dish.
STAYING ON TRACK
• Daily calorie, protein, carb and fat targets based on your goal.
• Weight and water tracking.
• Steps from Apple Health count toward your daily calories, and your meals and water can be saved to Apple Health.
• Groups: track together with friends or family and compare a daily score.
• Medals, streaks and meal reminders.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Arabic, and Kurdish in both Sorani and Badini, with full right-to-left support.
JUULA PREMIUM
Juula is free to use. Premium adds:
• More AI photo scans every day
• More meals logged by voice or text
• Unlimited barcode scans
• Analytics that show which foods drive your calories, plus your macros, food quality and meal split
• Monthly reports with PDF export
• All vitamins and minerals
• Custom foods, and Quick Add with protein, carbs and fat
• Meal plans built around your goals
• No ads
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Juula Premium is available as monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://juula.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00162628:ios.description:
Octal is your go-to news feed for breaking tech news, putting the biggest stories of the day with engaging discussion right in the palm of your hand.
Beautifully designed for both iPhone and iPad, Octal focuses on what you care most about: native design, speed, and usability. It's the modern, full-featured Hacker News app you've been looking for.
You'll find an unparalleled, community-powered source of stories about anything ranging from self-driving cars to the latest Apple gadgets. Octal has all the features you need, including the ability to vote on stories, submit posts, add comments, and manage favorites. Best of all, it's free of all that annoying stuff, like ads, subscriptions, and tracking. If you want to keep up to date with the latest popular and trending tech headlines, Octal is made for you.
• NEWS FOR NERDS: Read and share the most important stories in the tech world, submitted and voted on by Hacker News users. Stories are constantly changing, and often focus on areas like programming, startups, technology industry and companies (Apple, Google, Microsoft, Facebook, Amazon, Uber, etc.), and key technology categories such as mobile, computers, internet, design, coding, and security.
• ENGAGE AND VOTE: Vote on stories and comments you like and dislike, and report stories with objectionable content. Found something you need to read later? Add it to your favorites!
• DISCUSS THE NEWS: Read and engage with stories by viewing their discussions with a fast, fully-threaded, collapsible, buttery smooth comments experience. Add your own comments. If you're a fast reader, you can instantly jump to the next top-level comment thread with a single tap.
• SUBMIT LINKS: Got a cool story or news link to share to Hacker News? Submit new posts directly in the app. You can also share links directly to Octal to quickly submit them.
• SEARCH STORIES: Search Hacker News stories and sort search results by relevance or date.
• JOIN THE COMMUNITY: Log in to Hacker News to easily track your karma, activity and favorites. Browse user profiles, including their karma, about, activity, and favorites.
• THEMEABLE: Total Dark Mode support. Turn on 'True Black' to use a pure RGB #000 background color - perfect for devices with OLED displays.
• CUSTOMIZE YOUR NEWS FEED: Tap or swipe between story feeds such as 'Top Stories', 'Threads', 'Ask HN', 'Show HN', 'Best Stories', 'New Stories', and 'Jobs'.
• ACCESSIBLE: Increase or decrease the text size to one that's comfortable for you, or enable 'Dynamic Type' to use the system's 'Larger Text' font size. And VoiceOver is fully supported!
• DEEP LINK SUPPORT: You can open Hacker News links in Octal by sharing them to Octal. You can also use apps like 'Opener'. Most Hacker News links starting with 'octal://' are supported!
• READY FOR ANY SCREEN: Octal looks great on iPads with an optional 2-pane interface. Say goodbye to wasted screen real estate.
• WEB BROWSER SUPPORT: Open links in your web browser of choice.

bluejetty:00019521:ios.name: Widgetsmith
bluejetty:00019521:ios.summary:
Widgetsmith lets you personalize your device like never before with a wide range of highly customizable widgets. It allows you to design your home screen to remind you of the people, places, and words that mean the most to you. 
Widgetsmit
bluejetty:00019521:ios.description:
Widgetsmith lets you personalize your device like never before with a wide range of highly customizable widgets. It allows you to design your home screen to remind you of the people, places, and words that mean the most to you. 
Widgetsmith showcases your photos, counts down to upcoming events, provides quick access to your favorite music, allows you to check the weather at a glance, and more. You can build widgets with Actions to launch apps, run Shortcuts, send a text, and more, from your home screen or Control Center.
Widgetsmith includes a library of iPhone wallpapers and a tool to theme your widgets to perfectly complement these wallpapers or any of your own.
Each widget can be adjusted precisely to fit your desired appearance and function, using various colors, fonts, borders, and themes. With Widgetsmith, you can create your perfect home screen aesthetic and easily change it over time. 
WIDGETS:
You can create almost anything with Widgetsmith, using the wide range of widget types offered in the app! Here are some favorites:
Photos: Highlight your favorite images across your home screens with a range of filters and borders
Photo Galleries: View photos in an album or customized collection
Customizable Date & Time Clocks
Activity Tracking & Step Counting
Countdown Timers
Solar & Lunar Trackers
Weather Conditions & Forecasts
Time Zone Tracker
Widgetsmith lets you customize not only your home screen but also your lock screen! You can view inspirational song lyrics, a photo of a loved one, weather information, and more without unlocking your device.
WALLPAPERS:
Widgetsmith includes a collection of phone wallpapers from various artists. These can be downloaded directly from the app and used to create custom widget themes to quickly and easily theme your entire home screen in a pleasing color palette. 
FLEXIBILITY:
If you want different widgets at different times of day, Widgetsmith has you covered! For example, a widget could show the weather in the morning, your calendar during your work day, and then switch to your Activity ring progress as you wrap up your day. This lets you take full advantage of each slot on your home screen.
IN-APP TOOLS:
Wisgetsmith is also home to a wide range of valuable tools, including:
A weather app with air quality, pollen, and tide information
A full-featured time zone converter
Charts to review activity and workout data
NOTES:
Widgetsmith is designed to optionally integrate with Apple Health to display your steps and activity. Permission for Widgetsmith to access this data is controlled through the Apple Health app.
Widgetsmith can also integrate with your photos, Apple Music library, calendars, reminders, and more. Access to this information is handled using the standard iOS/iPadOS/watchOS privacy prompts, which are shown only in Widgetsmith.
Widgetsmith includes an optional premium subscription. This is offered on a monthly or annual basis. If you choose to purchase a subscription, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings in the App Store.
Access to tide and weather data is only available to Widgetsmith Premium subscribers.
LEARN MORE: 
Privacy Policy: https://widgetsmith.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://widgetsmith.app/terms

apple-macos:6794546268.name: Frelio
apple-macos:6794546268.description:
Field notes for your friendships.
Some people are worth remembering, and we forget them anyway. The church planter with three kids and a fishing habit. The barista who knows your order before you say it. Frelio is a pocket notebook for the people in your life. Part field notes on the ones you're just getting to know, part gentle nudge to keep showing up for the ones you already love.
It's not a social network. There's no feed, and nobody to perform for. The phone comes out for five seconds so the next conversation can go deeper.
JUST MET SOMEONE?
Jot their name and one detail. That's it. Dictate it in the parking lot if your hands are full. Next time you see them, you'll remember the thing that mattered, and they'll notice that you did.
AT A CONFERENCE OR A WEDDING?
Start an event and everyone you meet files under it automatically. Afterwards, Frelio runs a quick memory game on who you met, because saying a name out loud is how it sticks. Open that event a year later and everyone's still there.
YOUR CIRCLE
The handful of people you're really investing in get more. Birthdays. A check-in rhythm that fits each person, weekly for your closest, quarterly for the old roommate across the country. A quiet nudge when life has crowded somebody out. No streaks and no guilt.
PLACES
Friendship has a geography. Your city, your church, the gym, the coffee shop. Add your spots and Frelio keeps track of who you meet there. Your regulars become your people.
ON EVERY DEVICE
Keep your notebook on every device, and get new features first. Create a Frelio account and your iPhone, iPad and Mac stay in step. Sign in with Apple or Google. An account is optional. Without one, Frelio works the way it always has.
ALSO IN THE BOX
One-tap capture from your lock screen. Siri can add someone for you, and so can your Apple Watch. Save people to your iPhone Contacts without creating duplicates. Photos, common ground, search across everything you've written, and a full export of your notebook anytime.
PRIVATE, ACTUALLY
Your notebook lives on your device. Frelio has no ads, and nothing in it tracks you across other apps or websites.
Create a Frelio account and your notebook is encrypted on your device before it leaves, so nobody else can read it, us included. Your Apple account keeps the key safe, and you get a recovery key for the rare day you need it. What Frelio can see is short: your email, your first name if you give it, the devices you use, and a few counts and dates.
One more thing Frelio won't do: become your brain. Writing a detail down is an act of paying attention. The goal is that you remember the name next time, not that an app remembers it for you.
